title: Recovering curves from isogeny classes of Prym varieties
comment: Submitted to a volume in honor of Y. Zarhin
summary: We propose a conjecture on how to recover an algebraic curve from the isogeny classes of its Prym varieties. Motivated by this conjecture, we analyze constructions of pairs of curves with isogenous Jacobians and several isogenous Pryms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个关于从Prym簇的同源类恢复代数曲线的猜想，并基于该猜想分析具有同源Jacobian及多个同源Prym的曲线对的构造。
AI.motivation: 探讨代数曲线与其Prym簇同源类之间的对应关系，试图建立从Prym簇同源类恢复原曲线的理论框架。
AI.method: 提出一个恢复曲线的猜想作为研究动机，进而分析构造具有同源Jacobian和多个同源Prym的曲线对的方法。
AI.result: 给出了若干曲线对的构造，这些曲线对具有同源的Jacobian以及多个同源的Prym簇。
AI.conclusion: 该猜想为从Prym簇同源类恢复代数曲线提供了可能路径，且相关构造为该方向的研究提供了具体实例。

title: A construction of polyptych lattices via a pair of Gorenstein PL cones
summary: The theory of polyptych lattices seeks to incorporate, into a single combinatorial framework, the piecewise-linear bijections (mutations) that appear in many theories that generalize toric geometry, such as Newton-Okounkov bodies, toric degenerations, cluster varieties, and other areas. The link to algebraic geometry comes from the accompanying notion of detropicalizations of polyptych lattices, and their associated compactifications. The main result of this manuscript gives a concrete construction of a strict dual pair $(\mathcal{E}, \mathcal{F})$ of polyptych lattices, which we call a Gorenstein PL cone extension. To define our construction, we introduce the notion of Gorenstein PL cones, which are a polyptych analogue of a Gorenstein cone in the classical setting. If the original polyptych lattices are detropicalizable, then the new polyptych lattices $\mathcal{E},\mathcal{F}$ are also detropicalizable, via a simple explicit formula. Our Gorenstein PL cone extensions give a rich source of examples of strict dual pairs of polyptych lattices. In particular, any pair of Gorenstein-Fano polytopes $Δ,Δ'$ of dimension $n,n'$ respectively, gives rise to a strict dual pair $(\mathcal{E}(Δ,Δ'), \mathcal{F}(Δ,Δ'))$ of detropicalizable polyptych lattices of rank $n+n'+1$. Other examples can be built from cluster data.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了一类严格对偶的多联晶格对——Gorenstein PL锥扩张，统一并入多联晶格理论，可来源于Gorenstein-Fano多胞形与簇数据。
AI.motivation: 多联晶格理论旨在将Newton-Okounkov体、toric退化、簇簇（cluster varieties）等推广toric几何的理论中出现的分段线性双射（突变）纳入统一的组合框架，但其严格对偶对的具体构造尚属空白，需要丰富的实例来源来支撑该理论。
AI.method: 引入Gorenstein PL锥（经典Gorenstein锥的多联类比），据此给出严格对偶多联晶格对(𝓔,𝓕)的具体构造，称为Gorenstein PL锥扩张；并结合detropicalization的伴随概念及其紧化建立与代数几何的联系。
AI.result: 给出了严格对偶对(𝓔,𝓕)的具体构造；若原多联晶格可detropicalize，则新晶格𝓔、𝓕也可通过一个简单的显式公式detropicalize；任意维数为n、n'的Gorenstein-Fano多胞形对(Δ,Δ')产生秩为n+n'+1的detropicalizable严格对偶多联晶格对(𝓔(Δ,Δ'),𝓕(Δ,Δ'))；此外还可由簇数据构造更多例子。
AI.conclusion: Gorenstein PL锥扩张为多联晶格的严格对偶对提供了丰富的实例来源，将Gorenstein-Fano多胞形与簇数据纳入统一框架，并为toric几何各类推广理论间建立组合与代数几何的桥梁。

title: Riemann-Roch for 0-cycles on a singular variety
summary: Let $X$ be a quasi-projective scheme of dimension $d$ over an infinite field $k$, such that $X$ is reduced after removing all components of dimension $<d$, and let $X^*\subset X$ be a closed subset of dimension $<d$ such that $X\setminus X^*$ is regular of dimension $d$. Using a modification $\text{CH}^d(X, X^*)$ of the Chow group of 0-cycles on a singular variety defined by C. Weibel and the author in 1985, we construct a Chern class map $c_d:K_0(X)\to \text{CH}^d(X, X^*)$, a cycle class map from $\text{CH}^d(X, X^*)$ onto a subgroup $F^dK_0(X)$ of $K_0(X)$, and prove a Riemann-Roch theorem computing the two compositions of these two maps.

AI.tldr: 本文在奇异拟射影簇上利用修正的Chow群CH^d(X,X*)构造了Chern类映射与循环类映射，并证明了相应的Riemann-Roch定理。
AI.motivation: 对奇异簇上0-循环的Chow群（Weibel与作者1985年定义的修正）建立K_0与Chow群之间的类映射并给出Riemann-Roch型公式，以推广经典情形下的结果。
AI.method: 设X为无限域k上维数d的拟射影概型，去掉维数<d的分量后约化，X*为维数<d的闭子集，且X\X*是维数d的正则部分；使用修正Chow群CH^d(X,X*)，构造Chern类映射c_d: K_0(X)→CH^d(X,X*)，以及从CH^d(X,X*)到K_0(X)子群F^dK_0(X)的满射（循环类映射），并计算两个映射的两种复合。
AI.result: 构造出Chern类映射c_d: K_0(X)→CH^d(X,X*)与循环类映射CH^d(X,X*)↠F^dK_0(X)，并证明了一个Riemann-Roch定理，用于计算这两个映射的两种复合。
AI.conclusion: 在奇异簇（条件为去低维分量后约化并具正则开部分）上，修正Chow群与K_0之间的Chern类与循环类映射满足Riemann-Roch公式，推广了光滑情形下的Riemann-Roch定理。

title: The moduli space of torsion-free sheaves with quasi-maximal third Chern class
summary: In this paper, we investigate the geometry of the Gieseker moduli space of semistable rank $2$ torsion-free sheaves on $\mathbb{P}^3$ with Chern classes $(c_1, c_2, c_3) = (-1, c_2, c_2^2-2)$ for $c_2 \geq 2$. We use the modular Serre correspondence to relate these moduli spaces to spaces of pairs and to suitable Hilbert schemes of one-dimensional subschemes in $\mathbb{P}^3$. For $c_2 \geq 4$, we prove that the moduli space is irreducible of dimension $c_2^2+3c_2+5$. For the case $c_2 = 3$, relying on a known geometric description of a relevant Hilbert scheme, we show that the moduli space $\mathcal{M}(-1,3,7)$ consists of exactly two irreducible components, namely the generic component of reflexive sheaves and a $T$-component, and we prove that their intersection is nonempty.

AI.tldr: 研究 P^3 上 c1=-1、c3=c2^2-2 的秩2无挠半稳定层模空间几何：c2≥4 时不可约且维数为 c2^2+3c2+5；c2=3 时 M(-1,3,7) 恰有两个不可约分支且相交非空。
AI.motivation: 刻画 P^3 上特定 Chern 类秩 2 无挠半稳定层的 Gieseker 模空间几何结构，尤其是不可约性与分支构成。
AI.method: 利用模 Serre 对应，将这些模空间与 pairs 空间及 P^3 中一维子概形的适当 Hilbert 概形联系起来。
AI.result: c2≥4 时模空间不可约，维数为 c2^2+3c2+5；c2=3 时 M(-1,3,7) 恰由两个不可约分支组成，即 reflexive 层的一般分支与一个 T-分支，且二者交非空。
AI.conclusion: 通过模 Serre 对应揭示模空间与 pairs、Hilbert 概形之间的联系，并确定相关模空间的不可约性、维数与分支结构。

title: Odd stochastic density functional theory
summary: Stochastic density functional theory (SDFT) provides a powerful framework for studying the dynamics of many-body systems both in and out of equilibrium. In its standard form, it can be viewed as a density-based formulation of coupled Langevin equations with white noise. Here, we extend SDFT to a class of systems, ranging from magnetized electrolytes to chiral active matter, that possess a chiral overdamped limit in which a relaxation timescale and an oscillation period are simultaneously taken to zero. We derive this formulation, which we dub ``odd SDFT", by taking the overdamped limit of a fluctuating hydrodynamic description of underdamped particles subject to a Lorentz force. We establish the validity and utility of the resulting framework by calculating the collective mobility tensor of interacting particles using both direct linear response and a Green-Kubo relation. We then apply the theory to the Hall conductivity of electrolytes in magnetic fields. Going beyond mean-field theory and using two distinct Green-Kubo relations, we derive the full conductivity tensor, extending the relaxation part of the Debye-Hückel-Onsager theory to the case of finite magnetic fields.

AI.tldr: 本文将随机密度泛函理论（SDFT）扩展至具有手性过阻尼极限的系统（如磁化电解质与手性活性物质），提出"odd SDFT"框架，并推导出完整电导率张量。
AI.motivation: 标准SDFT可视为白噪声耦合Langevin方程的密度表述，但难以描述同时具备弛豫时间尺度与振荡周期的体系（磁化电解质、手性活性物质等）。作者希望建立一个涵盖此类手性过阻尼极限的密度泛函理论。
AI.method: 从受洛伦兹力的欠阻尼粒子的涨落流体力学描述出发，取过阻尼极限，其中弛豫时间尺度与振荡周期同时趋于零，从而推导出odd SDFT。通过直接线性响应与Green-Kubo关系计算相互作用粒子的集体迁移率张量，并进一步利用两种不同的Green-Kubo关系推导完整电导率张量。
AI.result: 建立了odd SDFT框架，验证了其在计算集体迁移率张量时的有效性；将其应用于磁场中电解质的霍尔电导率，得到完整电导率张量，并将Debye-Hückel-Onsager理论的弛豫部分推广至有限磁场情形。
AI.conclusion: odd SDFT为研究手性过阻尼体系提供了统一且有效的密度泛函框架，成功将经典电解质理论推广至磁场情形，兼具理论价值与实用前景。

title: Global-in-time inviscid limit of the Navier-Stokes equations for vortex-wave data
comment: 103 pages. Comments or suggestions are welcome
summary: We justify the vortex-wave system introduced by Marchioro and Pulvirenti in the 1990s as the vanishing-viscosity limit of the two-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations on every prescribed finite time interval. The initial vorticity consists of a point vortex and a smooth, compactly supported background that vanishes near the vortex. The regular component converges strongly to the background vorticity governed by the vortex-wave system, while the concentrated component is approximated by a Lamb-Oseen vortex centered on the limiting point-vortex trajectory. We obtain quantitative estimates for both components, with constants and a viscosity threshold depending on the chosen time interval, thereby providing a global-in-time justification of the vortex-wave system for this class of initial data.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了Marchioro-Pulvirenti涡旋-波系统是二维Navier-Stokes方程在任意给定有限时间区间上的粘性消失极限，初始涡量由点涡和紧支撑光滑背景组成。
AI.motivation: 涡旋-波系统自上世纪90年代提出以来，缺乏严格的粘性消失极限推导，本文旨在填补这一理论空白，给出该系统的严格数学基础。
AI.method: 考虑二维Navier-Stokes方程，初始涡量包含一个点涡和在其附近消失的光滑紧支撑背景；分析粘性趋于零的极限行为，将解分解为正则部分（收敛于背景涡量）和集中部分（用Lamb-Oseen涡近似）。
AI.result: 正则分量强收敛于由涡旋-波系统支配的背景涡量；集中分量由位于极限点涡轨迹上的Lamb-Oseen涡近似；获得两个分量的定量估计，其中常数和粘性阈值依赖于所选时间区间。
AI.conclusion: 为该类初始数据提供了涡旋-波系统的整体时间（global-in-time）严格论证，确立了其作为二维Navier-Stokes方程粘性消失极限的合理性。

title: Uncertainty Quantification for the Fission Matrix Method: A Rigorous Mathematical Framework and Computationally Efficient Alternatives
comment: Submitted to Nuclear Science and Engineering (Taylor & Francis) on Sep. 22, 2026
summary: The fission matrix (FM) method recasts neutron transport in matrix form, enabling fast, interpolation-based reactor calculations from a pre-computed database of Monte Carlo-derived coefficients. Propagation of the underlying Monte Carlo statistical uncertainty to the FM eigenvalue and eigenvector is rarely rigorous: prior approaches assume independent coefficients without testing this against their actual covariance. This work derives a full-covariance Delta-method framework for propagating uncertainty to keff and the fission source, and evaluates it with two cheaper alternatives, a diagonal-covariance approximation and direct resampling of the FM coefficients, using an OpenMC model of the JSI TRIGA Mark-II reactor. For the all-rods-out case, these three estimators and an empirical benchmark of 100 independent Monte Carlo runs agree within 5.7% for keff and 1% for the fission source. The sign of the diagonal approximation's bias flips between the two statistics levels, so it must be checked case by case. With a global fixed-source FM generation strategy, the diagonal, resampling, and independent-run estimators agree within about 2% and lie roughly 10% below the full-covariance estimate, a gap attributed to covariance sampling noise. The large off-diagonal covariance is nearly symmetric and mostly cancels when propagated, rather than being small or negative as previously assumed. For the FM control-rod interpolation and combination strategy (FM-CRd), keff matches an exact perturbed reference within 60 pcm (about two standard deviations) and the fission source within 0.7%, while the diagonal and resampling estimators agree closely and are conservative by about a factor of two. Given this and the prohibitive memory cost of the full covariance, the diagonal Delta method is recommended as the practical default, with the full covariance reserved for one-time characterization of a system.

AI.tldr: 该文建立了裂变矩阵(FM)方法中蒙特卡洛统计不确定度传播的全协方差Delta方法框架，并与对角协方差近似及重采样法对比，验证了keff与裂变源的不确定度估计。
AI.motivation: FM方法基于预先计算的蒙特卡洛系数数据库进行快速插值计算，但此前对蒙特卡洛统计不确定度向FM特征值与特征向量的传播很少严格处理——既有方法假设系数相互独立，却未用实际协方差加以检验。
AI.method: 推导了向keff和裂变源传播不确定度的全协方差Delta方法框架，并以两种更廉价的替代方案（对角协方差近似与FM系数直接重采样）进行对照，采用JSI TRIGA Mark-II反应堆的OpenMC模型开展评估。
AI.result: 全棒抽出情形下，三种估计量与100次独立蒙特卡洛运行的实证基准在keff上一致到5.7%以内、裂变源上一致到1%以内；对角近似的偏差符号在两个统计量层级间发生翻转，需逐案检查。采用全局固定源FM生成策略时，对角、重采样与独立运行估计量一致到约2%以内，但比全协方差估计低约10%，归因于协方差采样噪声。非对角协方差大且近似对称，传播时大部分相互抵消，而非先前假设的小或为负。对FM控制棒插值组合策略(FM-CRd)，keff与精确扰动参考在60 pcm（约两个标准差）内吻合，裂变源在0.7%内，对角与重采样估计量吻合良好且保守约两倍。
AI.conclusion: 鉴于全协方差内存开销过高，推荐将对角Delta方法作为实用默认选择，全协方差则保留用于系统的一次性表征。

title: Reversibility and Multiplicity in Liquid-Vapor Phase Change
summary: Using diffuse-interface theory, we uncover unexpected phase-change phenomena that are absent from widely used models of evaporation and condensation. In the inviscid limit, the same adjacent thermodynamic states admit stationary evaporation and condensation with equal and opposite mass fluxes, even when the vapor pressure lies below saturation. Viscosity breaks this reversibility but gives rise to multiple stationary condensation rates for the same vapor state. Lattice Boltzmann simulations dynamically recover these states, showing that these phenomena are dynamically realized by the diffuse-interface equations rather than arising solely as mathematical solutions of the reduced interfacial relations. Our results reveal previously unexplored behavior in a well-established theory of liquid--vapor interfaces.

AI.tldr: 该文基于扩散界面理论研究蒸发与凝结，揭示了经典模型中未出现的相变现象。
AI.motivation: 广泛使用的蒸发与凝结模型可能遗漏了液-气界面的重要物理行为，作者希望检验扩散界面理论框架下是否存在被忽略的相变现象。
AI.method: 采用扩散界面理论进行理论分析，并结合格子Boltzmann模拟进行动力学验证，分别考察无粘极限与含粘性情形。
AI.result: 无粘极限下，相邻热力学状态可同时支持质量通量相等且相反的定常蒸发与凝结，即使蒸气压低于饱和值；粘性破坏该可逆性，但使同一蒸气状态对应多个定常凝结速率。格子Boltzmann模拟动态再现了这些状态，表明其由扩散界面方程动力学实现，而非仅是简化界面关系的数学解。
AI.conclusion: 研究在成熟的液-气界面理论中揭示了此前未探索的行为，提示传统蒸发凝结模型存在局限。

title: Eigenfunction asymptotics and nodal domain estimates for dumbbell domains
summary: We study the nodal structure of Neumann eigenfunctions on planar dumbbell domains as the width of the neck joining two fixed end domains tends to zero. Under simplicity and non-degeneracy assumptions, we show that sufficiently thin necks force an increasing number of nodal domains as the limiting eigenvalue grows. At the bottom of the spectrum this forcing can attain Courant's upper bound: in particular, the third Neumann eigenfunction has exactly three nodal domains and is Courant sharp. At the same time, nodal deficiency of an eigenfunction on an end domain can persist on the full dumbbell, giving eigenfunctions that are not Courant sharp. The main analytic difficulty is that the singular limit may vanish on one or both end domains even though these regions contribute nodal domains for every positive neck width. We overcome this by deriving refined asymptotics for the first nonzero profiles on the vanishing regions, expressed through Neumann Green's functions with poles at the neck attachment points and obtained by a two-dimensional matched asymptotic analysis with logarithmic terms.

AI.tldr: 研究平面哑铃域上Neumann特征函数的节点结构，当连接两固定端域的颈部宽度趋于零时，在简单性与非退化假设下，细颈会迫使节点域数量随极限特征值增长；低端谱处可达到Courant上界，第三Neumann特征函数恰有三个节点域且为Courant sharp，同时端域上的节点亏格可延续到整个哑铃域。
AI.motivation: 作者希望理解哑铃域在颈部宽度趋于零的奇异极限下Neumann特征函数的节点结构如何变化，特别是细颈对节点域数量的强制效应，以及Courant sharp性质能否保持或丧失。核心困难在于奇异极限可能在某一端或两端域上消失，而这些区域对任意正颈部宽度都贡献节点域。
AI.method: 采用二维匹配渐近分析（matched asymptotic analysis），处理含对数项的展开，推导消失区域上首个非零剖面的精细渐近式，并用颈部附着点处带极点的Neumann Green函数表达。分析基于简单性与非退化假设，考察颈部宽度趋于零的奇异极限。
AI.result: 在足够细的颈部下，节点域数量随极限特征值增长而被强制增加；谱底部该强制可达Courant上界，第三Neumann特征函数恰有三个节点域且为Courant sharp；端域特征函数的节点亏格可在完整哑铃域上延续，从而产生非Courant sharp的特征函数。
AI.conclusion: 细颈对Neumann特征函数节点结构具有显著的强制效应，低端谱可实现Courant sharp性，而端域的节点亏格亦可持续存在，表明Courant sharp性并非普遍成立。所发展的含对数项的匹配渐近方法与Neumann Green函数刻画，为处理奇异极限中节点域消失的困难提供了有效工具。

title: Applications of the Lorentz positive cone in nonconvex quadratic optimization
summary: We consider the Lorentz positive cone of $n\times m$ matrices that map the Lorentz cone in $\Rbb^m$ into the Lorentz cone in $\Rbb^n$. The Lorentz positive cone and its dual, the cone of Lorentz separable matrices, are shown to provide polynomial-time algorithms for the problem of minimizing a bilinear objective over variables contained in ellipsoids in $\Rbb^n$ and $\Rbb^m$. We also demonstrate how these cones can be used to strengthen SDP relaxations of other nonconvex quadratic optimization problems, including the two-trust-region subproblem.

AI.tldr: 研究Lorentz正锥（保持Lorentz锥的矩阵集合）及其对偶（Lorentz可分矩阵锥），证明二者可为椭球约束下的双线性目标极小化问题提供多项式时间算法，并可用于加强其他非凸二次优化问题（如双信赖域子问题）的SDP松弛。
AI.motivation: 非凸二次优化问题（如含椭球变量的双线性极小化、双信赖域子问题）通常难以求解或SDP松弛不够紧，需要新的凸锥结构来刻画可行集并给出更强、仍可高效计算的松弛。
AI.method: 定义并研究Lorentz正锥——将R^m中Lorentz锥映射到R^n中Lorentz锥的n×m矩阵集合，及其对偶锥（Lorentz可分矩阵锥）；利用这两个锥的凸性与可计算性设计多项式时间算法，并将其嵌入非凸二次优化问题的SDP松弛中。
AI.result: Lorentz正锥与其对偶（Lorentz可分矩阵锥）能够为椭球变量上的双线性目标极小化提供多项式时间算法；同时可有效加强其他非凸二次优化问题的SDP松弛，包括双信赖域子问题。
AI.conclusion: Lorentz正锥和Lorentz可分矩阵锥是一类具有良好计算性质的凸锥，可作为统一工具用于求解与加强含椭球约束的非凸二次优化问题。

title: Bridging Stochastic Flow Maps and Boltzmann Generators with Normalizing Flows
summary: Generating independent, equilibrium samples of molecular systems at scale remains a central obstacle in computational statistical mechanics. Boltzmann Generators address this by pairing a generative model with importance sampling to obtain consistent samples from the target distribution. We introduce Normalizing Flow Flow Maps (NF$^2$M), which combines the strengths of recent stochastic flow maps with the tractability of classic normalizing flows to build a Boltzmann Generator. Unlike most methods, which correct the generative model only at the end, NF$^2$M reweighs each denoising transition as generation proceeds, avoiding wasted compute on trajectories that are ultimately discarded. At each denoising step, a conditional normalizing flow proposes clean configurations given the current noisy state (a simpler task than sampling directly from the target) and its exact likelihood enables correcting each proposal toward the true denoising transition of the target Boltzmann distribution. This is in contrast to most existing methods, whose likelihoods are approximate or expensive to evaluate, undermining the statistical reliability of the correction. We establish consistency of the corrected transitions and bound how approximation errors propagate through the sampling chain. We evaluate NF$^2$M on peptide systems, demonstrating improved sampling efficiency and sample quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Normalizing Flow Flow Maps (NF²M)，将随机流映射与规范化流的可解析似然结合，构建 Boltzmann Generator。其核心是在每个去噪步骤用条件规范化流提出干净构型，并利用精确似然对每一步转移进行重要性重加权，避免在最终被丢弃的轨迹上浪费计算。作者证明了修正转移的一致性并界定了误差传播，在肽体系上验证了采样效率与样本质量的提升。
AI.motivation: 在计算统计力学中，大规模生成分子体系的独立且处于平衡态的样本仍是核心难题。现有 Boltzmann Generator 类方法（如基于扩散/流映射的方法）通常只在生成末端对生成模型做一次修正，导致大量最终被丢弃的轨迹浪费计算；且多数方法的似然是近似或计算昂贵的，削弱了修正的统计可靠性。
AI.method: 提出 NF²M：将近期随机流映射的优势与经典规范化流的可解析性结合，用作 Boltzmann Generator。在每个去噪步骤，用一个条件规范化流在当前含噪状态下提出干净构型（比直接从目标分布采样更简单），借助其精确似然，将每个提议修正到目标 Boltzmann 分布的真实去噪转移。与多数仅在末端修正的方法不同，NF²M 在生成过程中对每个去噪转移逐步重加权。理论上证明了修正转移的一致性，并界定了近似误差在采样链中的传播。
AI.result: 在肽（peptide）体系上进行评估，结果显示 NF²M 在采样效率和样本质量上均有提升。理论层面给出了修正转移的一致性证明及误差传播的界。
AI.conclusion: NF²M 通过在去噪链中逐步进行精确似然修正，避免了无效计算，保证了统计可靠性，为大规模生成平衡态分子样本提供了一种兼顾效率与准确性的 Boltzmann Generator 新范式。

title: Rare but stable: hidden states in the 1D swarmalator model
summary: The one-dimensional swarmalator model is usually understood through three macroscopic states: synchrony, the phase wave, and asynchrony. We show that the identical model also contains a much larger set of hidden stable equilibria - families of q-twisted and m-clustered states - which random initial conditions almost never reach, because many are embedded in a degenerate neutral manifold of vanishing global basin. They are nonetheless locally robust: under Gaussian perturbations of per-coordinate amplitude ε their survival radii shrink only algebraically, as 1/q and 1/m, in sharp contrast to the Gaussian basins and winding ceiling of twisted states on a nearest-neighbour Kuramoto ring, both removed by mean-field coupling. A block-circulant Jacobian fixes the stability in closed form, and far-kick experiments indicate the basins are compact cores rather than tentacled sets. Several patterns reported in extended swarmalator models thus already exist, stable or neutrally stable, in the minimal one.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了一维 swarmalator 模型，除已知的同步、相位波和异步三态外，还揭示出一大类隐藏的稳定平衡态——q-扭转态与 m-聚集态。这些态因嵌入退化的中性流形、全局吸引盆近乎消失，随机初值几乎无法到达，但在高斯扰动下具有局部鲁棒性，其存续半径仅按 1/q 和 1/m 代数式收缩。
AI.motivation: 一维 swarmalator 模型长期被理解为仅含同步、相位波和异步三种宏观态。作者希望探究这一最小模型是否还隐藏着其他平衡态，以及这些态的稳定性与可达性，从而厘清最小模型与扩展模型之间的关系。
AI.method: 利用块循环（block-circulant）Jacobi 矩阵以闭式形式确定稳定性；通过高斯扰动（每个坐标幅度为 ε）考察态的存续半径；并采用远踢（far-kick）实验探测吸引盆的几何结构。
AI.result: 模型包含大量隐藏的稳定平衡态，即 q-扭转与 m-聚集态族；随机初值几乎无法到达，因其嵌入退化的中性流形、全局吸引盆消失。这些态在局部仍稳健：高斯扰动下存续半径仅按 1/q 与 1/m 代数式收缩，与最近邻 Kuramoto 环上扭转态的高斯吸引盆和缠绕上限（均被平均场耦合消除）形成鲜明对比。远踢实验表明吸引盆是紧凑核心而非触须状集合。
AI.conclusion: 扩展 swarmalator 模型中报道的若干模式，实际上已稳定或中性稳定地存在于最小一维模型中。

title: Finite-Data Error Bounds for Approximating the Koopman Operator: Sampling Measures, Super-Polynomial Convergence and Regularization
summary: The Koopman operator is a well-established framework for lifting nonlinear dynamical systems to an infinite-dimensional space where dynamics are linear. Extended Dynamic Mode Decomposition (EDMD) is a widely used method in data-driven dynamics as it provides a Galerkin approximation of the Koopman operator on the finite-dimensional span of a prescribed dictionary of observable functions. In particular, EDMD only requires samples from the dynamical system, describing the Koopman operator without knowledge of the underlying dynamics. While many studies analyze asymptotic convergence results for EDMD in terms of data, the question of more practical finite-data convergence results remains incomplete in general settings. In this work, we prove bounds for the finite-data EDMD Galerkin approximation of the Koopman operator by a rate proportional to the inverse of the root of the number of samples (the Monte Carlo rate). These results apply to multiple classes of problems, i.e., for discrete or continuous dynamics, including stochastic systems. In certain more structured setting, we demonstrate super-polynomial rates are achievable both theoretically and computationally. Finally, we derive recovery guarantees for an EDMD variant in the undersampled regime inspired by compressed sensing techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文针对EDMD的有限数据收敛性给出蒙特卡洛速率误差界，并涵盖离散/连续/随机系统及欠采样恢复。
AI.motivation: EDMD仅依赖系统采样即可近似Koopman算子，但现有研究多关注数据量趋于无穷时的渐近收敛，通用设定下的有限数据收敛性仍不完整，缺乏实用误差界。
AI.method: 将非线性动力学提升到无穷维线性空间的Koopman框架下，分析在观测函数字典有限维张成空间上的Galerkin近似；通过有限样本误差分析推导收敛速率，并借助压缩感知思想设计EDMD变体以处理欠采样情形。
AI.result: 证明了有限数据下EDMD Galerkin近似的误差界与样本数平方根成反比（蒙特卡洛速率）；结果适用于离散、连续及随机动力学等多类问题；在更结构化的设定中从理论与计算两方面展示了可达到超多项式速率；并在欠采样情形下给出EDMD变体的恢复保证。
AI.conclusion: EDMD在有限数据下具有蒙特卡洛型收敛保障，结构化问题可进一步提升至超多项式速率，且结合压缩感知可在欠采样下实现恢复，为数据驱动动力学分析提供更实用的理论支撑。

title: Replay in the Silent Degrees of Freedom: Continual Learning Without an Offline Phase
summary: Replay-based continual learning almost always consolidates in a dedicated offline phase or by interleaving replayed samples with the input stream, whereas brains also consolidate during wakefulness through local sleep, brief use-dependent off-periods of individual circuits. We ask whether a network trained by local, biologically constrained rules can consolidate with no offline phase at all. An isolation rule confines replay updates to hidden synapses invisible to the current input under k-winner-take-all dynamics, with optimiser state advanced only inside the mask; a refractory rotation rule makes units that have just fired sit out the next competition, widening the consolidable set; a homeostatic pressure and a relative-novelty gate decide when replay bursts fire and when rotation runs. This inverts the usual direction of non-interfering continual learning: the hidden computation on the current input is held invariant (exactly on the proven channels, and for all but 0.3% of waking samples per update elsewhere) while past memories are written into the degrees of freedom the current batch leaves unused. On class-incremental split-MNIST the system reaches 91.6+-0.3% with no offline phase, at or above the best offline-night schedule on two held-out splits, tied with DER++ and above experience replay, ER-ACE, A-GEM and unmasked local replay; in a single pass it leads DER++ (91.8% against 90.1%) while the night falls to 76.9%. The advantage is largest at small buffers and gives way to the backpropagation references at large ones; on split CIFAR-10 the system leads offline rehearsal and experience replay but trails ER-ACE and DER++. Rotation carries most of the gain; isolation adds the invariance guarantee. The mechanism is not tied to the local rule: under the same schedule a backpropagation network with k-WTA hidden layers gains from rotation, and isolation is again free on top of it.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种在k-WTA局部学习网络中、无需离线阶段即可进行经验回放的持续学习机制：通过"隔离规则"把回放更新限制在当前输入不可见的隐藏突触上（优化器状态仅在掩码内推进），并用"不应期轮换"让刚激活的单元跳过下一次竞争，从而扩大可固化自由度；结合稳态压力与相对新颖性门控决定回放与轮换时机。在split-MNIST上达到91.6±0.3%（无离线阶段），小缓冲下优于DER++、ER-ACE、A-GEM等；机制不限于局部规则，反向传播网络同样受益。
AI.motivation: 基于回放的持续学习通常依赖专门的离线阶段，或将回放样本与输入流交织，而大脑在清醒状态下也能通过局部睡眠（单个回路依赖性的短暂离线期）实现固化。作者由此提出问题：由局部、生物约束规则训练的网络能否完全无需离线阶段即完成固化。
AI.method: 提出三条机制：(1) 隔离规则（isolation）将回放更新限制在当前输入下不可见的隐藏突触，优化器状态仅在掩码内部推进；(2) 不应期轮换规则（refractory rotation）使刚发放的单元跳过一次竞争，扩大可固化集合；(3) 稳态压力与相对新颖性门控共同决定回放脉冲何时触发、轮换何时启动。该方法反转了非干扰性持续学习的常规方向：保持当前输入的隐藏计算不变（在已证明通道上精确不变，其他情况下每次更新仅影响0.3%的清醒样本），而将过去记忆写入当前批次未使用的自由度中。
AI.result: 在类增量split-MNIST上，系统在无离线阶段下达到91.6±0.3%，在两个留出划分上达到或超过最佳离线夜间调度，与DER++持平，并优于experience replay、ER-ACE、A-GEM及未掩码局部回放；单次遍历中领先DER++（91.8% vs 90.1%），而"夜间"阶段仅为76.9%。优势在小缓冲区时最明显，缓冲区增大后让位于反向传播参照方法。在split CIFAR-10上，系统优于离线rehearsal与experience replay，但落后于ER-ACE和DER++。轮换贡献了大部分增益，隔离提供了不变性保证。该机制不依赖于局部规则：在同一调度下，含k-WTA隐藏层的反向传播网络同样受益于轮换，且在其之上叠加隔离仍无额外代价。
AI.conclusion: 由局部生物约束规则训练的网络可以在完全无离线阶段的情况下实现持续学习固化，其核心在于利用当前输入未使用的隐藏自由度写入过去记忆，同时以隔离保证当前计算的不变性；轮换规则是主要增益来源，且该机制可推广至反向传播网络，表明其与具体学习规则解耦。

title: Weak positivity and weak flatness of vector bundles
summary: We study Viehweg's weak positivity for vector bundles on quasi-projective schemes over noetherian rings, including mixed characteristic. We prove that weak positivity is preserved under tensor products, symmetric powers, divided powers, and exterior powers. We introduce weakly flat bundles, generalizing numerically flat bundles, and we use them to construct an S-fundamental group scheme for normal varieties admitting a small projective compactification. We compare weak flatness with strong numerical flatness and establish analogues of the Demailly-Peternell-Schneider theorem. For smooth complex varieties admitting a small compactification, we prove that the semisimple objects in the category of weakly flat bundles are precisely the unitary flat bundles. We also show that a vector bundle equipped with an integrable algebraic connection and an invariant filtration with unitary flat quotients is weakly flat. As applications, we characterize quotients of abelian varieties in terms of weak positivity of some standard vector bundles.

AI.tldr: 本文研究拟射影概型（含混合特征）上向量丛的 Viehweg 弱正性，证明其在张量积、对称幂、除幂与外幂下保持；引入弱平坦丛并构造 S-基本群概型，建立 Demailly-Peternell-Schneider 定理的类比，并刻画阿贝尔簇的商。
AI.motivation: Viehweg 弱正性是代数几何中研究正性、紧化与模空间的核心工具，但既有理论多局限于特征零或特定基域。作者希望将弱正性推广到 noetherian 环上的拟射影概型（特别是混合特征），并借助弱平坦丛这一更弱的概念，在缺乏解析与凯勒几何工具的混合特征情形下重建基本群与数值平坦性的理论框架。
AI.method: 在 noetherian 环上的拟射影概型中定义并研究 Viehweg 弱正性，验证其在张量积、对称幂、除幂、外幂等运算下的封闭性；引入弱平坦丛（推广数值平坦丛）以构造容许小射影紧化的正规簇的 S-基本群概型；将弱平坦性与强数值平坦性进行比较，并证明 Demailly-Peternell-Schneider 型定理的类比；在光滑复簇情形下结合可积代数联络与不变滤链刻画弱平坦性。
AI.result: 弱正性在张量积、对称幂、除幂与外幂下保持；弱平坦丛构成可定义 S-基本群概型的对象类；建立弱平坦与强数值平坦的比较及 Demailly-Peternell-Schneider 定理类比；对容许小紧化的光滑复簇，弱平坦丛范畴中的半单对象恰为酉平坦丛；带可积代数联络且商为酉平坦的不变滤链的向量丛是弱平坦的；并以若干标准向量丛的弱正性刻画阿贝尔簇的商。
AI.conclusion: 弱正性与弱平坦性可在 noetherian 环、含混合特征的框架下系统建立，并足以支撑 S-基本群概型与数值平坦性理论；复情形下弱平坦的半单对象精确对应酉平坦丛，且带可积联络的滤链给出弱平坦性的判别，最终以弱正性对阿贝尔簇商作统一刻画。

title: Continuously varying exponents in the distribution of waiting times in the symmetric exclusion process on a percolation cluster
summary: We study the waiting-time distribution of hard-core interacting particles in the symmetric exclusion process on one- and two-dimensional lattices with side branches attached to each lattice site in the steady state. We use numerical simulations together with an approximate analytical treatment of particles trapped in side branches in the steady state. Such a two-dimensional carpet serves as a simplified model for trapping of a supercritical percolation cluster. At high particle densities, the system exhibits strong dynamical heterogeneity, with the distribution of logarithms of waiting times developing well-separated peaks corresponding to particles trapped at different depths from the backbone. We show that the probability that a tagged particle occupies the same position at time $t_0+t$ as at time $t_0$ decays algebraically as $t^{-ω}$, where the exponent $ω$ varies continuously with particle density for densities above a threshold value $ρ^*<1$. We also investigate the correlations between successive waiting times along the trajectory of a tagged particle.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带侧枝的对称排容过程中硬核粒子的等待时间分布，发现高密度下强动力学异质性及代数衰减规律。
AI.motivation: 理解约束几何（如带侧枝的一维/二维晶格、简化超临界渗流簇陷阱模型）中粒子输运的等待时间统计与动力学异质性。
AI.method: 对带侧枝晶格上对称排容过程的稳态，采用数值模拟结合对粒子被困于侧枝的近似解析处理。
AI.result: 高密度下出现强动力学异质性，等待时间对数分布呈现对应不同侧枝深度的分离峰；标记粒子于时刻t0与t0+t占据同一位置的概率随t按幂律衰减，指数ω在密度高于阈值ρ*<1时随密度连续变化；并考察了同一轨迹上相继等待时间的相关性。
AI.conclusion: 侧枝结构诱导的陷阱导致等待时间分布幂律衰减与连续变化的指数，揭示了此类几何中粒子输运的显著动力学异质性。

title: Isothermal walls in the compressible Navier-Stokes equations: affine entropy, ballistic energy, and entropy-stable discrete formulations
comment: 39 pages of main text, 16 pages of appendices, 11 figures
summary: We develop entropy-stable isothermal-wall conditions for the compressible Navier--Stokes equations at continuous and semi-discrete levels. For a stationary, impermeable, no-slip wall at constant positive temperature, adding total-energy density divided by wall temperature to the canonical convex entropy cancels the wall contribution without suppressing heat transfer. This affine modification preserves the entropy Hessian, relative entropy, and volume entropy production. It is proportional to total ballistic-energy density and yields a conditional $L_2$-type bound based on the initial field under the stated assumptions. Two wall formulations use a common discontinuous Galerkin discretization with the summation-by-parts property and simultaneous approximation terms. Both give zero adapted wall contribution without a penalty and a nonpositive contribution with it. The complete-residual formulation penalizes the full wall-data residual and balances fluid energy through its complete numerical wall flux. The Fourier-energy-exact formulation combines an entropy-neutral skew correction with a momentum-projected penalty so that the complete numerical outward energy flux equals the one-sided numerical Fourier heat flux at every wall node and spatial resolution. Pointwise tests verify the local identities. Manufactured-solution studies with entropy-stable interior coupling demonstrate convergence rates consistent with order $p_s+1$ in the discrete $L_2$ norm, where $p_s$ is the solution polynomial degree. Thermal-relaxation calculations verify the semi-discrete energy and adapted-entropy balances. Three-dimensional calculations demonstrate balance closure in a closed domain, convergence of curved-wall traces, and applicability to a complex supersonic separated flow.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可压缩Navier–Stokes方程的熵稳定等温壁面条件，涵盖连续与半离散层面，并通过DG-SBP-SAT离散、点态验证及多类数值算例验证其熵稳定性和收敛性。
AI.motivation: 为静止、不可渗透、无滑移且温度恒定的壁面构造既满足熵稳定性又不抑制传热的等温壁面边界条件，是保证可压缩流动数值模拟热力学一致性的关键问题。
AI.method: 在正则凸熵中加入总能量密度与壁温之比（仿射修正），该修正与总弹道能量密度成比例，抵消壁面贡献；采用具有分部求和性质的间断伽辽金离散与SAT惩罚项，构造全残差格式和傅里叶能量精确格式（熵中性斜对称修正加动量投影惩罚）。
AI.result: 仿射修正保持熵Hessian、相对熵与体积熵产生不变，并在给定假设下给出基于初始场的条件L2型界；两种壁面格式在无惩罚时壁面贡献为零、有惩罚时为非正；点态测试验证局部恒等式；人造解研究显示离散L2范数收敛率约为p_s+1；热松弛算例验证半离散能量与适应熵平衡；三维计算实现封闭域平衡闭合、曲壁迹收敛及复杂超声速分离流应用。
AI.conclusion: 该等温壁面处理在连续与半离散层面均实现熵稳定，数值上保持设计精度与平衡闭合，可推广至曲壁与复杂超声速分离流动模拟。

title: When does the moment basis matter in lattice Boltzmann methods?
summary: Whether orthogonalising the moment basis changes a central-moment lattice Boltzmann scheme is decided by the geometry of the velocity set. The basis enters the collision only through the conjugate $\mathit{T}^{-1} Λ\mathit{T}$, so two bases related by a constant matrix $\mathit{A}$ define exactly the same scheme if and only if $[Λ,\mathit{A}]_{ij}=\mathit{A}_{ij}(λ_i-λ_j)$ vanishes, and on physical states only its columns for the non-conserved moments matter. We prove that on lattices with velocities in $\{0,\pm1\}^d$ and symmetric weights orthogonalisation reaches the shear moments only through the face and body diagonals: whatever the orthogonalisation, the shear rate is free on D2Q9 and D3Q15, whereas on D3Q19 and D3Q27 the scheme changes whenever the fourth-order moments do not relax at the shear rate. On rectangular lattices, where the symmetry is broken, an independent bulk rate yields an orthogonal counterpart that does not share the transport coefficients of the published scheme, which is itself orthogonal in the inner product of the rest equilibrium up to the one relaxation entry that consistency requires. Where the formulations differ but share their hydrodynamics, a basis orthogonal in the inner product of the rest equilibrium, which guarantees linear stability at rest, was never less robust in the least stable flow direction by more than a few per cent, often much more robust, and the more accurate against a Taylor-Green DNS. Computed through the non-orthogonal transforms with a conjugated relaxation matrix, it costs at most $2\%$ more on D3Q27.

AI.tldr: 矩基正交化是否改变中心矩格子玻尔兹曼格式由速度集几何决定；在{0,±1}^d格上，正交化仅通过面/体对角线触及剪切矩，从而给出D2Q9/D3Q15与D3Q19/D3Q27的判据，并给出矩形格、稳定性与成本分析。
AI.motivation: 澄清"对矩基作正交化是否会改变中心矩格子玻尔兹曼格式"这一常见疑问，界定在何种速度集几何下正交化等价或不等价，并澄清守恒矩与非守恒矩的作用范围。
AI.method: 利用碰撞只通过共轭 T^{-1}ΛT 进入、两基由常数矩阵 A 联系时相同的充要条件 [Λ,A]_{ij}=A_{ij}(λ_i-λ_j) 为零；针对速度在{0,±1}^d、对称权重的格（含D2Q9、D3Q15、D3Q19、D3Q27）以及对称性破缺的矩形格进行解析证明，并用泰勒-格林DNS与最不稳定流向的线性稳定性及成本测试作数值对照。
AI.result: 在{0,±1}^d对称权重格上，无论怎样正交化，剪切率在D2Q9与D3Q15上自由；D3Q19与D3Q27上当四阶矩不按剪切率松弛时格式改变。矩形格上独立体粘率产生不共享已发表格式输运系数的正交对应物，而已发表格式在静止平衡内积下正交到一致性所需的那一个松弛元。在共享流体力学的情形，静止平衡内积正交基从未在最不稳定方向上比原格式差超过百分之几，往往更稳健，且对泰勒-格林DNS更精确；用非正交变换与共轭松弛矩阵实现，在D3Q27上最多多花2%。
AI.conclusion: 正交化是否改变格式取决于速度集几何：低阶格上剪切矩不受影响，高阶格上四阶松弛率成为判据；静止平衡正交基在保持流体力学时兼具更高精度与至少不劣的稳定性，代价可忽略（D3Q27≤2%）。

title: Reconstruction of Molten Pool Flow Fields from High-Speed Video Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: Molten pool flow significantly influences bead geometry, defect formation, and solidification microstructure in wire-arc directed energy deposition (DED). However, direct flow sensing remains an open challenge due to extreme temperatures, intense arc illumination, and complex flow patterns. Traditional research has relied either on computationally intensive fluid dynamics simulations, which require assumed boundary conditions and lack empirical anchoring, or on vision-based tracer particle tracking, which yields sparse, noisy, and physically unconstrained velocity estimates. This work bridges these two paradigms by reconstructing physics-constrained 2D surface flow fields from high-speed imaging of a GTAW-based wire-arc DED process under distinct flow regimes: quasi-steady convection and periodic droplet impact. The pipeline begins with homography correction to calibrate the oblique camera view, followed by dense optical flow extraction to provide raw velocity observations. For quasi-steady pools, a physics-informed neural network (PINN) reconstructs the surface velocity field by jointly enforcing data fidelity, incompressible Navier-Stokes momentum equations, no-penetration boundary conditions, and an arc-forcing prior through composite loss minimization. For pools subject to periodic droplet impact, a phase-conditioned time-dependent PINN is further developed to resolve the cyclic flow evolution throughout the impact period. This work provides a unified framework that bridges high-speed visual sensing and fluid mechanics, enabling physics-grounded flow diagnostics for wire-arc DED processes.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过高速成像结合物理约束神经网络，重建丝弧定向能量沉积(GTAW-DED)熔池的二维表面流场，覆盖准稳态对流与周期性熔滴冲击两种流态。
AI.motivation: 熔池流动显著影响焊道几何、缺陷形成与凝固组织，但极端温度、强弧光干扰及复杂流态使直接流动传感极具挑战。传统方法要么依赖需假设边界条件、缺乏实测锚定的高计算量CFD仿真，要么依赖视觉示踪粒子跟踪，得到稀疏、含噪且无物理约束的速度估计。
AI.method: 从高速成像重建物理约束的2D表面流场：先用单应性校正标定倾斜相机视角，再以稠密光流提取原始速度观测。准稳态熔池采用PINN重建表面速度场，联合施加数据保真、不可压Navier-Stokes动量方程、无穿透边界条件及电弧驱动力先验，通过复合损失最小化求解；对周期性熔滴冲击熔池，进一步提出相位条件化的时变PINN以解析冲击周期内的循环流动演化。
AI.result: 构建了统一框架，将高速视觉传感与流体力学相结合，实现基于物理的丝弧DED流场诊断，分别在准稳态对流与周期性熔滴冲击两种流态下重建出物理一致的表面速度场。
AI.conclusion: 该工作弥合了计算流体仿真与视觉示踪两大范式之间的鸿沟，为丝弧DED过程提供物理基础的流动诊断手段，具有重要的工艺监控与机理研究价值。

title: Homogenization and Long Time Behavior of Wasserstein gradient flow for McKean-Vlasov Equation
summary: We consider a McKean-Vlasov equation incorporating spatial fast oscillatory behavior into both the energetic and kinematic components of the model. The former is given in terms of a confining potential while the latter by an underlying metric. The equation is formulated as a gradient flow in the space of probability measures endowed with a Wasserstein metric. We identify the limiting dynamics which is also described as a gradient flow in an effective media. We further prove the long time exponential convergence of solutions to the invariant measure. The rate of convergence is expressed in terms of a Logarithmic Sobolev constant which is uniform in terms of the oscillatory length scale. Our approach is based on variational and functional inequalities. The homogenization result of the current paper extends the authors' previous work [GaoYip] on a linear Fokker-Planck equation to a nonlinear and nonlocal setting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在能量项（限制势）和运动学项（底层度量）中同时包含空间快速振荡的 McKean-Vlasov 方程，将其表述为 Wasserstein 度量下概率测度空间中的梯度流，识别出有效介质中的极限梯度流动力学，并证明解到不变测度的长时间指数收敛性，收敛速率由与振荡长度尺度一致的 Logarithmic Sobolev 常数刻画。
AI.motivation: 将作者此前关于线性 Fokker-Planck 方程的均匀化结果推广到非线性、非局部的 McKean-Vlasov 情形，同时处理能量和运动学两方面的快速振荡。
AI.method: 基于变分方法和函数不等式，在配备 Wasserstein 度量的概率测度空间中把方程刻画为梯度流，分析其均匀化极限并用 Logarithmic Sobolev 不等式估计收敛速率。
AI.result: 识别出由有效介质中梯度流描述的极限动力学；证明解以指数速率收敛到不变测度，且该速率所依赖的 Logarithmic Sobolev 常数关于振荡长度尺度一致。
AI.conclusion: 本文的均匀化结果将作者先前关于线性 Fokker-Planck 方程的工作 [GaoYip] 推广到了非线性非局部的 McKean-Vlasov 设定，并给出了关于振荡尺度一致的指数收敛估计。

title: Tight Convergence Bounds for the Classical Kaczmarz Method
summary: The classical method of Kaczmarz, introduced in 1937, is a textbook iterative method for solving linear systems $A x = b.$ Despite its widespread use, particularly in the context of solving inverse problems where it is commonly included in software packages within Matlab, Python, and Julia, the precise characterization of convergence has long been deemed difficult to obtain. While different bounds on convergence rates have been established, they are largely unsatisfying as they cannot explain the classical, cyclic-update method's efficient convergence in practice. In this work, we obtain a tight characterization of convergence of the classical Kaczmarz method, establishing both linear and sublinear convergence bounds. The worst-case tight (i.e., exactly attained by some instances in the considered family) bounds are expressed in terms of a fixed matrix that depends only on $A,$ but are not fully interpretable in terms of the matrix spectrum and row correlations, which had been observed to have an impact on convergence. We thus provide relaxations of these bounds that are fully expressible in terms of matrix row norms, row correlations, rank, and extremal positive singular values. The provided relaxed bounds explain one-cycle convergence in special cases where the matrix rows are all either parallel or orthogonal to each other. We further argue that the dependence on different parameters appearing in the bounds is necessary and within a small constant factor of the best attainable in the worst case. Finally, our bounds explain why the classical cyclic update is faster than the randomized one when matrix rows are weakly correlated, which is often observed in inverse problems where the cyclic method is used.

AI.tldr: 该论文对经典Kaczmarz方法（1937年提出、广泛用于求解线性系统与逆问题）的收敛性给出了紧致刻画，同时建立了线性收敛与次线性收敛的界。这些最坏情况下的紧界表示为仅依赖于矩阵A的某个固定矩阵，并进一步给出可用行范数、行相关性、秩及极端正奇异值完全表达的松弛界。
AI.motivation: 经典Kaczmarz方法虽被广泛使用（常集成于Matlab、Python、Julia软件包中用于逆问题求解），但其收敛性的精确刻画长期被认为难以获得。已有的收敛速率界大多不能令人满意，因为它们无法解释经典循环更新方法在实践中为何高效收敛。
AI.method: 作者对经典Kaczmarz方法的收敛性进行紧致刻画，同时建立线性与次线性收敛界。这些最坏情况下的紧界（即在所考虑族中可被某些实例精确达到）用仅依赖于A的固定矩阵表示；由于该形式难以用矩阵谱和行相关性直接解读，作者进一步给出可用矩阵行范数、行相关性、秩和极端正奇异值完全表达的松弛界。
AI.result: 得到的松弛界能够解释特殊情形下的一周期收敛（即矩阵各行彼此全部平行或正交时）。作者进一步论证：界中出现的各参数依赖性是必要的，且在最坏情况下与最优可达界仅相差一个小常数因子。此外，这些界解释了当矩阵行弱相关时经典循环更新比随机更新更快，这一现象在常使用循环方法的逆问题中经常被观察到。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了经典Kaczmarz方法收敛性的紧致刻画，并通过可解释的松弛界揭示了行范数、行相关性、秩与奇异值对收敛的影响，从理论上解释了循环更新在弱相关行情形下优于随机更新、以及在特定行结构下一周期收敛等实践观察到的现象。

title: Continuous-Time Trajectory Generation from Discrete Observations with Stochasticity
summary: Physical systems evolve continuously in time, yet their states are typically observed only at discrete times. Generating trajectories consistent with their probability densities from such observations therefore requires capturing the continuous-time evolution rather than only learning transition mappings between consecutive observations. We propose PhiBE-Flow, a framework that directly estimates the probability velocity field induced by the stochastic differential equation (SDE) which governs this continuous-time distributional evolution. PhiBE-Flow learns from discrete observations using a model-free approach requiring neither known SDE coefficients nor score estimation. We establish convergence guarantees for the method, accounting for both time-discretization and finite-sample errors. We evaluate PhiBE-Flow on systems of increasing complexity, from controlled stochastic numerical systems to Navier--Stokes dynamics and real-world videos. Our results show that PhiBE-Flow accurately recovers probability flows of stochastic dynamics, preserves multiscale physical statistics, and improves video generation performance over representative baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/R1fe/PhiBE-Flow.

AI.tldr: 提出PhiBE-Flow框架，直接从离散观测估计SDE诱导的概率速度场，无需已知SDE系数或得分估计，并给出收敛性保证，在随机系统、Navier-Stokes动力学及真实视频上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 物理系统在时间上连续演化，但状态通常仅在离散时刻被观测到。要从这类观测生成与概率密度一致的轨迹，必须捕捉连续时间演化，而非仅学习相邻观测间的转移映射。
AI.method: PhiBE-Flow直接估计由SDE支配的连续时间分布演化所诱导的概率速度场。该方法采用无模型（model-free）方式从离散观测中学习，既不需要已知SDE系数，也不需要进行得分估计；同时建立了兼顾时间离散化误差与有限样本误差的收敛性保证。
AI.result: 在复杂度递增的系统上评估，涵盖受控随机数值系统、Navier-Stokes动力学以及真实世界视频。结果显示，PhiBE-Flow能准确恢复随机动力学的概率流、保持多尺度物理统计特性，并在视频生成任务上优于代表性基线。
AI.conclusion: PhiBE-Flow为从离散观测中学习连续时间随机演化提供了一种无模型且具理论保证的框架，在物理动力学建模与视频生成等任务上均展现有效性。代码已开源于https://github.com/R1fe/PhiBE-Flow。

title: Global synchronization of topological signals with time-delayed interactions
summary: Topological signals are dynamical variables supported on higher-order structures such as simplicial or cell complexes. In this work, we investigate the impact of time-delayed interactions on the emergence of global synchronization of topological oscillators, with application to the Stuart-Landau system. We first examine the case where signals are supported on simplexes, or cells, of a given dimension and coupled through the Hodge-Laplace matrix. We derive the Master Stability Function and we prove that for suitable discrete delay values, the stability of the synchronous solution becomes analytically tractable and can be solved by using the Lambert W-function. This analysis yields explicit spectral conditions for Global Topological Synchronization to emerge and shows that admissible delays may either promote or suppress synchronization. We then study delayed interactions between signals supported on simplexes, or cells, of different dimensions coupled by the Dirac operator. Under analogous admissible time delays the variational problem, still related to the Master Stability Function, can again be simplified, however in this case we prove that Global Topological Dirac Synchronization cannot emerge. Numerical simulations on simplicial and cell complexes corroborate and complement these findings.

AI.tldr: 研究时延影响下拓扑振子（Stuart-Landau）全局同步：同维耦合经Hodge-Laplace矩阵可用Lambert W函数解析求解，异维经Dirac算子的全局Dirac同步不可能出现。
AI.motivation: 拓扑信号是定义于单纯复形或胞腔复形等高阶结构上的动力学变量，其全局同步机制尚需研究，且实际耦合普遍存在时间延迟，延迟对高阶结构上同步的作用缺乏解析刻画。
AI.method: 以Stuart-Landau振子为模型，分两类情形：(1) 同维单纯形/胞腔上信号经Hodge-Laplace矩阵耦合，推导Master Stability Function（主稳定函数），在特定离散时延下用Lambert W函数求解；(2) 不同维单纯形/胞腔上信号经Dirac算子耦合，在类似可容许时延下简化与MSF相关的变分问题。
AI.result: 情形(1)得到全局拓扑同步出现的显式谱条件，并证明可容许时延既可促进也可抑制同步；情形(2)证明全局拓扑Dirac同步无法涌现。在单纯复形与胞腔复形上的数值模拟验证并补充了上述结论。
AI.conclusion: 时延对高阶拓扑结构上同步的作用依赖于耦合算子：Hodge-Laplace耦合下可通过Lambert W函数给出可解析的同步判据且延迟具有双向调节作用；Dirac耦合下全局Dirac同步在可容许时延下不可实现。

title: Mapped Multi-Patch Spectral Extreme Learning Machine for Partial Differential Equations
summary: We study a fixed-feature solver, referred to as Spectral-ELM, in which Chebyshev--Gauss--Lobatto (CGL) differentiation matrices are applied to the nodal values of an extreme learning machine (ELM) trial function. Curved domains are treated using a mapped multi-patch formulation. Each curved quadrilateral patch is represented as the image of a reference square, physical derivatives are computed from the associated metric terms, and adjacent patches are coupled by enforcing continuity of the solution and its normal flux. Local QR orthogonalization is used to reduce near-linear dependence among the discrete features. The numerical study includes comparisons with direct CGL collocation, an analytically differentiated ELM, a global Random Feature Method, and a TransNet sampling strategy. It also includes a matched KdV test, a small three-dimensional example, and a Poisson problem on a curved domain containing a hole. For a smooth elliptic problem on a square, direct CGL collocation gives the smallest error. When applied to the same fixed-feature trial space, spectral and analytic differentiation produce comparable errors. For the curved-domain problem, mapped direct CGL collocation and mapped Spectral-ELM achieve similar accuracy with comparable numbers of unknowns. The present formulation is particularly well suited to smooth PDEs in one to three dimensions, where tensor-product grids enable accurate high-order discretizations, while sparse-grid and dimension-adaptive strategies offer promising directions for extension to higher-dimensional problems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究固定特征的谱极速学习机（Spectral-ELM）求解器，将CGL微分矩阵作用于ELM试探函数的节点值，并用映射多片法处理曲边区域。
AI.motivation: 探索将谱微分与固定特征（ELM/随机特征）试解空间结合的可行性，并在曲边区域上高效高精度地求解光滑偏微分方程，同时厘清谱微分与解析微分在相同试解空间下的精度差异。
AI.method: 在ELM试探函数的节点值上施加Chebyshev–Gauss–Lobatto微分矩阵；每个曲边四边形片映射为参考正方形，由度量项计算物理导数；相邻片通过解及其法向通量的连续性耦合；局部QR正交化降低离散特征间的近线性相关。对比直接CGL配点、解析微分的ELM、全局随机特征方法（RFM）以及TransNet采样策略，并测试匹配KdV问题、小规模三维算例与含孔曲边区域的Poisson问题。
AI.result: 方域光滑椭圆问题中直接CGL配点误差最小；在同一固定特征试解空间内，谱微分与解析微分误差相当；曲边区域问题上，映射直接CGL配点与映射Spectral-ELM在未知量数目相当时精度相近。
AI.conclusion: 该格式尤其适用于一至三维的光滑偏微分方程，张量积网格可实现准确的高阶离散；稀疏网格与维度自适应策略是推广到高维问题的有前景方向。

title: OMP-MoE: Efficient Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts LLMs via Orthogonal Matching Pursuit
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable efficient scaling of large language models but face critical deployment challenges due to massive memory requirements. Existing pruning methods either incur prohibitive search costs or neglect the dynamic interdependencies between experts. To address these challenges, we present OMP-MoE, a novel training-free compression framework for reducing expert redundancy in MoE-based LLMs. Based on observations of expert contribution patterns, we reformulate the pruning problem as a sparse signal reconstruction task solved through Orthogonal Matching Pursuit. Specifically, our method first treats individual expert contributions as dictionary atoms and selects experts that greedily minimize reconstruction error with linear computational complexity. Then, we optimize cross-layer expert allocation through a water-filling strategy that accounts for both reconstruction quality and routing stability. Finally, we introduce OMP-MoE†, an adaptive inference mechanism that dynamically adjusts expert activation based on energy prediction. Comprehensive experiments on Qwen, DeepSeek-V2, GPT-OSS, and Mixtral MoE demonstrate consistent improvements over existing methods at 25-50% pruning ratios. For Qwen3-30B-A3B at 50% compression, we retain 93.3% of original performance, achieving 33$\times$ faster search and 1.55$\times$ inference speedup. Codes will be available after acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练压缩框架 OMP-MoE，将专家剪枝重构为稀疏信号重建问题，用正交匹配追踪（OMP）低成本选择专家，并结合注水策略优化跨层分配与自适应推理机制，在多种 MoE 大模型上实现高效压缩与加速。
AI.motivation: MoE 模型虽能高效扩展大语言模型，但部署时内存需求巨大。现有剪枝方法要么搜索成本过高，要么忽视专家之间的动态相互依赖关系，因此需要一种低成本且能刻画专家协作关系的压缩方案。
AI.method: 1) 基于专家贡献模式观察，将剪枝问题重构为稀疏信号重建任务，用正交匹配追踪求解；2) 将单个专家贡献视为字典原子，以线性计算复杂度贪心地选择使重建误差最小的专家；3) 用注水策略优化跨层专家分配，兼顾重建质量与路由稳定性；4) 提出自适应推理机制 OMP-MoE†，基于能量预测动态调整专家激活。
AI.result: 在 Qwen、DeepSeek-V2、GPT-OSS、Mixtral 等 MoE 模型上，25%–50% 剪枝率下一致优于现有方法。Qwen3-30B-A3B 在 50% 压缩时保留 93.3% 原始性能，搜索速度提升 33 倍，推理加速 1.55 倍。
AI.conclusion: OMP-MoE 是一种免训练的 MoE 压缩框架，通过 OMP 专家选择、注水式跨层分配和自适应推理，在显著降低专家冗余的同时保持性能，并大幅降低搜索成本、提升推理效率。

title: Large automorphism groups of curves of zero $p$-rank in odd characteristic
summary: Let $\cX$ be a curve of genus $g\ge2$ and zero $p$-rank over an algebraically closed field of odd characteristic $p$. We classify the pairs $(\cX,G)$ for which $G\le\Aut(\cX)$ has no common fixed point and $|G|>24g(g-1)$. For $g\ge4$, the curves are explicit cyclic covers of the projective line, the Hermitian curve, or the Ree curve. We determine their full automorphism groups and the possible subgroups $G$, including the central extensions. The exceptional $A_7$ action in characteristic $5$ determines the Hermitian curve of degree $6$. The cases of genus $2$ and $3$ are treated separately. These results give an odd-characteristic counterpart to the classification of large automorphism groups of zero $2$-rank curves. As an application, we obtain a new characterization of the generalized Suzuki curve in which the fixed-point hypothesis is no longer required.

AI.tldr: 本文分类了奇特征域上亏格 \(g\ge2\)、\(p\)-秩为零的曲线 \(\mathcal{X}\) 及其无公共不动点且阶 \(>24g(g-1)\) 的自同构子群 \(G\)，给出了这类大自同构群曲线的完整刻画。
AI.motivation: 已有关于零 \(2\)-秩曲线大自同构群的分类，但奇特征下的对应问题尚缺。本文旨在建立奇特征的类比，并借此去掉广义 Suzuki 曲线刻画中的不动点假设。
AI.method: 设 \(\mathcal{X}\) 为奇特征代数闭域上亏格 \(g\ge2\)、\(p\)-秩为零的曲线，研究满足 \(G\le\Aut(\mathcal{X})\)、无公共不动点且 \(|G|>24g(g-1)\) 的配对 \((\mathcal{X},G)\)。对 \(g\ge4\)，将曲线归为射影直线的显式循环覆盖、Hermitian 曲线或 Ree 曲线；确定其全自同构群及允许的子群 \(G\)，包括中心扩张；并单独处理 \(g=2,3\)。特征 \(5\) 中的例外 \(A_7\) 作用对应 \(6\) 次 Hermitian 曲线。
AI.result: 分类了所有满足条件的大自同构群配对；证明 \(g\ge4\) 时曲线只能是射影直线的循环覆盖、Hermitian 曲线或 Ree 曲线，并给出其全自同构群与可能的子群（含中心扩张）。特征 \(5\) 的例外 \(A_7\) 作用确定 \(6\) 次 Hermitian 曲线；\(g=2,3\) 情形单独处理。作为应用，得到广义 Suzuki 曲线的新刻画，且无需固定点假设。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出零 \(2\)-秩曲线大自同构群分类在奇特征下的对应结果，并以此获得不依赖固定点假设的广义 Suzuki 曲线新刻画。

title: Backward Kolmogorov Transport: Sampling Invariant Laws of Reversible Diffusions from Trajectory Data
summary: We consider a reversible diffusion with unknown drift, observed through trajectories, and construct samplers of its invariant law. The trajectories contain samples of this law, but a sampler built from them by density or score estimation inherits the errors of these estimates, in particular on the barriers between metastable states. The trajectories also contain the dynamics, and for a reversible diffusion the ratio between the law of the process and its invariant law solves the backward Kolmogorov equation, so that the eigenpairs of the generator propagate it in closed form. Backward Kolmogorov transport (BKT) evaluates this ratio with eigenpairs estimated from the trajectories and coefficients computed once from the initial particles, and moves the particles along the Wasserstein gradient flow of the Kullback-Leibler divergence. The particles do not interact, BKT defines a transport map, and no density, score or drift is estimated. With exact eigenpairs BKT transports the spectral projection of the initial law exactly when this projection is positive. For estimated eigenpairs we prove a transport identity in which truncation enters only through the initial law and estimation only through the residual of the eigenpairs, and a local stability bound in the 2-Wasserstein distance. With coefficients computed from the transported particles, the sampling error of the retained modes cancels, and a central limit theorem identifies the asymptotic variance. Experiments on Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes, multi-well potentials, separable products and alanine dipeptide, including comparisons with particle methods based on density estimates, agree with these results, and with an accurate spectrum the errors of BKT reach or fall below those of independent samples.

AI.tldr: 提出后向Kolmogorov传输(BKT)方法，从轨迹估计可逆扩散生成元的特征对，直接构造不变律采样器，无需估计密度、得分或漂移。
AI.motivation: 轨迹虽含不变律样本，但基于密度或得分估计的采样器会继承估计误差，尤其在两亚稳态间的势垒处。利用可逆扩散的动力学信息（过程律与不变律之比满足后向Kolmogorov方程），可绕开这些估计。
AI.method: 由轨迹估计生成元特征对；用从初始粒子一次性计算的系数，沿KL散度的Wasserstein梯度流移动粒子，以特征对闭合传播该比值（即后向Kolmogorov传输）。粒子间无相互作用，BKT定义为一个传输映射，不估计密度、得分或漂移。
AI.result: 精确特征对下，当初始律的谱投影为正时BKT精确传输该投影；估计特征对下证明传输恒等式（截断仅经初始律进入、估计误差仅经特征对残差进入）与2-Wasserstein距离下的局部稳定性界。用传输后粒子计算系数可抵消保留模态的采样误差，并给出中心极限定理识别渐近方差。在Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程、多势阱、可分乘积与丙氨酸二肽实验（含与基于密度估计的粒子方法比较）结果一致；谱估计准确时BKT误差达到或低于独立样本的误差。
AI.conclusion: BKT提供一种无需密度/得分/漂移估计的可逆扩散不变律采样框架，误差可控（分离截断与估计影响），在准确谱下可达独立采样精度。

title: Stochastic Physics-Constrained Operator Inference for Complex Systems
summary: Quadratically nonlinear systems driven by additive noise arise throughout science and engineering, both as stochastic dynamical systems in their own right and as reduced-order models (ROMs) of turbulent flows. We propose stochastic physics-constrained operator inference (SPOpInf), a non-intrusive method that learns a stochastic differential equation, i.e., a quadratic--linear drift and a diffusion amplitude, from data. Unlike operator inference (OpInf), which fits a deterministic drift by least squares, SPOpInf maximizes an Euler--Maruyama increment likelihood in which the residual covariance is itself an unknown, so the deterministic and stochastic components are calibrated jointly; it enforces the energy-preserving quadratic structure exactly, through linear equality constraints imposed inside the optimization; and it works in an upper-triangular parametrization that removes the structural non-identifiability of the full quadratic tensor. The resulting optimization is solved by an expectation--maximization (EM)-based iterative learning algorithm that updates the drift coefficients and the noise levels in turn: each iteration requires only an inexpensive weighted least-squares solve for the drift and a residual-variance update for the noise. With five stochastic benchmark systems that show intermittency and chaos, SPOpInf recovers the deterministic operators more accurately than OpInf, satisfies the imposed constraints to machine precision, accurately estimates the noise amplitudes, and reproduces long-time statistics. Applied to a stochastic Burgers equation and a quasi-geostrophic double-gyre flow, the same estimator yields non-intrusive stochastic ROMs that remain stable over long times where unconstrained alternatives blow up.

AI.tldr: 本文提出随机物理约束算子推断（SPOpInf）：通过最大化Euler–Maruyama增量似然联合标定漂移与扩散，精确施加能量守恒二次结构约束，并用上三角参数化消除结构不可辨识性，以EM迭代求解，在随机基准与Burgers、双涡旋流中取得优于OpInf的稳定长时随机ROM。
AI.motivation: 科学工程中普遍存在受加性噪声驱动的二次非线性系统（既作为随机动力系统，也作为湍流的降阶模型ROM）。现有算子推断（OpInf）仅用最小二乘拟合确定性漂移，忽略了噪声项，导致确定性部分与随机部分无法联合标定，且全二次张量存在结构不可辨识性，长期积分易失稳。
AI.method: 提出SPOpInf（随机物理约束算子推断）——一种非侵入式方法，从数据中学习随机微分方程（二次–线性漂移加扩散幅值）。核心做法：1）最大化Euler–Maruyama增量似然，将残差协方差视为未知量，从而联合标定确定性漂移与随机噪声；2）在优化内部施加线性等式约束，精确保证能量守恒的二次结构；3）采用上三角参数化，消除全二次张量的结构性不可辨识。优化通过基于期望最大化（EM）的迭代学习求解，交替更新漂移系数与噪声水平，每次迭代仅需一次廉价的加权最小二乘求解（漂移）与一次残差方差更新（噪声）。
AI.result: 在五个呈现间歇性与混沌的随机基准系统上：SPOpInf比OpInf更准确地恢复确定性算子，施加的约束满足到机器精度，噪声幅值估计准确，并能重现长期统计特性。在随机Burgers方程与准地转双涡旋流上，同一估计器给出非侵入式随机ROM，在长期保持稳定，而无约束的替代方法会发散。
AI.conclusion: SPOpInf是一种非侵入式数据驱动框架，可同时学习二次–线性漂移与扩散幅值，在不牺牲物理结构的前提下实现确定性/随机成分联合标定，适用于稳定长时随机降阶建模，可推广至湍流类复杂流动。

title: A deterministic Fokker--Planck/lattice-Boltzmann micro--macro solver for dilute Hookean polymer solutions
summary: Deterministic micro--macro simulation of polymer solutions requires the coupled evolution and spatial transport of a configuration distribution, together with the conversion of its moments into macroscopic stress and feedback to the flow. We develop a Fokker--Planck/lattice-Boltzmann solver for this coupling in two-dimensional dilute Hookean polymer solutions. The solver represents the distribution on the unbounded configuration space by Hermite coefficient fields, advances local configuration dynamics and physical-space transport in separate steps, and recovers Kramers stress from the second moment to achieve two-way coupling with a purified two-relaxation-time lattice-Boltzmann flow solver. To assess whether this configuration description recovers the corresponding macroscopic response, we use the exact second-moment closure of the continuous Hookean model as a macroscopic reference for comparison with analytical and independently discretized macroscopic solutions. The calculations reproduce velocity overshoot and damped oscillations in start-up Poiseuille flow, with velocity profiles approaching the analytical start-up transient under grid refinement; in four-roll flow with spatially nonuniform extension and stress feedback, the maximum full-domain relative differences in velocity and polymer stress are approximately $0.0309\%$ and $3.84\%$, respectively, over the tested Weissenberg numbers at corresponding sampling times. These comparisons support the solver's ability to recover the Hookean macroscopic response from configuration-distribution evolution. Further calculations of wall-bounded recirculation and open cross-slot flow exhibit the corresponding conformation responses and symmetric and asymmetric flow states, extending this deterministic micro--macro method to viscoelastic flows under different boundary constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出一种Fokker-Planck/格子Boltzmann求解器，用于二维稀薄Hookean聚合物溶液的确定性微观-宏观模拟，实现构型分布演化与流动的双向耦合。
AI.motivation: 确定性微观-宏观模拟聚合物溶液需要构型分布及其空间输运的耦合演化，同时需要将分布矩转化为宏观应力并反馈给流场，因此需要发展能够忠实再现宏观响应的数值方法。
AI.method: 在无界构型空间上以Hermite系数场表示分布函数，将局部构型动力学与物理空间输运分步推进；由二阶矩恢复Kramers应力，与纯化的双松弛时间（two-relaxation-time）格子Boltzmann流动求解器实现双向耦合。以连续Hookean模型的精确二阶矩封闭作为宏观参照进行对比验证。
AI.result: 在启动Poiseuille流中复现速度过冲与阻尼振荡，速度剖面随网格加密趋近解析启动瞬态；在具有空间非均匀拉伸和应力反馈的四辊流中，所测Weissenberg数及对应采样时刻下速度与聚合物应力的全域最大相对差异分别约为0.0309%与3.84%。此外，壁面约束再循环流与开放十字槽流计算显示了相应的构象响应以及对称与非对称流态。
AI.conclusion: 该求解器能够从构型分布演化中恢复Hookean宏观响应，并将确定性微观-宏观方法推广至不同边界约束下的粘弹性流动。

title: A Fourier approach to the sharp stability of Heisenberg Uncertainty Principles of higher and fractional orders: a new perspective
summary: We show that, on the Fourier side, the sharp second order Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle (HUP) and its sharp stability for functions are nothing but the first order $L^{2}$-Caffarelli--Kohn--Nirenberg inequality and its sharp stability, applied to their Fourier transforms. This gives a proof in a few lines of the sharp stability estimate that we established recently by a much longer argument. The same observation then produces two one-parameter families of sharp fractional Heisenberg Uncertainty Principles, in which the gradient is replaced by a fractional power of the Laplacian: for each of them we compute the sharp constants, characterize all the optimizers, and establish the sharp stability estimates. The stability constant of the first family is equal to $1$ for every nonnegative order and every dimension. Negative orders, where the fractional Laplacian becomes a Riesz potential, are treated as well. Finally, we show that the deficit carries much more information than the distance to the optimizers alone: it controls an explicit chain of successive remainder terms whose constants are the successive spectral gaps of an explicit operator. For the classical Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle this gives three remainder terms with optimal explicit constants, and for the second order HUP a chain of four remainder terms measured against explicit confluent hypergeometric profiles and coupled through one single set of parameters. As applications, we also establish the chain of stability of the HUP for curl-free vector fields.

AI.tldr: 该文揭示了Fourier侧的二阶Heisenberg不确定性原理(HUP)及其sharp稳定性等价于对Fourier变换应用一阶$L^2$-Caffarelli--Kohn--Nirenberg不等式及其sharp稳定性，从而给出原长证明的简短新证，并由此构造两族含参数的分式阶HUP，计算sharp常数、刻画优化元、建立sharp稳定性，且证明deficit可控制一链余项。
AI.motivation: 作者此前用冗长论证建立了二阶HUP的sharp稳定性估计，本文希望寻找更本质、更简短的证明机制，并将该机制推广到更一般的分式阶HUP，同时挖掘deficit所蕴含的远超"到优化元距离"的信息。
AI.method: 核心方法是Fourier变换：将二阶HUP及其稳定性转化为Fourier侧的一阶$L^2$-Caffarelli--Kohn--Nirenberg不等式及其sharp稳定性；据此构造两族单参数sharp分式HUP（梯度替换为Laplacian的分式幂），逐族求sharp常数、刻画全部优化元并建立sharp稳定性；负阶情形（分式Laplacian退化为Riesz位势）亦作处理；并用deficit展开余项链，考察其常数与某显式算子谱隙的关系。
AI.result: 给出原sharp稳定性估计的几行简短证明；构造出两族单参数sharp分式HUP，得到其sharp常数、全部优化元与sharp稳定性估计；第一族的稳定性常数对任意非负阶和任意维数均等于1；对经典HUP得到三个余项及其最优显式常数；对二阶HUP得到四个余项构成的链，以显式合流超几何剖面度量并由单一参数组耦合；并建立curl-free向量场HUP的稳定性链。
AI.conclusion: 二阶HUP的sharp稳定性本质上是Fourier侧一阶CKN不等式的稳定性，这一等价性带来统一而简洁的处理框架，并自然推广出多族sharp分式HUP及稳定的余项链结构；deficit比单纯的优化元距离携带更多信息，可控制一系列常数由显式算子谱隙给出的余项。

title: An Efficient iLQR Algorithm for Optimal Control with Bounded States and Inputs: Application to Spacecraft Maneuvers
summary: This paper presents a constrained iterative Linear Quadratic Regulator (Box-iLQR) method for nonlinear aerospace optimal-control problems with bounded states and controls. Logarithmic barrier functions are used with a two-fold objective: the barrier parameter is reduced toward zero to recover the constrained optimal trajectory, while a finite barrier is retained to construct a smooth, constraint-aware feedback policy for closed-loop operation. The method is demonstrated on spacecraft attitude control, a minimum-fuel planar orbit transfer, and an L2 to L2 halo-orbit transfer. Box-iLQR respects the imposed constraints and produces nominal trajectories together with time-varying feedback policies. Closed-loop simulations under disturbance, measurement noise, and control uncertainty show substantial reductions in terminal error. These results demonstrate that Box-iLQR provides both high-accuracy constrained trajectory optimization and practical constraint-aware feedback within a single framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Box-iLQR 方法，用对数障碍函数处理带状态与控制约束的非线性航天器最优控制问题，兼具约束轨迹优化与约束感知反馈能力。
AI.motivation: 非线性航天器最优控制常带状态与控制边界约束，传统 iLQR 难以直接处理约束，且通常只输出开环标称轨迹，缺乏实用的闭环反馈策略。
AI.method: 采用对数障碍函数并发挥双重作用：一是将障碍参数逐步趋零以恢复约束最优轨迹，二是保留有限障碍参数以构造平滑、约束感知的反馈策略。该方法称为 Box-iLQR（约束型迭代 LQR）。
AI.result: 在航天器姿态控制、最小燃料平面轨道转移以及 L2 到 L2 晕轨道转移三个算例上验证；Box-iLQR 满足所施加约束，同时给出标称轨迹与时变反馈策略。在扰动、量测噪声和控制不确定性下的闭环仿真显示终端误差显著降低。
AI.conclusion: Box-iLQR 在单一框架内同时实现了高精度约束轨迹优化与实用的约束感知反馈，适用于带边界约束的非线性航天器最优控制。

title: A Unified Optimism-Agnostic Framework for Linear Bandits over Spherical Action Sets
summary: Linear bandits model sequential decision-making problems with noisy rewards that are linear in the decision variable, where an agent must simultaneously learn about an unknown parameter that governs the mean rewards, while maximizing (expected) rewards over time. Two prominent algorithmic families--upper confidence bound (UCB) and Thompson sampling (TS)--achieve a balance of exploration (to estimate said parameter) and exploitation (utilization of knowledge about it) across time. The quality of estimation of that parameter depends on the eigenvalues of a design matrix. In this paper, we begin by showing that if the inference quality obtained from exploration, encoded in the minimum eigenvalue of the design matrix, grows $\gtrsim \sqrt{t}$ with time $t$, while actions remain sufficiently concentrated for exploitation, then an algorithm produces optimal high-probability $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T}\log T)$-regret rate over a time-horizon $T$ for spherical action sets. This analysis is algorithm-agnostic and follows an alternative route to the classical optimism-based elliptical-potential argument for regret analysis. Then, we illustrate that variants of UCB and TS satisfy the inference and concentration properties and in turn, enjoy optimal regret rate. In effect, our results provide a modular framework that can be used to analyze linear bandit algorithms and explicitly connect quality of parameter estimation to optimal regret accumulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个与算法无关的模块化框架，通过设计矩阵最小特征值的增长（≳√t）与动作集中性两个条件，将线性赌博机中参数估计质量与最优O(√T log T)遗憾率显式联系起来，并说明UCB与TS的变体均满足这些条件。
AI.motivation: 线性赌博机中，智能体需在未知参数下同时学习与最大化奖励，UCB和TS虽能平衡探索与利用，但参数估计质量与最优遗憾之间的显式理论联系尚不清晰。本文旨在建立一种与算法无关的分析路径，明确参数估计质量如何决定遗憾累积。
AI.method: 首先证明：若探索带来的推断质量（以设计矩阵最小特征值编码）随时间t以≳√t增长，且动作保持足够集中以用于利用，则算法在球形动作集上可达最优高概率O(√T log T)遗憾率；该分析不依赖具体算法，提供了一条不同于经典乐观-椭圆势论证的路径。随后说明UCB与TS的变体满足上述推断与集中性质。
AI.result: 在球形动作集、时间horizon T下，满足最小特征值≳√t增长与动作集中性条件的算法可获得最优高概率O(√T log T)遗憾率；UCB和TS的变体被证明满足这些条件，因而同样享有最优遗憾率。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个可用于分析线性赌博机算法的模块化框架，显式地将参数估计质量与最优遗憾累积联系起来，并统一解释了UCB与TS变体的最优性。

title: Criticality without Temperature in an Ising Spin System
summary: Criticality in the Ising model is conventionally generated by Hamiltonian dynamics and controlled by temperature. Here we show that critical like behavior can emerge in an Ising system whose dynamics is completely independent of the Ising Hamiltonian and contains no temperature like parameter. We introduce an adaptive cluster dynamics in which spin connectivity is controlled by a local quiet time variable, the time elapsed since a spin was last updated. The Ising Hamiltonian enters only as an observable characterizing the resulting configurations. As the parameter $α$, controlling the connectivity strength, is varied, the system undergoes spontaneous symmetry breaking accompanied by strong collective fluctuations. The cluster size distribution develops an extended power law regime, terminated by a small finite size hump at the largest scales, while the Ising energy exhibits a singular response to the variation of $α$. These results show that memory dependent connectivity alone can generate collective critical behavior, revealing a route to nonequilibrium criticality without energy based dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自适应团簇动力学，其自旋连通性由局部"静止时间"（自旋距上次更新经过的时间）控制，动力学完全独立于Ising哈密顿量且不含类温度参数。随连通强度参数α变化，系统发生自发对称破缺并伴随强集体涨落：团簇尺寸分布出现扩展幂律区并终止于大尺度上的有限尺寸小峰，Ising能量对α呈现奇异响应，表明仅靠记忆依赖的连通性即可产生集体临界行为。
AI.motivation: 传统Ising模型的临界性由哈密顿动力学产生并由温度调控。作者希望探究：临界行为是否必须依赖能量驱动的动力学与类温度控制参数，还是可以仅由与哈密顿量无关的、无温度的动力学机制自发涌现，从而开辟非平衡临界性的新路径。
AI.method: 引入自适应团簇动力学，用局部"静止时间"变量（自旋自上次更新以来经过的时间）来控制自旋间的连通性。Ising哈密顿量不参与动力学演化，仅作为刻画所生成构型的可观测量。通过调节控制连通强度的参数α来扫描系统行为。
AI.result: 随α变化，系统出现自发对称破缺及强烈的集体涨落；团簇尺寸分布形成扩展的幂律区，并在最大尺度处以小的有限尺寸峰终止；Ising能量对α的变化表现出奇异响应。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭记忆依赖的连通性即可产生集体临界行为，揭示了一条无需能量驱动动力学即可实现非平衡临界性的途径。

title: Accurate Density of States Estimation: A Comparative Study
summary: We study density of states (DOS) estimation for large sparse real symmetric matrices by fitting the cumulative density of states (CDOS) and differentiating the fit. We use a stochastic Lanczos method to supply Ritz values and weights, which we average across Lanczos runs to construct CDOS midpoint data. Monotone piecewise-cubic interpolation of these data yields a smooth CDOS approximation that can be easily differentiated to yield a nonnegative, normalized, piecewise-quadratic DOS without requiring a Gaussian smoothing with a fixed bandwidth in its construction. We also consider approximating CDOS by using Gaussian-process regression (GPR) with single- and double-Gaussian covariance kernels, yielding an approximation with uncertainty information. DOS approximation is then obtained by analytic derivative of the GPR-based CDOS. Experiments on matrices from diverse scientific applications are performed to compare these estimators with Gaussian-broadened stochastic Lanczos and Jackson-damped kernel polynomial approximations. At a common Gaussian validation resolution, we use error measures that assess local discrepancies, integrated errors, and agreement in the overall spectral shape. The results demonstrate that the midpoint spline can produce accurate approximations to the DOS with relatively few matrix--vector products, supporting the use of cumulative interpolation as a practical DOS estimation.

AI.tldr: 通过拟合累积态密度(CDOS)再微分来估计大型稀疏实对称矩阵的态密度(DOS)，提出单调分段三次样条与高斯过程回归两种方法，实验表明其精度高、所需矩阵-向量乘积少。
AI.motivation: 大型稀疏实对称矩阵的DOS估计中，传统方法（如高斯展宽随机Lanczos、Jackson阻尼Kernel多项式）需依赖固定带宽的高斯平滑，构造上受带宽选择限制，作者希望寻找无需固定带宽平滑、更实用的DOS估计途径。
AI.method: 用随机Lanczos方法提供Ritz值与权重，跨Lanczos运行平均后构造CDOS中点数据；对数据做单调分段三次插值得到光滑CDOS近似，再微分得到非负、归一化的分段二次DOS；另用带单/双高斯协方差核的高斯过程回归(GPR)拟合CDOS，通过解析导数获得DOS近似并附带不确定性信息。
AI.result: 在来自多种科学应用的矩阵上与高斯展宽随机Lanczos及Jackson阻尼Kernel多项式近似对比，在统一高斯验证分辨率下用局部偏差、积分误差和整体谱形一致性等指标评估，中点样条方法以较少的矩阵-向量乘积即可获得高精度DOS近似。
AI.conclusion: 累积插值（尤其是中点样条）是一种实用且高效的DOS估计方法，无需固定带宽高斯平滑即可得到准确近似，支持将累积插值作为实际DOS估计手段。

title: EEGAgentBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Short- and Long-Horizon EEG Analysis
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis is evolving from short-segment classification toward long-horizon interpretation that demands iterative evidence accumulation, multi-step reasoning, and coordinated use of specialized signal-processing tools. Although large language models (LLMs) have recently shown promise as autonomous agents for EEG analysis, existing EEG agentic evaluations remain fragmented, covering limited tasks over narrow temporal horizons with inconsistent protocols, and providing no comprehensive assessment of agents' reasoning, tool-use, and workflow construction capabilities. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{EEGAgentBench}, a unified benchmark for systematically evaluating LLM agents on short- and long-horizon EEG analysis. EEGAgentBench spans six representative EEG applications ranging from knowledge question answering to sleep staging. It encompasses signal durations from 2 seconds to nearly 23 hours, with prediction targets ranging from class labels to event intervals and epoch-level sequences. This design supports unified evaluation across knowledge reasoning, short-horizon interpretation, long-horizon event detection, and sequential understanding. The benchmark further provides 10 deterministic EEG analysis tools that expose only task-relevant signal measurements. Agents must therefore select tools autonomously, accumulate evidence iteratively, and construct multi-step workflows. For evaluation, we benchmark 29 frontier LLMs from 15 model families. Results demonstrate that EEGAgentBench effectively distinguishes agent capabilities beyond model scale and inference cost, while revealing substantial limitations of current LLM agents in long-horizon EEG analysis, particularly in sustained evidence accumulation and multi-step reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 EEGAgentBench，一个统一评估 LLM 智能体在短时段与长时段 EEG 分析能力的基准，覆盖六类任务、2 秒至近 23 小时的信号时长，并提供 10 个确定性 EEG 分析工具。
AI.motivation: EEG 分析正从短片段分类转向需要迭代证据积累、多步推理与多工具协同的长时段解读；现有 EEG 智能体评测碎片化，任务有限、时间跨度窄、协议不一致，且缺乏对推理、工具使用与工作流构建能力的全面评估。
AI.method: 构建 EEGAgentBench 统一基准，涵盖从知识问答到睡眠分期等六类代表性 EEG 应用，信号时长 2 秒至近 23 小时，预测目标包括类别标签、事件区间与 epoch 级序列；支持知识推理、短时段解读、长时段事件检测与序列理解的统一评估。基准提供 10 个确定性 EEG 分析工具，仅暴露任务相关的信号测量，要求智能体自主选工具、迭代积累证据并构建多步工作流。评测 15 个模型家族共 29 个前沿 LLM。
AI.result: EEGAgentBench 能够有效区分超越模型规模与推理成本的智能体能力，同时揭示当前 LLM 智能体在长时段 EEG 分析中的显著局限，尤其是在持续证据积累与多步推理方面。
AI.conclusion: EEGAgentBench 为 EEG 智能体提供了统一、系统的评测框架，表明模型规模与成本并非能力的决定因素，长时段 EEG 分析仍是当前 LLM 智能体的主要瓶颈。

title: Landau--Ginzburg mirror symmetry for ADE singularities
summary: We prove Landau-Ginzburg mirror symmetry conjecture for ADE singularities with the nontrivial symmetry groups. In particular, we consider $(f,G)$ with $f \in \mathbb{C}[z_1,z_2,z_3]$ defining ADE singularity and $G$ --- nontrivial group of diagonal symmetries of $f$. We show that orbifold Saito theory of $(f,G)$ is isomorphic to the Fan-Jarvis-Ruan-Witten theory of its Berglund-Hübsch-Henningson dual pair $(\widetilde f, \widetilde G)$.

AI.tldr: 证明具有非平凡对称群的ADE奇点的Landau-Ginzburg镜像对称猜想：orbifold Saito理论与Berglund-Hübsch-Henningson对偶的FJRW理论同构。
AI.motivation: Landau-Ginzburg镜像对称猜想此前主要针对平凡对称群或特殊情况，非平凡对称群情形尚待解决。
AI.method: 考虑定义ADE奇点的多项式f与对角对称非平凡群G组成的对(f,G)，利用Berglund-Hübsch-Henningson对偶构造(𝕗̃, G̃)，并建立orbifold Saito理论与FJRW理论之间的同构。
AI.result: 证明了(f,G)的orbifold Saito理论与其BHH对偶(𝕗̃, G̃)的Fan-Jarvis-Ruan-Witten理论同构。
AI.conclusion: 该结果为具有非平凡对称群的ADE奇点情形下的LG镜像对称猜想提供了证明，推广了此前仅对平凡群成立的结果。

title: Mpemba effect without a wall
summary: Experimental demonstrations of the Mpemba effect in a colloidal-particle system have imposed an instantaneous temperature quench via an initial condition where individual particle trajectories are drawn from a high-temperature Boltzmann distribution and then evolve in a bath at lower temperature. The potential used for the high-temperature distribution has had two walls that impose a finite range of initial positions, even at effectively infinite temperatures. The potential for evolution in the bath had no walls and matched that used for the initial condition over its support. For low bath temperatures, the difference between the dynamics with and without walls is negligible. Nonetheless, it has been speculated that the walls are perhaps more important than they seem and might even be required for the Mpemba effect to occur. Here, we introduce a new potential that lacks walls and use it for both the initial high temperature state and for subsequent evolution. This new potential then allows us to investigate by simulation Mpemba effects at finite-quench rates. Our results help clarify intuitions concerning the existence of a Mpemba effect and show that the Mpemba effect appears only for bath-temperature quenches faster than a critical quench rate.

AI.tldr: 该文研究胶体粒子系统中的Mpemba效应，提出一种无壁势阱用于初始高温态与后续演化，并通过模拟研究有限淬火速率下的Mpemba效应，发现该效应仅在快于临界淬火速率时出现。
AI.motivation: 已有胶体粒子Mpemba效应的实验通过瞬时温度淬火实现，但初始高温分布所用的势阱包含两堵壁，将初始位置限制在有限范围内；而演化所用的浴温势阱无壁。虽然在低浴温下有无壁的动力学差异可忽略，但有人猜测壁可能比表面看起来更重要，甚至是Mpemba效应出现的必要条件。作者希望澄清这一直觉。
AI.method: 引入一种不含壁的新势阱，并将其同时用于初始高温态和后续演化，从而在模拟中研究有限淬火速率下的Mpemba效应。
AI.result: 模拟结果表明，Mpemba效应仅在浴温淬火速率快于某个临界淬火速率时出现。
AI.conclusion: 无壁势阱同样可以产生Mpemba效应，壁并非该效应的必要条件；Mpemba效应的出现受淬火速率控制，存在一个临界淬火速率。

title: Enhancing generalization in endwall film cooling prediction: Incorporating the superposition principle into transformer-based neural operators
comment: Author manuscript updated to align core methods and results with the published article; 29 pages, 18 figures, 5 tables
summary: In this study, a physics-enhanced neural operator framework is proposed to enhance the generalization prediction ability of the cooling layout of a turbine endwall with variable number of film holes. Specifically, inspired by the film cooling superposition principle, we propose a film cooling prediction model, namely superposition-based deep neural operator (SDNO), that divides the endwall temperature field prediction into two stages. In the first stage, the cooling layout of a turbine endwall is divided into several sub-parts with randomly assigned film holes, and a Transformer-based neural operator network, namely Calculate Net, is designed to predict the temperature field of each sub-part. Then, in the second stage, another neural operator network, i.e., Super Net, is trained to combine the temperature fields predicted by Calculate Net for each sub-part and obtain the superposed temperature field of the full cooling layout. Additionally, instead of directly taking the film cooling contours as pixel plots, a signed distance function (SDF) which is sensitive to the variable locations of cooling holes, is designed to encode the location information of cooling holes. Furthermore, the proposed endwall film cooling prediction model is trained with the samples that changing the number of film holes from 1-5 with variable locations. Then, the trained prediction shows excellent generalization prediction ability, which can accurately predict the film effectiveness of the cooling layout with 10-20 film cooling holes that are unseen in the training samples. The proposed SDNO also improves prediction accuracy relative to the fully supervised baseline. With the above, the effectiveness of our proposed prediction model has been well demonstrated.

AI.tldr: 提出物理增强神经算子框架SDNO，基于气膜冷却叠加原理分两阶段预测涡轮端壁温度场，实现对训练未见孔数（10-20孔）的强泛化预测。
AI.motivation: 涡轮端壁气膜冷却布局中气膜孔数量可变，传统模型难以泛化到训练样本未覆盖的孔数与位置，需要提升变孔数冷却布局的泛化预测能力。
AI.method: 受气膜冷却叠加原理启发，提出叠加式深度神经算子（SDNO），分两阶段：第一阶段将端壁冷却布局分解为若干随机分配气膜孔的子部件，用基于Transformer的神经算子Calculate Net预测各子部件温度场；第二阶段用Super Net神经网络算子融合各子部件温度场得到整体叠加温度场。同时设计对孔位敏感的有符号距离函数（SDF）编码孔位信息，替代直接像素化冷却轮廓；训练样本孔数1-5且位置可变。
AI.result: 训练后的模型展现出优异泛化预测能力，可准确预测训练样本未见、含10-20个气膜孔的冷却布局气膜有效度；相比全监督基线，SDNO提升了预测精度。
AI.conclusion: 所提物理增强神经算子框架有效提升了变孔数涡轮端壁气膜冷却布局的泛化预测能力，验证了叠加原理与SDF编码结合的有效性。

title: Benchmark of no-slip boundary conditions for meshless Lattice Boltzmann Method in Stokes flow
summary: The introduction of the approximated streaming to the standard Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) decouples the space and velocity discretizations. Although many no-slip implementations knwon from LBM can be directly adopted to the models with approximated streaming, their exact behavior in the off-lattice setting remains unexplored. In this work, we investigate the meshfree off-lattice D2Q9 model equipped with several no-slip implementations -- non-equilibrium extrapolation, simple and interpolated bounceback, and moment-based boundaries -- applied to a Stokes flow around a cylinder. We compare the pressure, velocity and velocity gradient fields obtained with various no-slips, on polar and hybrid polar-scattered discretizations. We find that non-equilibrium extrapolation performs the best of all the studied no-slip realizations, giving smooth stresses and zero velocity on the solid walls. Other no-slips suffer from oscillations and/or discontinuities in the hydrodynamic fields. Hybrid discretizations are found to give higher errors than the polar grid, but improve the stability of the solution. Finally, we simulate the deformation of an elastic ring under the stresses obtained with the studied no-slips to highlight the importance of the sensible choice of the no-slip realization in more complex problems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无网格离格D2Q9模型中不同无滑移边界实现的行为，以圆柱绕流Stokes流为算例，发现非平衡外推表现最优。
AI.motivation: 近似流(approximated streaming)引入标准格子玻尔兹曼方法后，解耦了空间与速度离散。尽管LBM中许多无滑移实现可直接移植到近似流模型，但其在离格(off-lattice)情形下的确切行为尚未被探究，因此需要系统性考察。
AI.method: 采用无网格离格D2Q9模型，配置多种无滑移实现：非平衡外推、简单反弹与插值反弹、以及基于矩的边界；在极坐标网格与极坐标-散点混合离散上求解圆柱绕流的Stokes流，比较压力、速度与速度梯度场，并进一步模拟弹性环在所得应力下的变形。
AI.result: 非平衡外推在所研究的无滑移实现中表现最佳，给出光滑应力且固体壁面速度为零；其他无滑移实现存在流体力学场的振荡和/或不连续。混合离散相比极坐标网格误差更高，但提升了求解稳定性。弹性环变形模拟凸显了合理选择无滑移实现的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 在离格近似流LBM中，无滑移边界实现的选择显著影响流场质量与应力光滑性；非平衡外推是较优选择，混合离散以精度换取稳定性，复杂问题中须审慎选取无滑移边界。

title: Large time behaviour in the multidimensional nonlocal Fisher-KPP equation
summary: This work studies the expansion of the level sets of the solutions of a Fisher-KPP type reaction- diffusion equation, the diffusion being given by a nonnegative, compactly supported, even kernel. Because the latter is not assumed to be spherically symmetric, the level sets advance at an asymptotic speed given by a Freidlin-Gärtner type formula. The main contribution of this paper is to push the expansion up to terms that vanish as time goes to infinity, consisting in an asymptotically logarithmic delay corrected by an function that is constant in time, but depends on the direction of propagation.

AI.tldr: 研究非局部、非球对称核的Fisher-KPP反应扩散方程水平集展开，将渐近速度推进到含对数延迟与方向依赖常数修正项的高阶项。
AI.motivation: 现有结果多只刻画水平集以Freidlin-Gärtner型公式给出的渐近速度推进，尚缺乏对速度之后随时间趋于零的高阶修正项（尤其当核非球对称、依赖方向时）的定量描述，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 针对扩散由非负、紧支撑、偶函数（非局域）核给出的Fisher-KPP型反应扩散方程，分析其解的水平集展开；由于核不假定球对称，渐近速度由Freidlin-Gärtner型公式给出；通过渐近分析推导高阶项，得到对数延迟及方向依赖的常数修正。
AI.result: 水平集的展开可推进到随时间趋于零的项：表现为一个渐近对数延迟，并由一个在时间上为常数、但依赖于传播方向的函数加以修正。
AI.conclusion: 在非球对称非局部核情形下，Fisher-KPP方程水平集的渐近展开不仅有对数延迟，还包含方向依赖的常数修正，深化了对非局部传播front渐近行为的刻画。

title: Convergent Plug-and-Play Image Restoration with Annealed Noise Levels
summary: Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods solve imaging inverse problems by incorporating deep denoisers into iterative optimization algorithms. Although practical implementations often decrease the denoiser noise level $σ$ along iterations, most existing convergence analyses assume a fixed denoiser. In this work, we establish convergence guarantees for a broad family of Plug-and-Play algorithms with annealed noise level, spanning deterministic methods (RED--GD and PnP--PGD) and stochastic methods (SNORE, equivariant RED, and a variant of PnP--Flow). For each method, we identify an explicit, nonconvex objective associated with the terminal denoising level and prove asymptotic stationarity of the iterates with respect to this objective. Our analysis does not prescribe any decay rate for the noise schedule, and our assumptions cover both learned gradient-step denoisers and exact MMSE denoisers. Overall, our theoretical results bridge the gap between existing PnP convergence theory and the decreasing-denoising practices used by state-of-the-art image restoration methods.
