We empirically demonstrate the benefits of such schedules and illustrate the predicted convergence behavior on several imaging inverse problems, including inpainting, super-resolution, demosaicing and tomography.

AI.tldr: 该论文为带退火噪声水平的即插即用（PnP）算法建立了收敛性保证，涵盖确定性与随机方法，并证明迭代点对终末去噪水平对应的非凸目标具有渐近稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有PnP实现常在迭代中逐步降低去噪噪声水平σ，但多数收敛分析假设去噪器固定，理论与实际做法存在gap。
AI.method: 针对退火噪声水平的广义PnP算法族（RED-GD、PnP-PGD、SNORE、等变RED及PnP-Flow变体），识别与终末去噪水平关联的显式非凸目标，证明迭代点的渐近稳定性；不规定噪声调度衰减率，假设覆盖学习型梯度步去噪器与精确MMSE去噪器。
AI.result: 理论上桥接了现有PnP收敛理论与最先进图像复原所用的递减去噪实践；实验验证了此类调度的收益，并在修复、超分、去马赛克和断层重建等问题上展示了预测的收敛行为。
AI.conclusion: 为退火噪声PnP算法提供了统一收敛框架，协调了理论分析与实际递减去噪策略。

title: FOCUS: Fixed-Confidence Online Causal Learning Using Sequential Adaptive Interventions
summary: We study fully online fixed-confidence causal discovery without any historical observational data. Starting from zero samples, the learner sequentially selects interventions to recover both the causal DAG and its edge weights under a linear-Gaussian structural equation model. We establish an instance-dependent lower bound for any $(ε,δ)$-correct algorithm and propose \textsc{FOCUS}, which adaptively allocates interventions through an online max--min game. A key contribution is a computable concentration inequality for the accumulated KL divergence involving causal parameters shared across interventions. We prove that \textsc{FOCUS} is $(ε,δ)$-correct and that its expected stopping time matches the lower bound in its $Θ(\log(1/δ))$ dependence up to an instance-dependent constant. Experiments demonstrate improved structure and edge-weight recovery and confirm the predicted stopping-time trend. Our codes are available on https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FOCUS_code-76E5

AI.tldr: 本文研究无历史数据的全在线固定置信度因果发现，从零样本出发，通过序贯干预恢复线性-高斯SEM的因果DAG与边权，提出FOCUS算法并证明其最优性。
AI.motivation: 现有因果发现通常依赖历史观测数据或离线样本，而实际场景中可能完全没有先验样本可用，需从零开始在线设计干预以高效恢复因果结构。因此需要建立无历史数据条件下的固定置信度在线因果发现框架及其理论极限。
AI.method: 作者首先建立任意(ε,δ)-正确算法的实例依赖下界；然后提出FOCUS算法，通过在线max-min博弈自适应分配干预；核心贡献是推导出涉及跨干预共享因果参数的累积KL散度的可计算集中不等式。
AI.result: 证明了FOCUS满足(ε,δ)-正确性，其期望停止时间在Θ(log(1/δ))依赖上与下界匹配（至多相差实例依赖常数）；实验显示结构与边权恢复性能提升，并验证了预测的停止时间趋势。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为无历史数据的全在线固定置信度因果发现提供了理论下界与近似最优算法FOCUS，兼顾结构与边权恢复，并给出可计算集中不等式这一关键技术工具。

title: Second largest eigenvalue does not bound stationary entropy production
summary: We examine the spectral dissipation-coherence trade-off inequality conjectured by Oberreiter {\it et al}. [Phys. Rev. E 106, 014106 (2022)], stating that the coherent number, defined from the second largest eigenvalue, provides a lower bound on the stationary entropy production per unit oscillation. We disprove this conjecture by explicitly constructing a counterexample, which accompanies finite coherent number with vanishing stationary entropy production. This model also excludes a wide class of thermodynamic bound with the real and imaginary parts of the second largest eigenvalue of the transition rate matrix. Our result implies that the second largest eigenvalue does not necessarily characterize the degree of coherent oscillation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构造显式反例，推翻了Oberreiter等人提出的谱耗散-相干权衡不等式，指出相干数并不能为稳态熵产生提供下界。
AI.motivation: 检验Oberreiter等人（Phys. Rev. E 106, 014106 (2022)）提出的猜想：由次大特征值定义的相干数给出了单位振荡稳态熵产生的下界，即谱耗散-相干权衡不等式。
AI.method: 通过显式构造一个反例模型来证伪该猜想，其中相干数为有限值而稳态熵产生趋于零；同时分析该模型对基于转移速率矩阵次大特征值实部与虚部的各类热力学界的影响。
AI.result: 所构造的反例实现了有限相干数与消失的稳态熵产生共存，从而推翻了原猜想，并排除了依赖次大特征值实部、虚部的一整类热力学界。
AI.conclusion: 次大特征值并不必然刻画相干振荡的程度，谱耗散-相干权衡不等式不成立。

title: Finite element error estimates for a bilinear optimal control problem with pointwise tracking governed by a semilinear elliptic PDE
summary: We study finite element approximations for an optimal control problem with pointwise tracking governed by a semilinear elliptic PDE. The control variable enters the state equation as a reaction coefficient, resulting in a bilinear control, and the cost functional includes point evaluations of the state variable. We propose two discretization schemes: a semidiscrete scheme, where the control variable is not discretized, and a fully discrete scheme, where the control variable is discretized using piecewise constant functions. In two and three dimensions, for both schemes, we establish convergence of discrete solutions and prove a priori error bounds that behave as $\mathcal{O}(h|\log h|)$ in the $L^2(Ω)$-norm for approximating a locally optimal control. In two dimensions, these bounds are improved to $\mathcal{O}(h)$ for the fully discrete scheme and $\mathcal{O}(h^{2}|\log h|^2)$ for the semidiscrete scheme. We conclude with numerical experiments that demonstrate the performance of the proposed schemes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究半线性椭圆方程点态跟踪最优控制问题的有限元逼近。控制以反应系数形式进入状态方程（双线性控制），代价泛函含状态点态值。提出半离散（控制不离散）与全离散（控制用分片常数）两种格式，证明离散解收敛并给出局部最优控制逼近的先验误差估计：二维和三维均为 O(h|log h|) L²范数；二维下全离散改进为 O(h)，半离散改进为 O(h²|log h|²)。数值实验验证格式性能。
AI.motivation: 点态跟踪型最优控制常出现在状态只在有限观测点被测量的实际场景，而其有限元逼近的理论分析（尤其是双线性控制与点态代价耦合时的收敛性与收敛阶）尚不完善，需要建立半离散与全离散格式的误差估计。
AI.method: 针对受半线性椭圆PDE约束、控制作为反应系数（双线性控制）且代价泛函含状态点态值的最优控制问题，设计两种有限元离散格式：(1) 半离散格式，不离散控制变量；(2) 全离散格式，控制用分片常数离散。基于局部最优控制框架，利用有限元误差分析与点态跟踪正则性，在二维、三维情形推导收敛性与先验误差界。
AI.result: 两种格式的离散解均收敛于连续问题解；对局部最优控制的逼近，L²(Ω)范数误差在二维和三维均为 O(h|log h|)。在二维情形误差阶可提升：全离散格式为 O(h)，半离散格式为 O(h²|log h|²)。数值实验展示所提格式的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为含点态跟踪与双线性控制的半线性椭圆最优控制问题提供了半离散与全离散有限元逼近的完整收敛性及先验误差分析，并揭示了二维下不同离散策略可达到的更高收敛阶，数值实验与理论结果一致。

title: Equivariant principal bundles over toric Deligne--Mumford stacks
summary: Let $\mathscr{X}(\boldsymbolΣ)$ be the toric Deligne--Mumford stack with stacky torus $\mathscr{T}$ associated to the stacky fan $\boldsymbolΣ = (N,Σ, β)$. A toric principal $H$-bundle over $\mathscr{X}(\boldsymbolΣ)$ is a principal $H$-bundle $\mathscr{P}$ equipped with a $\mathscr{T}$-action lifting the $\mathscr{T}$-action on $\mathscr{X}(\boldsymbolΣ)$, such that the $\mathscr{T}$-action and the $H$-action on $\mathscr{P}$ commute. For a connected reductive algebraic group $H$ over $\mathbb{C}$, we classify the isomorphism classes of framed toric principal $H$-bundles over $\mathscr{X}(\boldsymbolΣ)$ in terms of piecewise linear maps from $|Σ|$ to the cone over the Tits building of $H$. Using this classification, we describe the equivariant automorphism group of a toric principal $H$-bundle, and give a necessary and sufficient condition for an equivariant reduction of the structure group. We also show that every toric principal $\mathrm{GL}(r)$-bundle over the weighted projective stack $\mathbb{P}(w_0,\dots,w_n)$ splits equivariantly whenever $r < n$, and that every toric principal $H$-bundle over the weighted stacky projective line $\mathbb{P}(a,b)$ splits equivariantly when $H$ is a connected reductive algebraic group.

AI.tldr: 本文对环面 Deligne–Mumford 叠上的环面主 $H$-丛进行分类，用从 $|\Sigma|$ 到 $H$ 的 Tits 建物锥上的分片线性映射刻画其同构类，并给出等变自同构群与等变结构群约化的充要条件；同时证明了加权射影叠上 $\mathrm{GL}(r)$-丛在 $r<n$ 时等变分裂等结论。
AI.motivation: 环面簇上的环面主丛已有较成熟理论，但把对象推广到具有叠结构的环面 Deligne–Mumford 叠、且结构群为一般连通约化代数群时，缺乏系统的分类与结构描述。作者希望建立这种框架，以统一处理加权射影簇/叠上的主丛分裂现象，并得到等变自同构与结构群约化的判据。
AI.method: 设 $\mathscr{X}(\boldsymbol{\Sigma})$ 为依托叠扇形 $\boldsymbol{\Sigma}=(N,\Sigma,\beta)$ 的环面 Deligne–Mumford 叠，叠环面为 $\mathscr{T}$。定义环面主 $H$-丛为带 $\mathscr{T}$-作用提升、且 $\mathscr{T}$ 与 $H$ 作用可交换的主 $H$-丛。对连通约化代数群 $H$，用从 $|\Sigma|$ 到 $H$ 的 Tits 建物锥上的分片线性映射刻画带框环面主 $H$-丛的同构类，并由此推导等变自同构群与等变结构群约化条件。
AI.result: 对任一连通约化代数群 $H$，给出了 $\mathscr{X}(\boldsymbol{\Sigma})$ 上带框环面主 $H$-丛同构类的分片线性映射分类；据此描述了环面主 $H$-丛的等变自同构群，并给出等变结构群约化成立的充要条件。进一步证明：加权射影叠 $\mathbb{P}(w_0,\dots,w_n)$ 上任意环面主 $\mathrm{GL}(r)$-丛在 $r<n$ 时等变分裂；加权射线射影叠 $\mathbb{P}(a,b)$ 上任一以连通约化代数群 $H$ 为结构群的环面主 $H$-丛均等变分裂。
AI.conclusion: 分片线性映射（取值于 Tits 建物锥）为环面 Deligne–Mumford 叠上环面主 $H$-丛提供了统一而有效的分类语言，并自然导出自同构与约化的等变描述；作为应用，得到了加权射影叠上主丛的等变分裂定理。

title: Periodically modulated traveling waves in integrate-and-fire networks: recursive speed law and propagation failure
comment: 18 pages, 8 figures; Supplemental Material (14 pages, 10 figures) appended
summary: Traveling waves of activity in neural tissue can be halted by spatial inhomogeneity in synaptic coupling. We study an integrate-and-fire network in which each neuron fires once and the coupling decays exponentially. For this model the leading-edge firing map reduces exactly to a scalar equation for the wave speed in space, with a slow unstable and a fast stable homogeneous speed, $c_1$ and $c_2$, and a periodic modulation of the coupling enters this equation pointwise. Positive periodic waves terminate in folds. For slowly varying modulation the fold amplitude approaches a plateau set by the trough of the modulation, where the local bottleneck speed is $\sqrt{c_1 c_2}$; the approach to the plateau is set by the local geometry of the trough. For rapidly varying modulation the fold amplitude grows linearly with frequency, with a slope given by a full-amplitude average over the integrated modulation profile; a weak-ripple truncation of that average overestimates the slope about 2.5-fold at the default coupling. A perturbative recursion in the amplitude gives the speed profile explicitly. We distinguish loss of the periodic wave from failure of a particular launch, and the excitatory regime $ε\le 1$ from its sign-changing extension. The results are checked against direct integration of the reduced equation and first-spike firing-map simulations of the network.

AI.tldr: 研究空间非均匀突触耦合如何中止神经组织中的行波，针对一类integrate-and-fire网络导出波速标量方程，分析了正周期波的折叠（终止）行为，得到慢变与快变调制下折叠幅度的渐近规律，并用数值积分验证。
AI.motivation: 神经组织中的行波活动可被突触耦合的空间非均匀性中止，但缺乏对调制空间频率如何定量控制波终止（折叠）的解析刻画，因此需要建立可精确约化的模型来理解这一机制。
AI.method: 采用每个神经元只放电一次、耦合按指数衰减的integrate-and-fire网络，将前缘放电映射精确约化为关于波速的标量方程；该方程含慢不稳定、快稳定的均匀波速c1、c2，耦合的周期调制逐点进入方程。利用扰动递归求波速剖面，并分别分析慢变调制（折叠幅度趋于平台，局部瓶颈速度为√(c1c2)）与快变调制（折叠幅度随频率线性增长，斜率由积分调制剖面的全幅平均给出），最后与约化方程的数值积分及网络的首次放电映射模拟对比。
AI.result: 正周期波终止于折叠。慢变调制时折叠幅度趋近由调制谷值设定的平台，局部瓶颈速度为√(c1c2)，趋近方式由谷的局部几何决定；快变调制时折叠幅度随频率线性增长，斜率由全幅平均给出，而弱波纹截断的近似在默认耦合下将斜率高估约2.5倍。扰动递归给出了显式的波速剖面。区分了周期波的丧失与特定发射的失败，并区分兴奋性区域ε≤1与其变号扩展。结果经约化方程直接积分和首次放电映射模拟验证。
AI.conclusion: 该约化标量波速方程为定量理解空间非均匀耦合中止行波提供了精确框架，揭示了慢变与快变调制下折叠幅度的不同标度律（平台化 vs. 线性增长），并为神经系统活动传播的控制提供了理论依据。

title: Spall Failure of Coral Skeleton beneath Gas-Laden Canopies: An Idealized Blast-Fishing Model
summary: Improvised explosives used for fishing on shallow Indonesian reefs shatter coral skeleton, yet the damage they cause has been described largely through empirical radii and ecological surveys. We formulate an idealized model of how free gas held within a coral canopy modifies the shock loading that such a charge delivers to skeletal plates. The canopy is treated as a relaxed bubbly mixture whose shock impedance follows from the conservation of mass and momentum, and the reef is represented as a layered column of water, canopy, skeletal plate, and canopy struck at normal incidence. Three closed-form results emerge. Above a crossover pressure set by the void fraction and the stiffness of seawater, the canopy becomes nearly transparent to the shock. The impulse transmitted through any lossless layered stack is independent of the canopy, so gas redistributes the pulse in time without changing its total push. A plate carries tension after reflection from its lower face only when the canopy impedance falls below a threshold fixed by the plate thickness and the pulse duration, which defines a critical thickness. For a one-kilogram charge directly overhead, a gas-rich canopy more than triples the standoff at which a twelve-centimeter plate spalls while shortening the standoff at which it is crushed. A prescribed daily cycle of photosynthetic gas makes the same charge markedly more damaging at noon than at night. Bubble dynamics show that the canopy does not reach equilibrium within the pulse, so the results are best read as upper bounds.

AI.tldr: 将珊瑚冠层视为含气泡的松弛混合介质，建立水-冠层-骨板-冠层分层一维冲击模型，得到三个闭式结果：存在由孔隙率决定的高压"透明"转变；无损分层中透射冲量与冠层无关；冠层阻抗低于阈值时骨板下界面反射产生拉应力并定义临界厚度。数值上，富气冠层使1 kg装药对12 cm板的剥落距离增至三倍以上，同时缩短压碎距离；光合气体昼夜循环使正午破坏显著强于夜间。
AI.motivation: 以往对炸鱼冲击造成珊瑚损伤的认识主要来自经验半径与生态调查，缺乏对冠层内自由气体如何改变冲击载荷传递的力学解释，本文旨在建立理想化模型揭示其机制并给出定量判据。
AI.method: 把珊瑚冠层当作松弛含气泡混合物，由质量与动量守恒导出其冲击阻抗；将礁体简化为水、冠层、骨板、冠层组成的层状柱，在正入射条件下求解分层冲击传播，并用气泡动力学检验冠层在脉冲内是否达到平衡。
AI.result: 得到三个闭式结果：（1）当压力超过由孔隙率与海水刚度决定的交叉压力时，冠层近似对冲击透明；（2）穿过无损分层结构的透射冲量与冠层无关，气体只重分配脉冲时间而不改变总推力；（3）仅当冠层阻抗低于由板厚与脉冲历时确定的阈值时，板下界面反射才产生拉应力，由此定义临界厚度。对1 kg正上方装药，富气冠层使12 cm板发生剥落的距离增至三倍以上，同时使压碎距离缩短；光合气体昼夜循环使同一装药正午破坏明显强于夜间。气泡动力学表明冠层在脉冲内未达平衡，故结果应视为上界。
AI.conclusion: 气体冠层通过改变冲击阻抗与脉冲时间结构显著调控珊瑚骨板的破坏模式与距离，且存在昼夜差异；由于气泡未在脉冲内平衡，所得预测为损伤上界。

title: Uncovering flame physics with machine learning: application to the reaction rate in hydrogen flames
summary: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are used as analytical tools to investigate the relationship between the progress variable field and the local chemical source term in lean premixed hydrogen flames. Rather than employing machine learning for modelling, CNNs are leveraged to analyse the physical information contained in spatially resolved fields from direct numerical simulations. CNNs are particularly well suited for this task because they exploit spatial correlations and multi-scale structures, allowing an assessment of how spatial organisation influences the source term. The analysis demonstrates that the progress variable based on water, $C_{\rm H_2O}$, contains all the information required to accurately parametrise the chemical source term whereas $C_{\rm H_2}$ alone does not. The inclusion of the mixture fraction $Z$ improves the accuracy of the latter but provides no significant additional information to the CNN when the spatial field of $C_{\rm H2O}$ is used as input. The same behaviour is observed in both a laminar thermodiffusively unstable flame and a turbulent slot-jet hydrogen flame, indicating that $C_{\rm H_2O}$ is a robust single variable for parametrisation. A complementary scale analysis in the laminar case shows that spatial features extending over at least two laminar flame thicknesses are required to reconstruct the source term accurately, thereby identifying the characteristic scale in the progress variable field that carries this information. These results demonstrate how machine learning can uncover physical dependencies that remain hidden to classical statistical analyses.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用卷积神经网络（CNN）作为分析工具，考察贫燃预混氢气火焰中进度变量场与局部化学源项之间的关系。结果表明，基于水的进度变量 \(C_{\rm H_2O}\) 可充分参数化化学源项，而 \(C_{\rm H_2}\) 单独使用则不足；在 \(C_{\rm H_2O}\) 场作为输入时，混合物分数 \(Z\) 无显著增益。该现象在层流热扩散不稳定火焰与湍流狭缝射流氢气火焰中均成立，尺度分析进一步指出重建源项所需特征尺度至少为两个层流火焰厚度。
AI.motivation: 传统统计分析方法难以揭示空间组织对化学源项的影响。作者希望借助CNN对空间相关性和多尺度结构的捕捉能力，从直接数值模拟的空间分辨场中挖掘被经典统计分析掩盖的物理依赖关系，并评估不同进度变量对化学源项参数化的充分性。
AI.method: 以CNN作为分析工具（而非用于建模），对贫燃预混氢气火焰直接数值模拟的空间分辨场进行处理。采用基于水的进度变量 \(C_{\rm H_2O}\) 和基于氢的进度变量 \(C_{\rm H_2}\) 作为输入，并考察引入混合物分数 \(Z\) 的影响。研究对象包括层流热扩散不稳定火焰和湍流狭缝射流氢气火焰；此外在层流工况下进行补充的尺度分析，确定重建源项所需的空间特征尺度。
AI.result: CNN分析表明，\(C_{\rm H_2O}\) 包含准确参数化化学源项所需的全部信息，而 \(C_{\rm H_2}\) 单独不足以实现准确参数化；引入混合物分数 \(Z\) 可提升 \(C_{\rm H_2}\) 的精度，但当输入为 \(C_{\rm H_2O}\) 空间场时，\(Z\) 未提供显著额外信息。层流热扩散不稳定火焰与湍流狭缝射流氢气火焰中表现一致，说明 \(C_{\rm H_2O}\) 是稳健的单变量参数化变量。层流尺度分析显示，重建源项所需空间特征至少延伸两个层流火焰厚度，从而识别出进度变量场中承载该信息的特征尺度。
AI.conclusion: CNN可有效揭示经典统计分析难以发现的物理依赖关系。\(C_{\rm H_2O}\) 是贫燃预混氢气火焰化学源项的稳健单变量参数化选择，混合物分数 \(Z\) 在 \(C_{\rm H_2O}\) 输入下无显著附加价值；源项重建依赖至少两个层流火焰厚度的空间尺度。该工作展示了机器学习作为物理分析工具在燃烧研究中的潜力。

title: Isoperimetric clusters with a liquid phase
summary: A wet foam is a cluster of air chambers whose interfaces are coated by a single liquid chamber of prescribed volume. In the corresponding isoperimetric problem the liquid chamber may collapse onto films of zero thickness, so that minimizers need not exist. We identify the relaxed energy accounting for such collapsed films and prove that limits of minimizing sequences are its minimizers. The resulting compactness and energy representation theorems lead to the regularity of these generalized minimizers, including an equilibrium law for the pressures across collapsed films. Finally, as the liquid volume vanishes, the minimal energies converge to those of the classical dry foam.

AI.tldr: 本文研究湿泡沫的等周问题，识别了允许零厚度薄膜塌缩的松弛能量，证明极小化序列的极限是其极小元，并给出正则性及压力平衡律。
AI.motivation: 湿泡沫等周问题中，液体腔可塌缩为零厚度薄膜，导致极小元可能不存在，因此需要松弛化处理来刻画极小化序列的极限。
AI.method: 识别并构造考虑塌缩薄膜的松弛能量，证明紧性与能量表示定理，从而分析广义极小元的结构。
AI.result: 证明了极小化序列的极限是松弛能量的极小元，建立了紧性与能量表示定理，得到广义极小元（含塌缩薄膜两侧压力平衡律）的正则性；并证明液体体积趋于零时，极小能量收敛于经典干泡沫的能量。
AI.conclusion: 该松弛框架严格刻画了湿泡沫等周问题的广义极小元及其正则性，并在液体体积消失极限下恢复了经典干泡沫理论。

title: Facial distance and diameter
summary: The facial distance of a polytope, equivalently its pyramidal width, is a geometric condition measure that appears in the convergence bounds for Frank--Wolfe algorithms. Peña and Wirth developed calculus rules for this quantity and conjectured that the ratio of the facial distance to the diameter multiplied by the square root of the dimension is bounded by a constant. We show that this quantity is uniquely maximized by a regular simplex in each dimension, which implies that the conjecture holds and that $\sqrt{2}$ is the smallest constant. We also compute the facial distance of the Birkhoff polytope.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多面体面部距离（锥形宽度），证明其与直径之比乘以维数平方根的最大值由正则单纯形唯一取到，从而验证了Peña–Wirth猜想，且$\sqrt{2}$为最小常数；同时计算了Birkhoff多面体的面部距离。
AI.motivation: 面部距离（等价于锥形宽度）是Frank–Wolfe算法收敛界中的几何条件测度。Peña和Wirth建立了该量的运算规则，并猜想面部距离与直径之比乘以维数平方根有常数上界，但该猜想尚待证明，相关多面体的具体数值也未知。
AI.method: 作者通过几何分析，将面部距离与直径之比乘以维数平方根这一量在每个维度上最大化，论证其唯一由正则单纯形取得；据此确定最优常数，并计算Birkhoff多面体的面部距离。
AI.result: 证明了面部距离与直径之比乘以维数平方根在每一维度上由正则单纯形唯一最大化，进而验证了猜想成立，且最小常数为$\sqrt{2}$；同时给出了Birkhoff多面体面部距离的计算结果。
AI.conclusion: Peña–Wirth猜想成立，$\sqrt{2}$为最优常数，正单纯形为该比值的极值构型；Birkhoff多面体的面部距离得到确定，为Frank–Wolfe算法的收敛分析提供了更精确的几何常数。

title: Uncertainty Quantification of Next Generation Reservoir Computing with Applications to Memory-Driven Dynamical Systems
summary: Nonlinear dynamical systems with memory arise across science and engineering, yet uncertainty quantification for efficient forecasting methods such as Next Generation Reservoir Computing (NGRC) remains underdeveloped. We study Bayesian ridge and conformal prediction intervals for NGRC and characterize when their uncertainty estimates agree or differ. In low dimensions, their asymptotic widths are governed by different summaries of the residual distribution, so agreement depends on residual shape rather than dimensionality alone. In high dimensions, regularization introduces a further tradeoff between estimation variance, shrinkage bias, and posterior uncertainty, leading to an explicit transition between regimes where Bayesian intervals are wider or narrower than conformal intervals. We extend these results to quadratic NGRC feature maps and give sufficient conditions for transferring the analysis to temporally dependent forecast windows. Simulations and real-data experiments support the theoretical predictions and illustrate how residual distribution, regularization, dimensionality, and distribution shift affect interval calibration and efficiency. These results provide a principled framework for choosing and interpreting uncertainty quantification methods in reservoir-based forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了下一代储备池计算（NGRC）中贝叶斯岭回归与共形预测区间的不确定性量化，刻画了两者一致或分歧的条件，并给出高维正则化下的区间宽度转变机制。
AI.motivation: 具有记忆的非线性动力系统广泛存在，NGRC等高效预测方法的不确定性量化尚不成熟，缺乏对贝叶斯区间与共形区间如何选择与解释的理论依据。
AI.method: 理论分析贝叶斯岭回归与共形预测区间：低维下比较区间渐近宽度所依赖的残差分布摘要量；高维下分析正则化在估计方差、收缩偏差与后验不确定性之间的权衡；并推广至二次NGRC特征映射，给出向时间相关预测窗口迁移的充分条件，辅以仿真与真实数据实验。
AI.result: 低维时两类区间的渐近宽度由残差分布的不同摘要量决定，一致性取决于残差形状而非仅维度；高维时正则化导致贝叶斯区间与共形区间宽窄之间存在明确的机制转变；实验验证了残差分布、正则化、维度与分布漂移对区间校准与效率的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为储备池预测中选择与解释不确定性量化方法提供了有原则的框架，明确了贝叶斯与共形区间适用与一致的边界条件。

title: Distance-Residual Physics-Informed Neural Networks: A Deep Learning Framework for Differential and Partial Differential Inclusions
summary: We introduce Distance-Residual Physics-Informed Neural Networks (DR-PINNs), a physics-informed learning framework for approximating solutions of ordinary and partial differential inclusions (DIs), governing laws in which a differential operator is constrained to lie in a set-valued map rather than equaling a prescribed function. The method replaces the classical pointwise PDE/ODE residual by the squared distance from the differential operator to the admissible set. This distance vanishes exactly when the inclusion is satisfied and measures the infimal correction needed for the operator to enter the admissible set. For a fixed closed convex admissible set, the squared distance is differentiable with respect to the operator value, with gradient given by the metric projection. When the admissible set also depends on the network state, that dependence is included through the chain rule. The framework encompasses ordinary and partial DIs with set-valued reaction terms. For both settings we prove consistency: under the stated closedness, measurability, convexity, and growth assumptions, any sequence of candidates satisfying the initial (and, in the parabolic case, boundary) conditions whose continuous distance-residual functional tends to zero admits a subsequence converging to an exact solution of the target inclusion. These are conditional statements for the continuous distance-residual functional; they do not cover the finite-collocation training loss, the behavior of the optimizer, or convergence rates. For admissible sets given as convex hulls of finitely many vertices, projection onto the set reduces to a small convex quadratic program, making the loss efficiently computable inside the training loop. Numerical experiments demonstrate high accuracy on the differential-inclusion benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出距离残差物理信息神经网络（DR-PINNs），用微分算子到容许集的平方距离替代传统逐点残差，用于求解常/偏微分包含，并证明一致性、给出高效投影算法与数值验证。
AI.motivation: 经典 PINN 以逐点残差（算子等于给定函数）为损失，无法处理微分算子被约束在集值映射中（即微分包含）的问题；需要一种可微、可训练且具理论保证的残差形式。
AI.method: 以算子值到容许集的平方距离作为残差：当容许集为闭凸集时该距离可微，梯度由度量投影给出；容许集依赖网络状态时经链式法则纳入梯度。容许集为有限顶点凸包时，投影化为小型凸二次规划，可在训练循环内高效计算。
AI.result: 在闭性、可测性、凸性与增长性假设下证明一致性：满足初值（抛物情形下还需边界条件）且连续距离残差泛函趋于零的候选序列，存在子列收敛到目标包含的精确解；数值实验在微分包含基准上取得高精度。
AI.conclusion: DR-PINNs 为常/偏微分包含提供了统一的可微残差框架，兼具理论一致性与计算可行性；但结论仅针对连续距离残差泛函，不覆盖有限配点训练损失、优化器行为与收敛速率。

title: Symmetry-quotient Flatness and Generalization
comment: Accepted to 33rd International Conference on Neural Information Processing (ICONIP 2026) as an extended abstract. This version is the full paper
summary: This paper develops a theorem-level pipeline in symmetry-quotient settings: quotient linear stability implies quotient flatness, quotient flatness implies input smoothness, and input smoothness yields generalization under local covering assumptions. Flatness is often associated with generalization, and Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) is frequently viewed as implicitly biased toward flat solutions. However, standard flatness measures are typically defined in the raw parameter space and are therefore not invariant under function-preserving symmetries such as positive rescaling. We develop a symmetry-aware theory of quotient flatness, quotient linear stability, input smoothness, and generalization on quotient spaces of neural-network parameters. For square loss and models equipped with function-preserving group actions, we define quotient flatness as the trace of the Hessian of the empirical loss on the regular quotient manifold. We show that quotient flatness controls input smoothness through a quotient-space analogue of the flatness-to-smoothness argument. We also prove that one-step mean-square quotient linear stability of the linearized SGD dynamics implies an explicit quotient-flatness bound in terms of the batch size and learning rate, and extend this analysis to higher-order tensor moments. Finally, under local covering and boundedness assumptions, we derive population generalization bounds in terms of quotient flatness and, consequently, in terms of quotient linear stability.

AI.tldr: 本文在对称商空间框架下建立了一条定理级推理链：商线性稳定性 ⇒ 商平坦性 ⇒ 输入平滑性 ⇒ 泛化，并将商平坦性定义为经验损失 Hessian 在正则商流形上的迹。
AI.motivation: 标准平坦性度量在原始参数空间中定义，对正缩放等保函数对称性不变，因而与泛化之间的联系缺乏对称性感知的理论刻画；SGD 虽被认为偏好平坦解，但该直觉需在商空间下重新形式化。
AI.method: 针对平方损失与具保函数群作用的模型，在参数正则商流形上定义商平坦性（经验损失 Hessian 的迹）；证明商平坦性通过商空间版的平坦性—平滑性论证控制输入平滑性；证明线性化 SGD 动力学的一步均方商线性稳定性给出以批大小和学习率为显式项的商平坦性上界，并推广到高阶张量矩；在局部覆盖与有界性假设下推导总体泛化界。
AI.result: 建立了商线性稳定性 ⇒ 商平坦性 ⇒ 输入平滑性 ⇒ 泛化的完整推理链；给出由批大小与学习率刻画的显式商平坦性界；在高阶张量矩情形下推广该分析；得到以商平坦性（进而以商线性稳定性）表示的总体泛化界。
AI.conclusion: 对称性感知的商空间理论为平坦性与泛化关系提供了不变性刻画，并将 SGD 的隐式偏置、稳定性与泛化统一在同一定理级框架中。

title: Coordinate descents, monodromy, and finite normalization of marked-root maps
comment: 27 pages. Ancillary files: SymPy verification scripts with a runner and reference outputs (Apache-2.0)
summary: We study the dimension-indexed marked-root polynomial maps introduced by Harish. For every $n\geq 4$, their lower coefficient block extends to a polynomial coordinate system, giving three-dimensional Keller maps of geometric degree $n(n-2)$ for every choice of the fixed coefficients. We determine the generic monodromy of the original maps and all successive coordinate descents: it is the cyclic wreath product for odd $n$, and an explicit subgroup of index two for even $n$. Its order is $(n-2)^n n!/\gcd(2,n-2)$. We construct the smooth finite normalization and identify its complement of the affine source as $n-2$ disjoint affine divisors. One is ramified; the others record unramified loss of inverse sheets. The normalization has Picard group $\mathbb{Z}^{n-2}$ and the homotopy type of a wedge of $n-2$ two-spheres. Its rational deck group is cyclic, while the polynomial deck group of the source map is trivial. By base change, the normalization describes the preimage of any subvariety of the target; when the target polynomial factors, a component with only constant units is an open subset of a Kummer cover of the simple roots of one factor. Finally, the monodromy separates these maps, for $n\geq 4$, from single weighted lifts under stable polynomial left-right equivalence.

AI.tldr: 该文研究Harish引入的按维数标号的标记根多项式映射，证明其低次系数块可扩展为多项式坐标系统，得到几何度为n(n-2)的三维Keller映射；并确定了原映射及所有逐次坐标下降的一般单值群、构造了光滑有限正规化、识别了其补集、Picard群与同伦型，最后给出单值群对稳定多项式左右等价下的区分性。
AI.motivation: 研究Harish提出的维数标号标记根多项式映射，刻画其低次系数块所能诱导的多项式坐标系统与Keller映射，并理解这些映射的代数几何与拓扑不变量（单值群、正规化、Picard群、同伦型），以便在稳定多项式左右等价下区分这类映射与单加权提升。
AI.method: 对n≥4，将标记根多项式映射的低次系数块扩展为多项式坐标系统，构造几何度为n(n-2)的三维Keller映射；计算原映射及各逐次坐标下降的一般单值群，得奇n时为循环花环积、偶n时为指数二的显式子群，阶为(n-2)^n n!/gcd(2,n-2)；构造光滑有限正规化并刻画其补集；通过基变换描述目标任意子簇的原像，并在目标多项式可分解时识别含常单元分支为某因子简单根的Kummer覆盖的开子集；利用单值群进行稳定多项式左右等价下的分离。
AI.result: 低次系数块可扩展为多项式坐标系统，给出几何度n(n-2)的三维Keller映射；一般单值群为奇n的循环花环积或偶n的指数二显式子群，阶为(n-2)^n n!/gcd(2,n-2)；光滑有限正规化的补集为n-2个互不相交的仿射除子，其中一个分歧、其余记录逆叶的非分歧丢失；正规化Picard群为Z^{n-2}，同伦型为n-2个二维球面的楔；有理甲板群循环，而源映射的多项式甲板群平凡；正规化经基变换描述目标任意子簇的原像，目标多项式可分解时含常单元分支为某因子简单根Kummer覆盖的开子集；单值群在n≥4时将该类映射与稳定多项式左右等价下的单加权提升区分开。
AI.conclusion: 标记根多项式映射的低次系数块可系统扩展为Keller型坐标系统，其单值群、正规化几何与拓扑不变量（除子结构、Picard群、同伦型、甲板群）被完整刻画；这些不变量还可在稳定多项式左右等价下将此类映射与单加权提升区分开来。

title: Boolean Cumulants and Exact Reduced Descriptions of Renewal-Driven Systems
summary: Reduced descriptions of unresolved fluctuations are commonly based on Gaussian processes, despite the fact that many realistic forcings possess finite correlation times and a renewal structure. For memoryless step (Kubo-Anderson) noise, we show that the reduced dynamics admit two exact and complementary descriptions: a kernel representation governed by the Boolean cumulants of the jump distribution, and a frozen-noise representation for stationary probability densities. For exponentially distributed waiting times, the totally time-ordered $G$-cumulants coincide exactly with the Boolean cumulants of the jump law, leading to an exact resummation of the memory kernel. The resulting kernel is expressed through the Boolean generator $η$ evaluated on a resolvent operator. Within this hierarchy, second-order closure is exact if and only if the jump distribution is symmetric Bernoulli. For general jump laws, the leading closure error is controlled by the universal combination $(b4/b2)λ^2$. Unlike classical cumulant expansions, however, the Boolean hierarchy acts on the reduced kernel rather than directly on the stationary measure. A complementary exact description is provided by the frozen-noise representation. For the linear system with linear multiplicative interaction (LIMI/CAM) model, it reduces the dynamics to a random affine recursion and yields exact expressions for stationary densities and Kesten tail indices. The analysis reveals that rates, moments, and closure errors are governed by the Boolean hierarchy, whereas stationary-density properties are determined by the geometry of the jump distribution through the frozen dynamics. Finite-correlation reductions are therefore controlled not only by the variance and correlation time of the forcing, but also by the underlying combinatorial structure of the renewal process. For memoryless renewal noise, that structure is Boolean.

AI.tldr: 对无记忆阶跃（Kubo-Anderson）噪声，约化动力学存在两种精确互补描述：基于跳跃分布Boolean累积量的核表示，以及平稳概率密度的冻结噪声表示。指数等待时间下，G-累积量与Boolean累积量完全一致，实现记忆核精确重求和，核由Boolean生成元η在预解算子上的取值表达。
AI.motivation: 现有对未解析涨落的约化描述多基于高斯过程，但许多实际强迫具有有限相关时间和更新结构，高斯假设不适用。作者希望为具有有限相关时间的更新型强迫建立精确的约化动力学理论，并揭示其背后的组合结构。
AI.method: 针对无记忆阶跃噪声，建立两种精确描述：(1) 由跳跃分布Boolean累积量支配的核表示；(2) 平稳密度的冻结噪声表示。对指数等待时间证明全时间序G-累积量与跳跃律的Boolean累积量一致，从而精确重求和记忆核，用Boolean生成元η作用于预解算子表示核；分析二阶闭合误差与跳跃分布的关系，并在LIMI/CAM线性乘性模型中将动力学化为随机仿射递归。
AI.result: 二阶闭合精确当且仅当跳跃分布为对称Bernoulli；一般跳跃律下领先闭合误差由普适组合(b4/b2)λ²控制。Boolean层级作用于约化核而非直接作用于平稳测度。冻结噪声表示对LIMI/CAM模型给出平稳密度与Kesten尾指数的精确表达式。速率、矩和闭合误差由Boolean层级支配，而平稳密度性质由跳跃分布几何经冻结动力学决定。
AI.conclusion: 有限相关约化不仅由强迫的方差与相关时间控制，还由更新过程的底层组合结构决定；对无记忆更新噪声，该结构是Boolean的。Boolean累积量层级与冻结噪声表示构成互补的精确框架。

title: On elastic scattering behavior of corner domains
summary: We investigate the scattering of elastic waves by anisotropic inhomogeneous media at a fixed wave number. We prove that, in two dimensions, every penetrable obstacle with piecewise $C^{1}$ boundary and corner singularities, and, in higher dimensions, every obstacle with edge singularities, scatters every incident wave satisfying suitable assumptions. This work extends our previous result [J. Math. Anal. Appl. 2026, doi:10.1016/j.jmaa.2026.130630] from scalar equations to systems of equations, a generalization that requires a more delicate blowup analysis and more involved computations. Roughly speaking, our results establish the principle that \emph{corners always scatter} for general anisotropic media with variable coefficients.

AI.tldr: 该文研究固定波数下弹性波在各项异性非均匀介质中的散射，证明二维分片C^1边界带角奇性障碍及高维带棱边奇性障碍均会散射所有满足条件入射波，将先前标量方程结果推广到方程组，确立了"角点必然散射"原则。
AI.motivation: 先前工作[J. Math. Anal. Appl. 2026]仅在标量方程框架下证明了角点散射现象。本文旨在将其推广到弹性波方程组（更一般的各向异性变系数介质），此类推广需要更精细的爆破分析与更复杂的计算，从而检验"角点必然散射"原则在方程组情形下的普适性。
AI.method: 在固定波数下考察弹性波散射问题。对二维具有分片C^1边界及角奇性的可穿透障碍，以及高维具有棱边奇性的障碍，通过更精细的局部爆破（blowup）分析与较繁重的计算，证明每个满足适当假设的入射波均被散射。
AI.result: 证明了二维任意具有分片C^1边界和角奇性的可穿透障碍，以及高维任意具有棱边奇性的障碍，都会散射每个满足适当假设的入射波；即对一般各向异性变系数介质，"角点必然散射"成立。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将标量方程中"角点必然散射"的结论成功推广至弹性波方程组，表明该原则对一般各向异性、变系数的介质普遍成立，并展示了方程组情形所需的更深入的爆破分析与计算方法。

title: Saddle-Point Problems with a Low-Dimensional Block Do Not Need Accurate Inner Solves
summary:
Many learning problems couple a high-dimensional block of parameters with a handful of adversarial or dual variables: worst-group risk over a few groups, or learning under a few constraints. We consider $\min_{x\in X}\max_{y\in Y} f(x,y)$ with $X\subseteq\mathbb{R}^n$, a compact convex set and strongly convex with condition number $κ$, and we count the oracle calls for $x$ and for $y$ separately. The textbook approach runs a
  cutting-plane method in $y$ and solves every inner problem to accuracy $\varepsilon$ with an accelerated method; it needs $O(m\log(1/\varepsilon))$ calls for $y$ but $O(m\sqrtκ\log^2(1/\varepsilon))$ calls for $x$. We show that the inner problems need not be solved accurately. Our method, certificate transport, keeps a strongly convex lower model of a single slice and uses it as a prior for a short accelerated run on the next slice. By concavity in $y$, every call for $y$ then either cuts the localizer or moves the lower model to a mixture of the two slices with a certified increase of the lower bound. For $m=1$ this gives an $\varepsilon$-saddle point after $O(\sqrtκ\log(1/\varepsilon))$ calls for $x$, up to an initialization term, and $O(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ calls for $y$; both counts are optimal, even though $f(x,\cdot)$ is only assumed to be concave and Lipschitz. For general $m$, with centers of gravity of the localizer treated as computable, the method needs $O((m+\sqrt{mκ})\log(1/\varepsilon))$ calls for $x$ and the optimal $O(m\log(1/\varepsilon))$ calls for $y$. Under strong concavity in $y$, a two-point accelerated method makes the number of calls for $x$ independent of $m$.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"证书传输"(certificate transport)方法，通过允许内层问题不精确求解并结合强凸下模型迁移，显著改进了求解 min-max（或约束/最坏组风险）问题的 oracle 调用复杂度。
AI.motivation: 许多学习问题（如最坏组风险、少约束学习）将高维参数块与少量对抗/对偶变量耦合。标准做法（切割平面 + 精确求解内层问题）需要对 x 的调用数带有额外 log^2(1/ε) 因子，且需将每个内层问题精确求解到 ε，代价高昂。作者希望避免精确求解内层问题以降低复杂度。
AI.method: 针对 min_{x∈X} max_{y∈Y} f(x,y)，X 为紧凸且强凸（条件数 κ）。提出 certificate transport：维护单个切片的强凸下模型，作为下一个切片上短程加速运行的先验。利用 y 的凹性，每次对 y 的调用要么切割定位器(localizer)，要么将下模型移动到两个切片的混合并带有下界的可证增加。
AI.result: m=1 时，达到 ε-鞍点需要 x 调用 O(√κ log(1/ε))（含初始化项），y 调用 O(log(1/ε))，两者均最优，尽管 f(x,·) 仅假设为凹且 Lipschitz。一般 m 时（以定位器重心为可计算），x 调用 O((m+√(mκ))log(1/ε))，y 调用最优的 O(m log(1/ε))。在 y 强凹情形下，两点加速方法使 x 调用数与 m 无关。
AI.conclusion: 内层问题无需精确求解；通过证书传输可在 x 与 y 的 oracle 调用计数上达到（甚至最优）改进，显著优于经典切割平面+精确内层求解方案。

title: High-Probability Guarantees for SGD under $β$-Heavy-Tailed Gradient Noise
summary: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is widely used to train machine learning models, but subsampling the training data introduces noise into its updates. The strength and applicability of high-probability guarantees therefore depend critically on how the tails of gradient noise are modeled. Reports of heavy-tailed gradient noise in deep learning motivate relaxing the bounded-noise and sub-Gaussian assumptions commonly used in high-probability analyses of SGD. We use Young functions from Orlicz space theory to describe noise tails in a common framework. We model SGD gradient noise by adopting a Young function that preserves the finiteness of all polynomial moments while allowing tails heavier than sub-Weibull, including lognormal distributions. The resulting class is called $β$-heavy-tailed, with $β$ controlling the tail heaviness. We establish concentration inequalities for $β$-heavy-tailed noise and combine them with a uniform bound on the difference between empirical and population gradients along the SGD trajectory to obtain high-probability bounds on optimization and population-risk stationarity for smooth nonconvex losses under trajectory assumptions. The bounds are not restricted to a particular learning-rate decay rule and make explicit the effects of noise tails and learning-rate schedules. Under the Polyak-Łojasiewicz condition, we bound the risk at the last iterate. We also analyze SGD with gradient clipping under the $β$-heavy-tailed noise model.

AI.tldr: 本文用Orlicz空间中的Young函数刻画SGD梯度噪声尾部，提出β-重尾噪声模型（允许比sub-Weibull更重、保留多项式矩有限的尾部，如对数正态），建立集中不等式，并据此给出光滑非凸损失下优化与总体风险平稳性的高概率界，同时分析梯度裁剪情形。
AI.motivation: SGD更新因数据子采样而含噪声，其高概率保证的强度依赖对梯度噪声尾部的建模。深度学习中被报道存在重尾梯度噪声，因此常用有界噪声与sub-Gaussian假设过于严格，需要放松。
AI.method: 采用Orlicz空间理论中的Young函数统一描述噪声尾部；构造保留所有多项式矩有限、但尾部比sub-Weibull更重（含对数正态）的Young函数，定义β-重尾类，β控制尾部重程度；建立β-重尾噪声的集中不等式；结合沿SGD轨迹的经验梯度与总体梯度差的一致界，导出光滑非凸损失下优化与总体风险平稳性的高概率界；在Polyak-Łojasiewicz条件下界最后迭代风险；并分析β-重尾噪声下的梯度裁剪SGD。
AI.result: 给出了β-重尾噪声的集中不等式，以及光滑非凸损失下优化和平稳性、总体风险平稳性的高概率界；这些界不限于特定学习率衰减规则，并显式体现噪声尾部与学习率调度的影响；在Polyak-Łojasiewicz条件下得到最后迭代的风险界；并给出梯度裁剪SGD在β-重尾噪声模型下的分析结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过Young函数框架统一刻画重尾梯度噪声，将SGD高概率分析从有界/sub-Gaussian/sub-Weibull假设推广到更一般的β-重尾情形，明确了尾部重量与学习率调度对收敛保证的作用，并覆盖了梯度裁剪SGD。

title: Optimal convergence analysis of arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian finite element methods for two-phase Stokes flow problems with moving interface
summary: In this paper, an arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian (ALE)-based finite element method (FEM) is developed and studied in a monolithic framework for a class of two-phase Stokes flow problems with moving interfaces and jump coefficients, where the mixed finite element approximation to Stokes moving interface problems is established and analyzed in both semi- and fully discrete schemes based on the ALE formulation. The key analytical technique involves a specific H^1-projection associated with the ALE-induced mesh motion due to the evolving interface. Optimal convergence properties of the proposed H^1-projection and its ALE temporal derivative are proved in both H^1 and L^2 norms, with which optimal error estimates are obtained for both semi- and fully discrete mixed finite element approximations to the studied Stokes moving interface problem in both H1 and L2 norms as well. Numerical experiments are carried out to validate all derived theoretical results. The developed analytical approach can be extended to Taylor-Hood and MINI mixed elements, as well as to more general two-phase flow problems.

AI.tldr: 本文在单体（monolithic）框架下，基于任意拉格朗日-欧拉（ALE）有限元方法，研究一类具有运动界面与跳跃系数的两相 Stokes 流动问题，建立并分析了半离散与全离散混合有限元格式，证明了最优误差估计并通过数值实验验证。
AI.motivation: 两相 Stokes 流动中界面随时间演化，且存在跨界面的系数跳跃，界面运动导致网格变形，给数值格式的稳定性与误差分析带来困难。需要一种能统一处理运动界面、保持最优收敛性的有限元分析框架。
AI.method: 采用基于 ALE 的有限元方法，在单体框架下处理两相 Stokes 运动界面问题；建立混合有限元半离散与全离散格式；引入与 ALE 网格运动相关的特定 H^1-投影作为核心分析工具，并在 H^1 与 L^2 范数下证明该投影及其 ALE 时间导数的收敛性；据此导出半离散与全离散逼近在 H^1 和 L^2 范数下的最优误差估计。
AI.result: 证明了所提出 H^1-投影及其 ALE 时间导数在 H^1 与 L^2 范数下的最优收敛性；获得了半离散与全离散混合有限元逼近在 H^1 与 L^2 范数下的最优误差估计；数值实验验证了全部理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 所发展的分析框架可推广至 Taylor-Hood 与 MINI 混合元，以及更一般的两相流动问题。

title: What Next-Event Accuracy Cannot See: Closed-Loop Evaluation of Emergency Department Trajectory Simulators
summary: Clinical trajectory models are usually evaluated by next-event accuracy on observed histories. Simulation is different: models must condition on their own generated events, allowing errors to compound. Although this problem is well known in sequence modelling, it has not been systematically quantified for clinical trajectory simulators. We developed EDSim-Bench to evaluate this failure mode using 425,028 MIMIC-IV-ED stays, with external replication on MC-MED, and release the evaluation protocol and scoring code. Starting from held-out visit prefixes, models generate the remainder of each visit and are evaluated on termination, event composition, timing, conditional fidelity, and occupancy forecasting, with a train-only order-3 n-gram as a reference baseline. Despite next-event accuracies within 0.001, three neural architectures behaved very differently under rollout. Across seeds, one Transformer recipe ranged from 0.43 to 0.96 in termination score and from 4.2- to 137-fold the divergence of the n-gram; no prefix-trained neural model approached the n-gram on termination or event composition. Inference-time interventions improved termination but did not jointly recover composition and timing. Supervising every eligible sequence position rather than only the final prefix position was associated with one to two orders of magnitude lower divergence across Transformer, GRU, and LSTM models, with the pattern persisting under model scaling, temporal shift, and external-site evaluation. Nevertheless, even the best model generated visits approximately half as long as observed, and model rankings reversed on occupancy forecasting, a downstream quantity relevant to bed management. These results show that next-event accuracy is insufficient to evaluate clinical trajectory simulators and motivate closed-loop evaluation across seeds, rollout criteria, and downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EDSim-Bench 评测框架，系统量化临床轨迹模拟器在自回归 rollout 下的误差累积问题，发现 next-event 准确率无法区分模型质量，且训练监督位置的选择显著影响长程生成稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有临床轨迹模型多以 observed history 上的 next-event 准确率评估，但模拟任务要求模型以自身生成的事件为条件进行自回归 rollout，误差会不断累积。该问题在序列建模中虽已知，却未被系统地针对临床轨迹模拟器进行量化。
AI.method: 构建 EDSim-Bench，基于 425,028 条 MIMIC-IV-ED 就诊记录并在 MC-MED 上做外部复现。从留出的就诊前缀出发，让模型生成整段就诊，并从终止、事件组成、时间、条件保真度与占用预测五个维度评估，采用仅在训练集上拟合的 order-3 n-gram 作为参考基线；同时比较 Transformer、GRU、LSTM 三类架构及不同监督位置、推理时干预、模型规模、时间偏移与外部队列。
AI.result: 尽管 next-event 准确率差异在 0.001 以内，三类神经网络在 rollout 下表现差异巨大：某 Transformer 方案跨随机种子终止分数在 0.43–0.96 之间波动，发散度达 n-gram 的 4.2–137 倍；无任何前缀训练神经模型在终止或事件组成上接近 n-gram。推理时干预可改善终止，但无法同时恢复组成与时间。对每个可用序列位置（而非仅前缀末位）进行监督，可使 Transformer、GRU、LSTM 的发散度降低 1–2 个数量级，该规律在模型缩放、时间偏移和外部队列下依旧成立。但最佳模型生成的就诊长度仍约为真实的一半，且模型在占用预测上的排名发生反转。
AI.conclusion: next-event 准确率不足以评估临床轨迹模拟器，需在多种子、多 rollout 准则与下游任务上开展闭环评估；训练监督位置是决定长程生成稳定性的关键设计因素。

title: On the algebraicity of non-abelian Noether-Lefschetz loci of rank-two real local systems
summary: As a non-abelian analogue of the Hodge locus, Simpson introduced the non-abelian Noether--Lefschetz locus and conjectured its algebraicity for $\mathbb Z$PVHS. In this paper, we study this question on the moduli space of curves $\mathcal M_g$. For a non-unitary representation \[ ρ:π_1(Σ_g)\longrightarrow \mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb R) \] which admits a $\mathbb R$PVHS of weight one, we prove that algebraicity of a positive-dimensional non-abelian Noether--Lefschetz component is equivalent to discreteness of $\operatorname{im}ρ$, and in this case the component is precisely a marked fixed-target orbifold Hurwitz component. As applications, we construct two explicit rational families by slit surgery: one with non-discrete monodromy and non-algebraic Noether--Lefschetz image, and another with discrete monodromy whose period map is nevertheless non-uniformizing. The latter gives an affirmative answer to a question of Baldi--Lam concerning $\mathbb Q$PVHS.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非阿贝尔Noether–Lefschetz locus在模空间M_g上的代数性问题：对容许权1实PVHS的SL_2(R)表示，证明正维数非阿贝尔NL分支的代数性等价于单值群离散，且此时分支为带标记固定目标的orbifold Hurwitz分支；并给出两个显式有理族作为应用。
AI.motivation: Simpson提出非阿贝尔Noether–Lefschetz locus并猜测其代数性（针对Z PVHS）。本文在曲线模空间M_g上研究这一猜想，试图理解该分支的代数性刻画及几何来源。
AI.method: 取非酉表示ρ:π_1(Σ_g)→SL_2(R)，且容许权1的R PVHS；在M_g上分析正维数非阿贝尔Noether–Lefschetz分支，并将其代数性与im ρ的离散性进行比较；同时通过slit surgery构造显式的有理族。
AI.result: 证明了正维数非阿贝尔NL分支的代数性等价于im ρ的离散性；此时分支恰为marked fixed-target orbifold Hurwitz component。构造了两个有理族：一个具非离散单值群且NL像非代数；另一个单值群离散但周期映射非uniformizing，从而肯定回答Baldi–Lam关于Q PVHS的问题。
AI.conclusion: 在M_g上，非阿贝尔Noether–Lefschetz分支的代数性由单值群的离散性完全刻画，代数分支即orbifold Hurwitz分支；slit surgery可构造出反例与满足离散但非uniformizing的实例，回应并解决了Baldi–Lam的Q PVHS问题。

title: MinkowskiPE: Minkowski Positional Encoding for Spatiotemporal Perception
summary: Modeling spatiotemporal coupling is a key challenge in building physical intelligence across scales, from microscopic to macroscopic. Existing models capture such structure broadly through physics-motivated dynamical formulations or learning-motivated architectures. The former provide stronger priors but may constrain flexibility, whereas the latter are more flexible but leave the spatiotemporal coupling largely implicit. We therefore seek an approach that combines flexible learning with an explicit geometric bias for jointly modeling time and space. To this end, we propose Minkowski Positional Encoding (MinkowskiPE), which uses joint temporal and spatial coordinates to parameterize Lorentz transformations applied to query and key features. With MinkowskiPE, the query-key attention score depends on position only through the relative spacetime displacement between the two tokens and is therefore invariant to global translation of the coordinates. This paradigm retains the standard dot-product attention interface and remains compatible with efficient attention implementations. We evaluate MinkowskiPE on microscopic molecular dynamics and macroscopic video prediction tasks, achieving the best results on all nine multi-trajectory molecular evaluations and reducing KTH video-prediction MSE by 9.9% relative to the best baseline while using roughly one-tenth as many parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出 Minkowski Positional Encoding (MinkowskiPE)，用洛伦兹变换对 query 和 key 特征进行联合时空参数化，使注意力分数仅依赖相对时空位移，在分子动力学与视频预测任务上取得最优效果。
AI.motivation: 时空耦合建模是跨尺度（微观到宏观）物理智能的核心挑战。现有方法分为两类：物理启发的动力学建模具备更强先验但灵活性受限；学习驱动的架构更灵活但时空耦合多为隐式表示。作者希望兼得二者优势——既保持灵活学习能力，又引入显式的几何偏置来联合建模时间与空间。
AI.method: 提出 MinkowskiPE，利用联合的时空坐标参数化作用于 query 和 key 特征的洛伦兹变换。由此，query-key 注意力分数对位置的依赖仅通过两个 token 之间的相对时空位移体现，因而对坐标的全局平移具有不变性。该方法保留标准点积注意力接口，并兼容高效注意力实现。
AI.result: 在微观分子动力学与宏观视频预测任务上评估：在全部九项多轨迹分子评测中均取得最佳结果；在 KTH 视频预测任务上，MSE 相对最佳基线降低 9.9%，且参数量约为其十分之一。
AI.conclusion: MinkowskiPE 通过显式几何偏置（洛伦兹变换诱导的相对时空位移依赖）与灵活学习相结合，实现了高效且参数轻量的时空耦合建模，验证了融合物理先验与学习架构的有效性。

title: Reduced Subgrid-Scale Terms for Turbulence Simulations with the Lattice Boltzmann Method
summary:
Turbulent flows span a wide range of scales, making direct numerical simulation (DNS) prohibitively expensive at high Reynolds numbers. Large eddy simulation (LES) offers a pragmatic alternative by only resolving the large-scale motions, but its accuracy hinges on the subgrid-scale (SGS) model. We introduce the Tau-orthogonal (TO) framework to the lattice Boltzmann method (LBM) using a macroscopic-velocity forcing. The TO method shifts the modeling target from a high-dimensional SGS field to the time dynamics of a small set of spatially integrated quantities of interest (QoIs). Training data are generated by a predictor-corrector tracking procedure that nudges coarse simulations toward reference QoI trajectories. Lightweight linear regression models with stochastic, multivariate Gaussian residuals (LRS) then drive the LES autonomously. Compact convolution-based kernels replace the sharp Fourier filters of the original formulation, lifting its restriction to rectangular periodic domains.
  We first evaluate the closure on two-dimensional Kolmogorov flow, where TO-LRS yields stable, statistically accurate online LES. However, bounded high-frequency oscillations are observed in the solution fields. The decisive test is three-dimensional turbulent channel flow, simulated on a grid five times coarser in every direction than the high-fidelity reference. Here the plain BGK solver is unstable, and even calibrated Smagorinsky and WALE models over-dissipate the near-wall flow. TO-LRS, applied on top of an eddy-viscosity substrate and with the QoI set augmented by mean-profile QoIs, reproduces the reference distributions and holds the DNS mean velocity profile, at $40\times$ lower online cost per simulated time unit than the high-fidelity simulation. These results establish reduced, QoI-based closures as an interpretable and inexpensive alternative to high-dimensional neural SGS models for LBM.

AI.tldr: 本文将Tau-orthogonal (TO) 框架引入格子Boltzmann方法(LBM)，以宏观速度强制实现，将建模目标从高维斯格子尺度(SGS)场转向少量感兴趣量(QoI)的时序动态，仅在宏观积分量层面进行闭合建模，并在二维Kolmogorov流与三维湍流槽道流上验证了其稳定性、精度与低成本优势。
AI.motivation: 大涡模拟(LES)的精度依赖亚格子尺度(SGS)模型，而高维SGS场建模（如神经SGS模型）往往复杂、缺乏可解释性且计算昂贵；作者希望建立一种降维、可解释且廉价的闭合方式，将建模对象从高维SGS场转为少量感兴趣量(QoI)的时间动态。
AI.method: 提出适用于LBM的Tau-orthogonal (TO) 框架，采用宏观速度强制；用预测-校正追踪过程生成训练数据，使粗网格模拟向参考QoI轨迹靠拢；采用带随机多元高斯残差的轻量线性回归模型(LRS)自主驱动LES；用紧凑卷积核替代原始公式中的锐利Fourier滤波器，从而解除对矩形周期域的限制。
AI.result: 在二维Kolmogorov流上，TO-LRS给出稳定且在统计上准确的在线LES，但解场中出现有界高频振荡；在三维湍流槽道流中（网格各方向比高保真参考粗5倍），原始BGK求解器不稳定，标定后的Smagorinsky与WALE模型对近壁流动过度耗散；TO-LRS叠加在涡黏基底上并加入平均剖面QoI后，能够重现参考分布并保持DNS平均速度剖面，在线计算成本比高保真模拟低40倍（每模拟时间单位）。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了基于QoI的降维闭合方法作为LBM中高维神经SGS模型的替代方案，具有可解释且成本低廉的特点，展示了在粗网格上实现稳定、统计准确的LES的可行性。

title: Smooth or Separable? Sparse Block Acceleration for Entropy-Regularized Linear Programs
summary: We study entropy-regularized linear programs with sparse affine constraints and compare two exact dual representations induced by whether a redundant normalization constraint is retained or eliminated. Eliminating it yields a partially separable sum-exp dual with sparse affine factors but unbounded curvature. Our main result is an accelerated randomized block method whose acceleration preserves sparse data-access cost. The key ingredient is a global entropy-specific Hessian--gap bound that remains valid for signed constraint matrices, admits computable block-overlap refinements, and provides deterministic curvature certificates before sampling. This geometry supports square-root importance sampling and an exact lazy implementation in which sparse arithmetic cost is weighted by local curvature rather than by a worst-block factor. We further introduce a gap-dependent curvature dimension that connects the generalized-smooth regime to the classical effective-rank intuition for coordinate methods. Retaining the normalization constraint yields a log-sum-exp dual with globally bounded higher derivatives, enabling gradient-regularized and cubic-regularized Newton methods. Experiments compare the resulting methods in terms of coordinate epochs, arithmetic operations, and wall-clock time, separating the effects of acceleration, touched-data sparsity, and problem-specific structure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究稀疏仿射约束下熵正则化线性规划的两种精确对偶表示，提出一种加速随机块方法，通过全局熵特定Hessian-gap界保持稀疏数据访问成本，并引入间隙依赖曲率维度连接广义平滑与有效秩直觉。
AI.motivation: 熵正则化线性规划的精确对偶表示存在两种选择：保留或消除冗余归一化约束。二者在结构上差异显著——消除归一化约束得到部分可分离的sum-exp对偶，具有稀疏仿射因子但曲率无界；这一无界曲率给加速与采样带来困难。作者希望系统比较两类表示并解决sum-exp对偶下的加速与稀疏性问题。
AI.method: 1) 对两种对偶表示进行比较分析。消除归一化约束得到部分可分离sum-exp对偶，稀疏仿射因子但曲率无界；保留归一化约束得到log-sum-exp对偶，高阶导数全局有界。2) 针对sum-exp对偶提出加速随机块方法，核心是一个全局熵特定Hessian-gap界，该界对有符号约束矩阵仍有效，允许可计算的块重叠细化，并在采样前提供确定性曲率证书。3) 基于该几何结构实现平方根重要性采样和精确惰性实现，使稀疏算术成本由局部曲率加权而非最坏块因子决定。4) 引入间隙依赖曲率维度，连接广义平滑与坐标方法经典有效秩直觉。5) 对log-sum-exp对偶应用梯度正则化与三次正则化牛顿法。6) 实验按坐标轮次、算术操作数与墙钟时间比较各方法，分离加速、接触数据稀疏性与问题特定结构的效果。
AI.result: 主要结果为：所提加速随机块方法的加速保持了稀疏数据访问成本；全局熵特定Hessian-gap界对有符号约束矩阵成立，支持平方根重要性采样与精确惰性实现；间隙依赖曲率维度建立了广义平滑与经典有效秩直觉的联系。实验中按坐标轮次、算术操作数和墙钟时间对比两类对偶下各方法，分离出加速、接触数据稀疏性与问题特定结构各自的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 消除归一化约束的sum-exp对偶虽然曲率无界，但借助熵特定Hessian-gap几何可实现保持稀疏访问成本的加速；保留归一化约束的log-sum-exp对偶则适合高阶正则化牛顿法。两类表示各有优势，具体选择取决于对曲率控制与稀疏算术效率的权衡。

title: Overfitting of Spectral Gradient Descent: How Matrix Geometry shapes Generalization and Implicit Bias
summary: We study the generalization of spectral gradient descent (SpecGD) in overparameterized matrix classification with corrupted labels. Each input combines a shared low-rank signal with a rank-one sample-specific perturbation, referred to as a shortcut, that enables memorization but does not generalize. We contrast collapsed shortcuts, which share a singular direction, with dispersed shortcuts, which occupy distinct singular directions. Changing only this geometry can reverse the relative generalization of GD and SpecGD: collapsed shortcuts can favor SpecGD, while dispersed shortcuts can favor GD. In the dispersed regime, exact shortcut orthogonality eliminates the signal from the late-stage SpecGD direction, while vanishing random correlations collectively generate a small but generalization-relevant signal through a second-order effect. To identify the direction selected by SpecGD, which the spectral max-margin problem alone does not determine, we combine a refined analysis of its dual with the exponentiated-gradient dynamics of normalized loss weights. Finally, we show that a single SpecGD step can already interpolate and generalize well, while continued training converges to a direction with substantially worse generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带标签噪声的过参数矩阵分类中谱梯度下降（SpecGD）的泛化性，揭示捷径（shortcut）的几何结构——坍缩与分散——会反转 GD 与 SpecGD 的相对泛化优劣。
AI.motivation: 过参数化模型中，模型既能记忆噪声又能泛化，其中"捷径"特征（可记忆但不泛化）的作用机制尚不清楚。作者希望理解为何不同算法（GD 与 SpecGD）在同一数据分布下会表现出相反的泛化行为，并澄清捷径几何结构对算法选择的影响。
AI.method: 设定输入为共享低秩信号加上秩一的样本特定扰动（捷径）。对比两类捷径几何：坍缩捷径（共享同一奇异方向）与分散捷径（占据不同奇异方向）。对 SpecGD 的晚期方向进行分析，结合其原始-对偶问题的精细刻画与归一化损失权重的指数梯度动力学，确定 SpecGD 实际选择的方向；并考察单步 SpecGD 与持续训练的表现差异。
AI.result: 仅改变捷径几何即可反转 GD 与 SpecGD 的相对泛化：坍缩捷径下 SpecGD 更优，分散捷径下 GD 更优。在分散情形中，精确的捷径正交性会从晚期 SpecGD 方向中消除信号，而微小的随机相关性通过二阶效应集体生成一个虽小但与泛化相关的信号。此外，单步 SpecGD 已能实现插值并具备良好泛化，而继续训练会收敛到泛化显著更差的方向。
AI.conclusion: 捷径的奇异方向几何是决定 GD 与 SpecGD 泛化优劣的关键因素；SpecGD 的方向选择需借助对偶分析与权重动力学共同确定；训练步数并非越多越好——早期停止（甚至单步）可能优于充分收敛。

title: A merged-cell discontinuous Galerkin method for scalar conservation laws on curved domains
summary: We analyse a discontinuous Galerkin method for two-dimensional scalar conservation laws on curved domains. Small intersections of a Cartesian grid with the domain are combined by rectangular cell merging. The local space is the restriction of $\mathbb Q_k$ to each physical merged cell. An entropy-conservative flux is supplemented by face viscosity and, for odd degrees, a skew derivative-jump correction on unmerged interior squares. We prove exact semidiscrete $L^2$ dissipation and an optimal error estimate for every fixed $k\ge1$. For smooth solutions with homogeneous trace on the entire boundary, the semi-discrete method satisfies an $O(h^{k+1})$ error bound. The constants are independent of the original cut-cell area fractions. The proof combines a physical-cell $L^2$ projection and cancellation of regular-face projection errors. A separate semidiscrete result covers linear transport with upwind inflow data. Computations for Burgers' equation on a disk and linear advection on a smooth star exhibit orders close to $k+1$ for $k=1,2,3$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并分析了一种针对曲边界区域上二维标量守恒律的不连续Galerkin方法，通过矩形单元合并处理笛卡尔网格与区域的小交集，结合熵守恒通量、面黏性及奇数阶偏斜导数跳跃修正，证明了半离散L²耗散性与最优误差估计，并用数值实验验证了接近k+1的收敛阶。
AI.motivation: 曲边界区域上的守恒律数值求解常受小切割单元（cut-cell）问题困扰：笛卡尔网格与区域边界相交会产生面积分数极小的单元，导致显式时间步长受限与稳定性、精度退化。作者希望在保持笛卡尔网格便利性的同时，克服小切割单元带来的困难，并给出与切割面积分数无关的误差常数。
AI.method: 采用矩形单元合并（cell merging）将网格与区域的小交集与相邻单元合并为非结构化的物理合并单元；局部空间取Q_k在每个物理合并单元上的限制。通量使用熵守恒通量，并附加面黏性（face viscosity）；对奇数阶k，在未合并的内部正方形上增加偏斜导数跳跃修正（skew derivative-jump correction）。证明结合物理单元上的L²投影与正则面投影误差的抵消技巧，得到半离散L²耗散与最优误差估计，并单独给出带迎风入流数据的线性输运的半离散结果。
AI.result: 证明了精确的半离散L²耗散，以及对任意固定k≥1的最优误差估计；对于整个边界上具有齐次迹的光滑解，半离散方法满足O(h^{k+1})误差界，且常数与原始切割单元面积分数无关。对圆盘上的Burgers方程与光滑星形区域上的线性对流进行的数值计算显示，k=1,2,3时收敛阶接近k+1。
AI.conclusion: 该单元合并的不连续Galerkin方法有效解决了曲边界守恒律中小切割单元引起的稳定性与精度问题，理论误差界与切割面积分数无关，数值结果与理论阶数一致，验证了方法的鲁棒性与最优收敛性。

title: Grounding Vision-Language Models in Driving Semantics: A Multi-Dataset Predicate Framework for Explainable Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models are increasingly used for driving-scene understanding, yet the semantic relations expressed in their outputs are often difficult to verify against the underlying traffic situation. This paper introduces a deterministic multi-dataset predicate framework that derives driving-scene semantics from measurable geometric, kinematic, temporal, map, and traffic-control evidence. Dataset-specific interfaces are used only to recover the required scene information, while predicate definitions remain unchanged across nuPlan and nuScenes and are materialised in a common Predicate Knowledge Graph. Quantitative semantic validation against manually annotated predicate relations on 200 scenarios from each dataset yields macro F1 scores of 0.94 on nuPlan and 0.93 on nuScenes, with an average cross-dataset difference of 0.02 across the shared predicates. The Predicate KG is further evaluated using a frozen LLaVA-OneVision-7B model on the nine NuPlanQA subtasks. Predicate grounding achieves the highest accuracy among the evaluated visual-input conditions in seven of nine NuPlanQA subtasks, including Traffic Light (53.2% to 71.5%), Situation Assessment (76.2% to 86.1%), and Action Recommendation (82.9% to 89.0%). Weather/Lighting remains essentially unchanged (89.4% vs. 88.8%), consistent with the absence of corresponding predicates, while Predicate KG only input outperforms metadata-only input in eight of nine subtasks. The results show that deterministic predicates provide a consistent and traceable semantic representation and, under oracle grounding, can reduce visual dependence for reasoning tasks covered by the predicate vocabulary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种确定性的多数据集谓词框架，从可测量的几何、运动学、时序、地图和交通控制证据中推导驾驶场景语义，并在nuPlan与nuScenes上以统一的谓词定义构建通用谓词知识图谱（Predicate KG）。该表示可跨数据集一致地验证语义关系，并在冻结LLaVA-OneVision-7B的NuPlanQA九个子任务中提升多数推理任务的准确率。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型越来越多地用于驾驶场景理解，但其输出中表达的语义关系往往难以与真实交通情境进行核对，缺乏可验证性与可追溯性。作者希望提供一种确定性的、可跨数据集复用的语义表示，使驾驶场景语义能够被量化验证，并减少推理任务对视觉输入的依赖。
AI.method: 提出确定性的多数据集谓词框架：从几何、运动学、时序、地图与交通控制等可测量证据出发推导驾驶场景语义；数据集特定接口仅用于恢复所需场景信息，谓词定义在nuPlan与nuScenes间保持不变，并统一物化为Predicate Knowledge Graph。在每数据集200个场景上与人工标注的谓词关系进行语义验证；再用冻结的LLaVA-OneVision-7B在NuPlanQA九个子任务上评估谓词接地与仅Predicate KG输入的效用。
AI.result: 语义验证的宏F1在nuPlan为0.94、nuScenes为0.93，共享谓词的平均跨数据集差异为0.02。谓词接地在九个子任务中的七个取得最高准确率，包括Traffic Light（53.2%→71.5%）、Situation Assessment（76.2%→86.1%）、Action Recommendation（82.9%→89.0%）；Weather/Lighting基本不变（89.4% vs. 88.8%），与缺少对应谓词一致；仅Predicate KG输入在九个子任务中的八个优于仅元数据输入。
AI.conclusion: 确定性谓词提供了一致且可追溯的语义表示；在oracle grounding条件下，可降低谓词词汇所覆盖推理任务对视觉信息的依赖，且谓词定义可跨数据集稳定复用。

title: A generalized Terao Conjecture for line arrangements
summary: For a line arrangement $\mathcal{A} \colon f=0$ in $\mathbb{P}^2$, let $ν(\mathcal{A})$ be the maximal dimension of a graded piece of the Jacobian module of $f$. We study the conjecture that $ν(\mathcal{A})$ depends only on the intersection lattice of $\mathcal{A}$. It is known that $\mathcal{A}$ is free if and only if $ν(\mathcal{A})=0$, and hence this conjecture is a strengthening of Terao's conjecture for line arrangements. We show that the conjecture holds for arrangements of at most $13$ lines, except possibly for arrangements of exactly $13$ lines whose intersection points have maximal multiplicity $5$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究平面直线构型的雅可比模分次块最大维数 ν(𝒜) 是否仅由交格决定这一猜想，并证明对不超过 13 条直线的构型该猜想成立（13 条且最大重数为 5 的情形可能除外）。
AI.motivation: 该猜想是 Terao 猜想在直线构型情形下的加强：已知 𝒜 自由当且仅当 ν(𝒜)=0，因此若 ν 仅依赖交格，则自由性也仅依赖交格。作者希望验证这一更强的不变量是否确实由交格决定。
AI.method: 对直线构型的雅可比模分次块最大维数 ν(𝒜) 进行研究，并将其与交格的关系进行系统分析，通过分类和计算验证小规模构型。
AI.result: 证明了该猜想对所有不超过 13 条直线的构型成立；唯一可能例外是恰好 13 条直线且交点最大重数为 5 的构型。
AI.conclusion: ν(𝒜) 由交格决定这一猜想在 13 条线以下（几乎完全）得到验证，为 Terao 猜想的加强版本提供了有力支持。

title: Quantum Dynamics of Full Counting Statistics in Fermionic Lattices with Localized Gain
summary: We investigate the dynamics of full counting statistics (FCS) of the growth of the total number of fermions in a one-dimensional non-interacting lattice subjected to a localized particle gain (source) at one edge. The dynamics of the setup is modeled by the Gorini--Kossakowski--Sudarshan--Lindblad (GKSL) quantum master equation. We recast the counting problem that involves counting particle number at every lattice site to a problem where only the local injected site is involved. We employ the Schwinger-Keldysh path integral formalism within the GKSL framework and derive an analytical expression for the cumulant generating function at arbitrary times and obtain a Levitov-Lesovik type formula in the long-time limit, earlier derived for boundary driven setups in the steady-state. For clean lattices with either short- or long-range hopping, supporting single-particle delocalized eigenstates, we show that all cumulants grow linearly with time in the asymptotic regime. Our analytical results are in excellent agreement with direct numerical simulations. These findings establish a general framework for characterizing FCS and quantum fluctuations in driven open fermionic systems with localized particle injection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一维无相互作用费米子晶格在单端局域粒子注入下的全计数统计（FCS）动力学，利用GKSL框架下的Schwinger-Keldysh路径积分推导了任意时刻累积量生成函数的解析表达式，并得到长时极限下的Levitov-Lesovik型公式；结果表明，在支持单粒子离域本征态的清洁晶格中（短程或长程跃迁），所有累积量在渐近区随时间线性增长，且与直接数值模拟高度吻合。
AI.motivation: 驱动耗散开放量子系统中粒子注入引起的量子涨落与全计数统计尚缺乏统一、可解析的理论框架，尤其在局域粒子注入与长时极限行为方面需要更一般的刻画。
AI.method: 采用GKSL量子主方程描述一维无相互作用晶格在单端局域粒子增益下的动力学；将逐格点计数问题重写为仅涉及局域注入格点的计数问题；在GKSL框架内使用Schwinger-Keldysh路径积分推导任意时刻累积量生成函数的解析表达式，并获得长时极限的Levitov-Lesovik型公式。
AI.result: 得到了任意时刻累积量生成函数的解析表达；在长时极限下复现了此前针对边界驱动稳态系统得到的Levitov-Lesovik型公式；对于支持单粒子离域本征态的清洁晶格（短程或长程跃迁），证明所有累积量在渐近区随时间线性增长；解析结果与直接数值模拟高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为局域粒子注入的驱动开放费米子系统建立了刻画全计数统计与量子涨落的一般框架，并揭示了离域单粒子本征态下累积量的线性时间增长规律。

title: Collapse of white dwarfs above the Chandrasekhar mass
summary: We give a dynamical characterization of the Chandrasekhar mass for cold white dwarfs governed by the radial Euler--Poisson equations with the exact Chandrasekhar equation of state. This mass is the infimum of masses for which a finite-energy classical solution with a physical vacuum can contract its entire support to a point in finite time. Below it, conservation of energy prevents complete collapse. For every mass in a sufficiently small interval above it, we construct a solution whose support shrinks to the origin and whose density concentrates there with the full mass of the star. The interior approaches a collapsing Goldreich--Weber profile. Near the vacuum boundary, a different rescaling gives a limiting profile that connects the high- and low-density regimes of the pressure law. We determine this profile and show that, after adding the electron rest energy, the conserved energy equals that of the Goldreich--Weber reference solution. The proof combines matched asymptotic expansions with local existence and energy estimates that extend solutions backward from times approaching collapse to a common earlier time.

AI.tldr: 本文对由径向Euler–Poisson方程和精确Chandrasekhar状态方程描述的超冷白矮星，给出了Chandrasekhar质量的动力学刻画：该质量是能使有限能量经典解在有限时间内将整个支撑收缩到一点的质量下确界；低于该质量时能量守恒阻止完全坍缩。对于略高于该质量的每个质量，构造出支撑收缩至原点、密度集中并携带全部星体质量的解，内部趋于坍缩的Goldreich–Weber剖面，真空边界附近通过不同重标度得到连接压力律高、低密度区的极限剖面，并证明加入电子静止能量后守恒能量等于Goldreich–Weber参考解的能量。
AI.motivation: Chandrasekhar质量是白矮星稳定性的经典临界值，但既有研究多基于静态或变分观点，缺乏从动力学坍缩角度对其的刻画；本文旨在建立该临界质量的动力学特征，并刻画临界质量以上的完全坍缩解结构。
AI.method: 采用径向Euler–Poisson方程配合精确Chandrasekhar状态方程；将匹配渐近展开与局部存在性、能量估计相结合，通过从接近坍缩的时刻向后延拓解到共同的更早时刻完成证明；并利用不同重标度分别分析内部区域与真空边界附近的极限剖面。
AI.result: 证明Chandrasekhar质量等于可发生有限时间完全坍缩（支撑收缩至一点）的有限能量经典解的质量下确界；低于该质量时能量守恒阻止完全坍缩；对略高于该质量的每个质量构造出支撑收缩至原点且密度集中全部星体质量的解；内部趋于坍缩的Goldreich–Weber剖面；真空边界附近得到连接压力律高、低密度区的极限剖面，并证明加入电子静止能量后守恒能量等于Goldreich–Weber参考解的能量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以动力学方式重新刻画了Chandrasekhar质量，揭示了临界质量附近白矮星坍缩的精细时空结构（内部Goldreich–Weber型坍缩与边界跨密度区过渡剖面），并建立了与Goldreich–Weber参考解的能量对应关系。

title: Phase-field simulation of interfacial stability in structured gas-liquid contactors: design rules for gas diffusion electrodes
summary: Many process engineering applications hold a gas-liquid interface stationary inside a structured solid by a controlled pressure difference. Gas diffusion electrodes (GDEs) are one such case, where the interface separates the liquid electrolyte from the gaseous reactant. Maintaining it is particularly challenging in organic electrosynthesis, where low surface tensions lower the admissible pressures throughout and small contact angles leave the electrode with little margin against flooding. Here, we quantify how the shape, wettability, and three-dimensional topology of a structured medium set this window, using phase-field simulations of the Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes equations. Each geometry is characterised by its Laplace pressure curve, which yields both the maximum admissible pressure difference and the stiffness of the interface against pressure fluctuations. For single flat orifices at constant open area, elongating the opening from an aspect ratio of one to six raises the admissible pressure difference by 40 % and the stiffness by a factor of 3.3. Comparison with slits of equal width shows that this gain originates entirely from the reduced opening width. Sheared, diamond shaped openings are markedly less effective. In woven meshes, the wettability displaces the operating window several times as far as it stretches it. A less wetting surface therefore buys flooding margin largely at the expense of breakthrough margin, whereas the geometric route, established here for flat openings, widens the window itself. From these results we derive design rules for structured gas-liquid contactors and improved GDE architectures for organic electrosynthesis.

AI.tldr: 通过Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes相场模拟，量化结构介质的形状、润湿性与三维拓扑对气液界面稳定操作窗口的调控，并据此提出结构气体-液体接触器与GDE的设计准则。
AI.motivation: 在有机电合成等过程中，需借助受控压差将气液界面稳定在结构化固体内部（如气体扩散电极GDE）。低表面张力会整体降低允许压力，而小接触角使电极抗泛滥的裕度极小，界面维持尤为困难，因此需要明确几何与润湿性如何决定这一操作窗口。
AI.method: 采用Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes方程的相场模拟，对具有不同形状、润湿性和三维拓扑的结构化介质进行模拟；以Laplace压力曲线表征每个几何构型，从中提取最大允许压差（突破裕度）与界面抗压力波动的刚度。
AI.result: 对恒定开口面积的单一平面孔口，将开口长宽比从1拉伸至6，可使允许压差提高40%，刚度提高3.3倍；与等宽狭缝对比表明该增益完全源于开口宽度的减小。剪切菱形开口效果明显更差。在编织网中，润湿性对操作窗口的位移（数倍）远大于其对窗口的拉伸；即降低润湿性主要以牺牲突破裕度换取泛滥裕度，而几何路径则能真正拓宽窗口。
AI.conclusion: 几何调控（如拉长平面开口）可同时提高允许压差与界面刚度，从而真正扩大操作窗口；润湿性调节主要造成窗口平移而非拓宽。据此提出结构化气体-液体接触器的设计规则，以及面向有机电合成的改进GDE架构。

title: Effect of Porous Coating on the Water-Exit Dynamics of a Circular Cylinder
summary: The effect of a porous coating on the water-exit dynamics of a circular cylinder is investigated experimentally. Cylinders comprising a $30~\mathrm{mm}$ solid core surrounded by a $10~\mathrm{mm}$-thick porous foam layer with pore densities of 10, 20, and 60 pores per inch (PPI) are compared with a smooth cylinder of the same outer diameter. Experiments are performed over $1.50\times10^{4}\leq Re\leq5.00\times10^{4}$ and $0.37\leq Fr\leq4.08$. Time-resolved particle image velocimetry characterizes the wake and reconstructed pressure field, while proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) examines its energetic organization. All porous cylinders reduce free-surface elevation relative to the smooth cylinder, with the largest reduction generally obtained for 60 PPI. The submerged wake, however, is not simply weakened. Porous cases generally develop larger circulation and vortex area, with a non-monotonic dependence on pore density and operating condition. The 10 PPI cylinder frequently produces the largest vortex region, whereas 60 PPI generates stronger negative pressure within the vortex and the largest integrated vortex-associated pressure deficit for $Fr=1.02$, $2.00$, and $4.08$. During the submerged approach to contact, this pressure deficit co-evolves strongly with circulation, with Pearson correlation coefficients typically between $0.90$ and $0.98$. POD shows that 9--18 modes recover 95\% of the modal energy, with 20 PPI requiring only 9--10 modes. Overall, porous coating reorganizes wake strength, extent, pressure signature, and energetic structure while reducing the free-surface response.

AI.tldr: 实验研究了多孔泡沫涂层对圆柱出水动力学的影响，发现涂层虽降低自由面抬升，但并未削弱水下尾流，反而重组了涡量、压力与能量结构。
AI.motivation: 圆柱出水涉及自由面与尾流的强耦合，工程中常以多孔涂层调控流动；但涂层对出水过程中尾流强度、压力特征及能量组织的影响机制尚不明确，需要定量实验表征。
AI.method: 对比实验：直径30 mm实心芯+10 mm厚多孔泡沫层（10、20、60 PPI）与同外径光滑圆柱。参数范围1.50×10^4≤Re≤5.00×10^4、0.37≤Fr≤4.08。采用时间分辨PIV获取尾流并重建压力场，结合本征正交分解（POD）分析能量结构。
AI.result: 所有多孔圆柱均降低自由面抬升，60 PPI通常降幅最大；但水下尾流并非单纯减弱，多孔工况环量与涡面积总体更大，且随孔密度和工况呈非单调依赖。10 PPI常产生最大涡区，60 PPI在Fr=1.02、2.00、4.08时涡内负压更强、积分涡致压力亏损最大。浸没接近接触阶段，压力亏损与环量协同演化，Pearson相关系数多在0.90–0.98。POD显示9–18阶模态可恢复95%模态能量，20 PPI仅需9–10阶。
AI.conclusion: 多孔涂层在降低自由面响应的同时，会重组尾流强度、空间范围、压力特征与能量结构，其效果对孔密度和运行工况高度敏感，需按具体Fr/Re进行设计选型。

title: Scattering for the quadratic NLS system in $\mathbb{R}^{5}$ without mass resonance or radial symmetry

AI.tldr: 证明了在非质量共振条件（κ≠1/2）下，五维二次NLS系统在基态以下、无径向对称的一般解仍具有散射性。
AI.motivation: 此前在κ=1/2（质量共振条件）下已有基态以下的散射结果；在κ≠1/2时仅对径向解证明了散射。本文旨在去掉径向对称假设，证明一般（非径向）解的散射性。
AI.method: 基于Kenig–Merle（2006）的集中紧性—刚性方法。刚性论证中沿用Pausader（2010）的思路，在与动量正交的方向上使用局部化virial（能量/恒等）论证。
AI.result: 证明了当κ≠1/2时，五维二次NLS系统在基态以下、任意（非径向）初值解的散射性。
AI.conclusion: 将κ≠1/2情形下的散射结果从径向解推广到无径向对称的一般解，完成了该情形下基态以下散射问题的完整刻画。

title: Optimal Reinsurance-Dividend Strategy with Fixed Transaction Costs in a Regime-Switching Brownian Risk Model: A Viscosity Solution to the Impulse Control Problem
summary: We consider a problem of optimal proportional reinsurance-dividend distribution under a Brownian risk model, where both the drift and volatility coefficients are subject to endogenous regime-switching. Dividend payments are subject to fixed transaction costs. The problem is formulated as a two-dimensional stochastic control problem, and we prove that the value function is the unique viscosity solution of the associated Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation with nonlocal operator. For almost all parameter configurations, we explicitly characterize the optimal strategy that maximizes the expected total discounted dividends net of transaction costs until ruin. The optimal dividend policy is a two-barrier impulsive strategy, while the optimal reinsurance proportion is given in feedback form. Numerical examples are provided to illustrate the optimality results.

AI.tldr: 研究内生机制转换Brownian风险模型下的最优比例再保险与带固定交易成本的分红问题,证明值函数为HJB方程唯一粘性解,并刻画最优策略。
AI.motivation: 在Brownian风险模型中,漂移与波动系数常受经济环境变化影响,且分红存在固定交易成本。引入内生机制转换与交易成本可更贴近现实,但导致问题变为带非局部算子的二维随机控制问题,求解困难,故需研究其最优策略。
AI.method: 将问题建模为二维随机控制问题,其中漂移与波动系数均具内生机制转换,分红支付含固定交易成本;证明值函数是相关含非局部算子的Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman(HJB)方程的唯一粘性解。
AI.result: 对几乎所有参数配置,显式刻画了在破产前最大化扣除交易成本后期望总折现分红的最优策略:最优分红为两障碍脉冲策略,最优再保险比例为反馈形式,并通过数值算例验证最优性结论。
AI.conclusion: 该研究在带内生机制转换与固定交易成本的Brownian风险模型中,完整给出了最优再保险-分红策略的粘性解刻画与显式形式,分红为两障碍脉冲策略,再保险为反馈策略。

title: AECSF: Adaptive Ensemble Conditional Score Filtering for High-Dimensional Nonlinear Data Assimilation
summary: Bayesian state estimation for high-dimensional nonlinear dynamical systems entails a fundamental tension between statistical fidelity and computational tractability, as particle weights can collapse, while Gaussian ensemble updates can miss non-Gaussian posterior structure. Score-based diffusion filters offer a sampling-based alternative, but existing training-free score filters often rely on heuristic likelihood corrections, which can compromise posterior accuracy by neglecting uncertainty about the system state associated with each noisy reverse particle. To address these issues, we propose AECSF, a training-free adaptive ensemble conditional score filter. AECSF constructs an analytically tractable score estimator from the conditional Tweedie identity, which recasts noisy posterior score estimation as estimating the conditional mean of the system state given a noisy reverse particle and the observation. To estimate these conditional means efficiently, AECSF employs a shared adaptive weighted proposal ensemble, while particle-specific conditional weights yield an estimate for each noisy reverse particle without separate proposal sampling. The proposal ensemble is updated using reverse-particle information within the same reverse-diffusion run to improve conditional-mean estimation. Theoretically, we characterize when a fixed weighted proposal measure yields the exact noisy posterior score. Under stated assumptions, we establish a bound relating conditional-mean estimation errors to reverse-sampling endpoint error. Numerical experiments demonstrate that AECSF improves the accuracy of posterior sampling and nonlinear filtering in high-dimensional problems with limited forecast ensembles.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练自适应集合条件得分滤波器AECSF，用条件Tweedie恒等式构造可解析的得分估计器，以共享自适应加权提议集合高效估计条件均值，提升高维非线性滤波的后验采样精度。
AI.motivation: 高维非线性动力系统的贝叶斯状态估计面临统计保真度与计算可处理性的矛盾：粒子权重会退化坍塌，而高斯集合更新会忽略非高斯后验结构。基于得分的扩散滤波虽提供采样替代方案，但现有免训练得分滤波依赖启发式似然修正，忽略了与每个含噪反向粒子相关的系统状态不确定性，从而损害后验精度。
AI.method: AECSF基于条件Tweedie恒等式构建可解析处理的得分估计器，将含噪后验得分估计转化为在给定含噪反向粒子与观测条件下系统状态的条件均值估计；采用共享自适应加权提议集合高效估计这些条件均值，粒子特定的条件权重可为每个含噪反向粒子给出估计而无需单独采样提议；并在同一反向扩散过程中利用反向粒子信息更新提议集合以改善条件均值估计。
AI.result: 理论上刻画了固定加权提议测度产生精确含噪后验得分的条件；在既定假设下建立了将条件均值估计误差与反向采样终点误差相联系的误差界。数值实验表明，在有限预报集合的高维问题中，AECSF提升了后验采样与非线性滤波的精度。
AI.conclusion: AECSF通过条件Tweedie恒等式与共享自适应加权提议集合，避免了启发式似然修正，实现了免训练且高效的高维非线性系统后验采样，并在理论与实验上验证了其精度优势。

title: Wave Breaking and Structure-Preserving Fully Discrete Method for Stochastic Camassa--Holm Equation with Additive Noise
summary: In this article, we investigate the stochastic Camassa--Holm equation driven by additive noise, which models nonlinear shallow-water waves under random external forcing. We establish that, almost surely, any finite-time breakdown occurs through wave breaking: the wave amplitude and the positive part of the slope remain bounded, whereas the minimum slope tends to $-\infty$. Under an additional moment assumption, we derive an initial-slope condition ensuring wave breaking with positive probability. We also formulate the equation as a stochastic Hamiltonian PDE, establish its stochastic multi-symplectic conservation law, and derive the evolution law for the averaged $H^1$ energy. Combining the Fourier--Galerkin method, symplectic Runge--Kutta integration, and exact solution of the linear stochastic subsystem, we propose a fully discrete method which preserves an integrated discrete stochastic multi-symplectic conservation law and the linear growth of the discrete averaged \(H^1\) energy. Under suitable regularity and resolution assumptions, we present that the fully discrete dynamics retain the slope-steepening mechanism responsible for wave breaking, providing a discrete counterpart of the continuous behavior.

AI.tldr: 研究加性噪声驱动的随机Camassa--Holm方程，证明破缺必为波浪破碎并给出初始斜率条件，揭示其随机Hamiltonian结构与多辛守恒律，构造保结构的全离散格式。
AI.motivation: 随机外强迫下的非线性浅水波（随机Camassa--Holm方程）的有限时间破缺机制尚不清楚，需要判定破缺类型、给出发生波浪破碎的初始条件，并设计能保持连续模型几何结构与能量律的数值方法。
AI.method: 理论上将方程表述为随机Hamiltonian PDE，建立随机多辛守恒律并推导平均H^1能量的演化律；数值上结合Fourier--Galerkin离散、辛Runge--Kutta时间积分与线性随机子系统的精确解，构造全离散格式。
AI.result: 几乎必然地，任何有限时间破缺都通过波浪破碎发生：波幅与斜率正部保持有界，而最小斜率趋于负无穷；在额外矩假设下得到保证波浪破碎以正概率发生的初始斜率条件。所提全离散格式保持积分形式的离散随机多辛守恒律与离散平均H^1能量的线性增长，并在适当正则性与分辨率假设下复现导致波浪破碎的斜率陡化机制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作刻画了随机Camassa--Holm方程破缺的波浪破碎本质，给出了波浪破碎的正概率判据，并提供了保持随机多辛结构与能量律的保结构数值方法，实现连续行为与离散动力学的一致性。

title: FIDAL: Diversity-Aware Federated Active Learning Under Real-World Distribution Shifts
summary: Federated learning enables collaborative model training across institutions without centralizing data, yet high annotation costs, domain shifts, and class imbalance remain major obstacles, especially when irrelevant out-of-distribution (OOD) samples dilute the labeled data. Existing active learning methods target uncertainty or diversity within in-distribution (ID) data and overlook unknown samples in federated clinical settings. We propose FIDAL, an open-set federated active learning framework that combines calibrated global-local evidential uncertainty, support-set diversity weighting, and adaptive OOD rejection. The rejection gate thresholds a foundation-model Gaussian-coverage signal per client and per round with Otsu's criterion, so that highly informative ID samples are queried while irrelevant outliers are excluded without any hand-tuned threshold. Evaluated on three multi-center medical imaging benchmarks (dermatology, histopathology, and mammography with organically occurring artifacts) in realistic open-set scenarios, FIDAL outperforms detector-based open-set methods by up to about 12 percentage points of balanced accuracy and is the only method on the accuracy-ID purity Pareto front of all three benchmarks. At an equal query budget it spends at least 1.3 times fewer annotations on OOD samples than every accuracy-matched baseline, saving an estimated 7-29 hours of expert reading on the mammography benchmark. By labeling only a fraction of the data pool, it matches or exceeds fully supervised performance across modalities. These results highlight the value of integrating uncertainty, diversity, and OOD rejection in open-set federated active learning for medicine.

AI.tldr: 提出FIDAL开放集联邦主动学习框架，融合证据不确定性、支持集多样性加权与自适应OOD拒绝，在三大多中心医学影像基准上显著优于检测器类开放集方法。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习可在不集中数据的前提下协作训练，但标注成本高、域偏移、类别不平衡，且无关的分布外（OOD）样本会稀释已标注数据。现有主动学习方法只关注分布内（ID）数据的不确定性或多样性，忽略联邦临床场景中的未知样本。
AI.method: FIDAL包含三部分：(1) 校准的全局-局部证据不确定性；(2) 支持集多样性加权；(3) 自适应OOD拒绝。拒绝门控基于基础模型的高斯覆盖信号，按客户端、按轮次用Otsu准则自动确定阈值，从而查询高信息量ID样本并排除无关离群点，无需手工调阈值。
AI.result: 在皮肤病学、组织病理学和乳腺X线摄影（含自然出现的伪影）三个多中心医学影像基准的开放集场景中，FIDAL相比基于检测器的开放集方法最多提升约12个百分点的平衡准确率，且是唯一同时位于三个基准准确率-ID纯度帕累托前沿的方法。相同查询预算下，其用于OOD样本的标注量至少比所有准确率相当的基线少1.3倍，在乳腺X线基准上估计节省7-29小时专家阅片时间；仅标注一部分数据池即可匹配或超越全监督性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在面向医学的开放集联邦主动学习中，整合不确定性、多样性与OOD拒绝具有重要价值。

title: Uniform Unicellular Dessins d'Enfants with Trivial Automorphism Groups
summary:
A Belyĭ function on a smooth projective algebraic curve defined over a number field determines a bipartite graph called a dessin d'enfant.
  We study the regularity and automorphism groups of dessins with uniform passports. In previous papers, we proved that every passport of the form $[n,n,n]$, $[n,b^{q},n]$, or $[b^{q},b^{q},n]$ of genus at least $2$ admits a dessin with trivial automorphism group. In this paper, we prove the analogous result for passports of the form $[a^{p},b^{q},n]$. The proof is mainly based on a counting argument: we compare a lower bound for the number of permutation representations having the prescribed passport with an upper bound for the number admitting a nontrivial automorphism. Together with our previous results, this shows that every uniform unicellular passport of genus at least $2$ admits a dessin with trivial automorphism group.

AI.tldr: 本文证明形如 $[a^{p},b^{q},n]$ 的 passport（亏格至少为 2）存在自同构群平凡的 dessin，从而与既往结果结合得出：任意亏格至少为 2 的 uniform unicellular passport 都存在自同构群平凡的 dessin。
AI.motivation: 研究 dessin d'enfant 的正则性与自同构群，特别是判定哪些 passport 能实现自同构群平凡的 dessin。作者此前已解决 $[n,n,n]$、$[n,b^{q},n]$、$[b^{q},b^{q},n]$ 三类 passport，本文旨在补全 $[a^{p},b^{q},n]$ 这一般情形。
AI.method: 计数论证：将具有给定 passport 的置换表示数量的下界，与允许非平凡自同构的置换表示数量的上界进行比较，证明存在性。
AI.result: 证明形如 $[a^{p},b^{q},n]$ 且亏格至少为 2 的 passport 存在自同构群平凡的 dessin。
AI.conclusion: 结合既往工作，所有亏格至少为 2 的 uniform unicellular passport 均存在自同构群平凡的 dessin。

title: Non-stationary Statistics and Energetics of Brownian Motion under Stochastic Harmonic Confinement
summary: We investigate the positional statistics and thermodynamic properties of a Brownian particle confined in a Harmonic trap. The stiffness of the particle fluctuates in time as the square of the Brownian process. First, in the absence of a thermal bath, we investigate the probability density function of the position of the particle at time $t$. Then, we provide an expression to compute the $n$th positional moment. We evaluate the first four positional moments and discuss their asymptotic behavior in the long-time limit. In contrast to previously studied models of fluctuating stiffness, the current model describes a non-stationary process. Furthermore, we provide the exact expression for the average work performed on the system and the average heat exchanged by the particle with the bath. Their long time behavior again reflects the non-stationary nature of the process. Our theoretical predictions are supported by numerical simulations.

AI.tldr: 研究了谐振阱中刚度按布朗过程平方随时间涨落的布朗粒子的位置统计与热力学性质，发现该模型为非平稳过程，并给出功与热的精确表达式。
AI.motivation: 已有关于涨落刚度模型的研究多针对平稳过程，而刚度按布朗过程平方涨落的情形尚未被充分探讨，其非平稳特性对位置统计和热力学量的影响值得深入分析。
AI.method: 在无热浴条件下推导粒子位置的概率密度函数及第n阶位置矩的表达式；借助数值模拟验证第一至四阶位置矩的渐近行为，并计算对系统做功的平均值与粒子与热浴交换的平均热的精确表达式。
AI.result: 给出了位置概率密度函数与位置矩的计算公式，分析了前四阶矩的长时间渐近行为，得到了平均功与平均热的精确表达式；数值模拟结果与理论预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 该模型描述的是非平稳过程，其位置矩及功、热的长时间行为均体现了非平稳特征，理论与数值结果相互支持。

title: E3J: An Efficient and Open-Source Backend for Euclidean Equivariant Operations on GPU and TPU
summary: We present e3j, a fast Euclid-equivariance backend for geometric deep learning applications with JAX bindings for GPU and TPU. Leveraging both optimized CUDA and Pallas kernels and algorithmic improvements, the library achieves state-of-the-art throughput and runtime on both forward and backward paths. On a machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) use case, it outperforms established backends, measuring up to 34% speed-up over cuEquivariance on water box NPT simulation using MACE, while remaining fully open source. E3j achieves over 80% efficiency over the H100 maximum memory bandwidth on tensor product operations, and in many cases more than doubles throughput of message passing convolutions forward compared to previously available backends. In addition, with the release of dedicated Pallas TPU kernel, e3j opens the possibility of large scale equivariant deep learning workloads on TPU architectures, which has so far been difficult to achieve. Our benchmarks show that e3j also achieves over 80% of a TPUv6e memory bandwidth, up to one order of magnitude more than e3nn-jax. The library is available on GitHub, PyPI and is released under an open source Apache 2.0 license.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 e3j——一个快速的 Euclid 等变几何深度学习后端，提供 JAX 的 GPU/TPU 绑定，在性能上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有等变几何深度学习后端在 GPU 上效率不足，且难以在 TPU 架构上实现大规模等变深度学习工作负载。
AI.method: 结合优化的 CUDA 与 Pallas 内核及算法改进，构建支持 GPU 和 TPU 的 JAX 等变后端 e3j，覆盖前向与反向路径。
AI.result: 在 MLIP 用例上（MACE 水盒 NPT 模拟）较 cuEquivariance 提速最高 34%；张量积操作达 H100 最大内存带宽 80% 以上效率；消息传递卷积前向吞吐常为既有后端两倍以上；TPU 上达 TPUv6e 内存带宽 80% 以上，较 e3nn-jax 高至一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: e3j 为 GPU/TPU 上的高性能等变深度学习提供开源方案（Apache 2.0），并在 TPU 上开启大规模等变工作负载的可能性。

title: A method for measuring and analyzing four-dimensional flow fields in viscous Rayleigh-Bénard convection
summary: Laboratory investigation of convective flow in viscous fluids is crucial for various engineering and geophysical applications, including vigorous convection in planetary mantles, which involves multiple rising plumes. Many experimental techniques have been developed to visualize the flow and plumes, but most previous measurements remain largely qualitative.
