Here we present a method to measure and analyze four-dimensional (4D) plume-bearing viscous fluid flow, extending volumetric velocimetry approaches to the high Prandtl-number laminar regime relevant to mantle convection. First, a customized three dimensional (3D) Scanning Stereoscopic Particle Image Velocimetry (SSPIV) system is applied to a Rayleigh-Bénard experiment suitable to study the dynamics of Earth's interior. We report the first quantitative 4D velocity measurements of multiple interacting laminar plumes at high Prandtl numbers. The raw velocity data are postprocessed with a Lagrangian Coherent Structure (LCS) and cluster analysis pipeline, tailored for clusters of viscous plumes, which allows quantitative, transport-based material boundary tracking of the plumes in space and time. We show example results to demonstrate the power of our method while fully exploring the dynamics in a companion paper Bao and Lithgow-Bertelloni (2025). Our analysis quantifies the rich dynamical behavior of multiple interacting plumes. We suggest our method of measurement and analysis can help better quantify the morphology, interaction, and evolutionary pathways of plumes feeding Earth's volcanic hotspots and other planetary interiors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一套四维（4D）羽流粘性流体流动的测量与分析方法：将体视三维扫描立体粒子图像测速（SSPIV）扩展至高普朗特数层流区，并结合拉格朗日相干结构（LCS）与聚类分析后处理管道，实现了多相互作用层流羽流的定量4D速度测量与基于输运的物质边界追踪。
AI.motivation: 实验室中对粘性流体对流（如行星地幔中的强烈对流及多上升羽流）的研究具有重要工程与地球物理意义；已有可视化技术众多，但多数测量仍停留在定性层面，缺乏对多羽流三维时空动力学的定量刻画手段。
AI.method: 1）搭建定制的三维扫描立体粒子图像测速（SSPIV）系统，应用于适合研究地球内部动力学的瑞利-贝纳德对流实验；2）将体视测速方法拓展至与地幔对流相关的高普朗特数层流区；3）对原始速度场采用针对粘性羽流簇定制的拉格朗日相干结构（LCS）与聚类分析后处理管道，实现时空上基于输运的羽流物质边界追踪。
AI.result: 首次获得高普朗特数下多个相互作用层流羽流的定量4D速度测量结果；示例结果展示了该方法的有效性，并定量刻画了多羽流相互作用的丰富动力学行为（完整动力学分析见Bao and Lithgow-Bertelloni, 2025姊妹论文）。
AI.conclusion: 该测量与分析框架可更定量地刻画供给地球火山热点及行星内部羽流的形态、相互作用和演化路径，为地幔对流等黏性流体对流研究提供可推广的定量4D实验工具。

title: A singular minimizer of a smooth strongly polyconvex functional in two dimensions
summary: We construct a Lipschitz, non-$C^1$ map $u\colon \mathbb{R}^2\to \mathbb{R}^6$ which is the unique global minimizer of a smooth, strongly polyconvex functional. Such an example is necessarily non-homogeneous.

AI.tldr: 构造了一个 Lipschitz 但非 $C^1$ 的映射 $u:\mathbb{R}^2\to\mathbb{R}^6$，它是某个光滑强多凸泛函的唯一全局极小元，且该例子必然非齐次。
AI.motivation: 探究变分法中极小元的正则性问题：是否存在光滑、强多凸泛函（具有良好的凸性/强制性假设），其全局极小元却不满足 $C^1$ 光滑性。经典正则性理论通常依赖凸性或强制性来推出光滑性，该工作旨在说明在强多凸、强椭圆条件下，Lipschitz 正则性可能是最优的，从而揭示正则性结果的极限。
AI.method: 显式构造一个从 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 到 $\mathbb{R}^6$ 的映射 $u$，满足 Lipschitz 连续但不可微（非 $C^1$）；同时构造一个光滑（无穷可微）且强多凸（strongly polyconvex）的泛函，使得该 $u$ 成为其唯一全局极小元。构造中利用非齐次（non-homogeneous）形式，以避免齐次情形下已知正则性结论的限制。
AI.result: 给出满足上述所有条件的反例：一个非 $C^1$ 的 Lipschitz 映射确实可以作为光滑强多凸泛函的唯一全局极小元而存在。
AI.conclusion: 表明即使在强多凸、强椭圆、光滑泛函的良好假设下，全局极小元也不一定具有 $C^1$ 正则性；Lipschitz 是这类问题的自然正则性门槛。此类反例必然是非齐次的，说明非齐次性是构造该现象的关键，对变分法和非线性弹性理论中的正则性理论具有重要启示。

title: Revisiting AdaGrad in Stochastic Convex Optimization: Last Iterates, High Probability, and Lower Bounds
summary: AdaGrad and AdaGrad-Norm are widely used adaptive methods, but their precise behavior in stochastic convex optimization remains less understood. We first show that AdaGrad-Norm and AdaGrad do not admit any universal \textbf{last-iterate} rate, even under sub-Gaussian noise and bounded iterates. We then prove that bounded variance alone is too weak: even with bounded iterates, it cannot yield \textbf{high-probability average-iterate} rates, and without bounded iterates it may not even guarantee convergence in expectation. Besides, we construct tight $Ω(\log T/\sqrt T)$ lower bounds for both AdaGrad-Norm and AdaGrad under sub-Gaussian noise, showing that $\log T$ in existing average-iterate upper bounds is unavoidable. Finally, we show that this $\log T$ loss disappears once bounded-iterate condition is imposed: under a general ABC condition, both methods achieve rates ${O}(1/\sqrt{T})$.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了 AdaGrad 与 AdaGrad-Norm 在随机凸优化中的精确收敛行为，指出其缺乏统一的末次迭代速率，刻画了有界方差假设的不足，并给出紧的 Ω(log T/√T) 下界与有界迭代下 O(1/√T) 上界。
AI.motivation: AdaGrad 与 AdaGrad-Norm 虽被广泛使用，但其在随机凸优化中的精确理论行为仍不够清楚，尤其是末次迭代、平均迭代以及不同噪声与迭代有界性假设下的收敛性质存在理论空白。
AI.method: 通过构造反例与下界，分析 AdaGrad-Norm 和 AdaGrad 在次高斯噪声、有界迭代、有界方差等条件下的收敛性；并引入一般 ABC 条件来推导有界迭代下的上界。
AI.result: 1) AdaGrad-Norm 与 AdaGrad 即使在高斯噪声和有界迭代下也不存在统一的末次迭代速率；2) 仅有界方差过弱：即使有界迭代也无法给出高概率平均迭代速率，无有界迭代时甚至不保证期望收敛；3) 在次高斯噪声下构造了紧的 Ω(log T/√T) 下界，说明现有平均迭代上界中的 log T 不可避免；4) 在有界迭代条件下该 log T 损失消失，在一般 ABC 条件下两方法均达到 O(1/√T)。
AI.conclusion: 该工作澄清了自适应方法在随机凸优化中的理论极限：末次迭代无统一速率，有界方差不足以保证高概率或期望收敛，log T 损失在平均迭代下是本质的，而有界迭代条件可使该损失消除并恢复 O(1/√T) 速率。

title: Agnostic Smoothed Online Regression with Adversarial Responses
summary: We study smoothed online prediction with bounded adversarial responses. This widely studied framework bridges i.i.d. sampling and adversarial covariate selection through a smoothness parameter $\textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}}$, which bounds conditional covariate densities relative to a fixed, unknown base measure. We propose \textsc{Hedge-Cover}, an information-theoretic algorithm that achieves sublinear regret $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{\text{Pdim}(\mathcal{F}) \textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}} T})$ for function classes with bounded pseudo-dimension. The algorithm aggregates a carefully constructed family of experts using \textsc{Hedge}, with a prior that links regret to the number of disagreements between a consistent selector and a target function. We bound this number by exploiting covariate smoothness. This answers an open problem posed in \cite{blanchard2025agnostic} on the minimax optimal adaptive regret of the smoothed online regression problem. We establish a matching lower bound for the class of linear predictors. The main intricacy of the lower bound lies in explicitly constructing a challenging sequential covariate distribution supported on mutually orthogonal hyperplanes. This construction may be of independent technical interest. Finally, we revisit the well-specified setting and quantify the effect of response noise. For conditionally $ν^2$-subGaussian responses, we extend the existing lower bound under realizable responses by showing that the minimax expected regret is $Ω((1\vee ν)\sqrt{(\textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}}-1)dT})$ for a function class of VC dimension $d$. A corresponding upper bound for ERM matches this dependence on $ν$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有界对抗响应下的平滑在线预测，提出信息论算法 Hedge-Cover，实现伪维度有界函数类的次线性遗憾，并给出匹配下界，解决了开放问题。
AI.motivation: 平滑在线预测框架通过平滑参数 C_cov 连接 i.i.d. 采样与对抗协变量选择。已有工作（blanchard2025agnostic）提出了关于该问题极小极大最优自适应遗憾的开放问题，本文旨在解决它。
AI.method: 提出 Hedge-Cover 算法：用 Hedge 聚合精心构造的专家族，其先验将遗憾与一致选择器和目标函数之间的不一致数联系起来。利用协变量平滑性界定不一致数。下界方面，显式构造支撑在相互正交超平面上的顺序协变量分布。并重新审视良设定情形，分析条件 ν²-次高斯响应噪声的影响。
AI.result: Hedge-Cover 对伪维度有界函数类达到次线性遗憾 Õ(√(Pdim(F) C_cov T))；对线性预测类建立匹配下界；对 VC 维为 d 的函数类，在条件 ν²-次高斯响应下给出极小极大期望遗憾下界 Ω((1∨ν)√((C_cov−1)dT))，ERM 的对应上界匹配该 ν 依赖。
AI.conclusion: 回答了 blanchard2025agnostic 的开放问题，确立了平滑在线回归的极小极大最优自适应遗憾；正交超平面构造具独立技术价值；并量化了响应噪声对良设定情形的影响。

title: Positivity-preserving semi-Lagrangian discontinuous Galerkin methods for multi-species Vlasov-Ampère models of plasma
summary: We develop a high-order and positivity-preserving kinetic solver for the multi-species Vlasov-Ampère system that is built within a semi-Lagrangian discontinuous Galerkin (SLDG) framework. The method is designed for efficiency and accuracy across a broad range of conditions, including stiff, multi-scale regimes with strong ion-electron scale separation. Phase space is discretized via high-order discontinuous Galerkin finite elements; time stepping is handled via high-order operator splitting and a series of one-dimensional, unconditionally stable, semi-Lagrangian updates. To improve both accuracy and efficiency, each plasma species is represented on a different phase-space mesh. On every element and for each species, local positivity-preserving limiters are applied to prevent spurious undershoots and rigorously ensure positivity of the cell averages at the next time step. The accuracy and robustness of the resulting method are verified on several standard single- and two-species test cases, including manufactured solutions, two-stream instability, weak and strong Landau damping, ion-acoustic wave propagation, ion-acoustic shock formation, and KEEN wave dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文在半拉格朗日间断伽辽金（SLDG）框架下，为多组分Vlasov-Ampère系统开发了一种高阶、保正性的动理学求解器，采用不同物种不同相空间网格及局部保正限制器，并通过多种标准测试验证了精度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 多组分Vlasov-Ampère系统在强离子-电子尺度分离等刚性、多尺度情形下的高效、高精度求解具有挑战性，且需保证分布函数的正性以避免非物理振荡。
AI.method: 在相空间采用高阶间断伽辽金有限元离散；时间推进采用高阶算子分裂与一系列无条件稳定的一维半拉格朗日更新；每个等离子体组分使用不同的相空间网格以提升精度与效率；在每个单元、每个组分上应用局部保正限制器，严格保证下一时间步单元平均值的正性并抑制虚假下冲。
AI.result: 在多种标准单组分与双组分测试算例上验证了方法的精度与鲁棒性，包括制造解、双流不稳定性、弱与强Landau阻尼、离子声波传播、离子声激波形成以及KEEN波动力学。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的SLDG动理学求解器能够高效、准确地处理多组分Vlasov-Ampère系统，包括刚性与多尺度区域，并严格保持正性。

title: Energy-aware frugal Bayesian optimization
comment: Published in MATEC Web of Conferences 422, 02009. 7th International Conference on Engineering Optimization
summary: Modern design optimization frameworks aim first and foremost for models with the most accurate predictions without balancing computational overhead. It remains a reason why scaled architecture and multidisciplinary design optimization problems are difficult to address, even with sample-efficient Bayesian optimizers. In this paper, a metric quantifying the computational energy footprint is introduced within a Bayesian optimization framework to guide the parameter setting of a model towards configurations that balance both performance and frugality. The computer experiments highlighted existing tradeoffs between optimum convergence and the underlying energy footprint, and sometimes resulted in both a better-found optimum and lower energy consumption.

AI.tldr: 该论文在贝叶斯优化框架中引入计算能耗足迹度量，引导模型参数配置在性能与节俭性之间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 现代设计优化框架首要追求预测精度最高的模型，却未兼顾计算开销，这导致即便使用样本高效的贝叶斯优化器，规模化架构与多学科设计优化问题仍难以处理。
AI.method: 在贝叶斯优化框架中引入一个量化计算能耗足迹的指标，用以指导模型的参数设置，使其朝向兼顾性能与节俭性的配置。
AI.result: 计算机实验揭示了最优收敛性与底层能耗足迹之间既有的权衡关系，且有时同时实现了更优的寻优结果与更低的能耗。
AI.conclusion: 将能耗足迹纳入贝叶斯优化可有效平衡性能与计算节俭性，并可能带来寻优质量与能耗的双重改善。

title: Full termination of MMP for klt pairs with big boundaries
summary: We prove the full termination of the minimal model program for klt pairs with big boundaries.

AI.tldr: 证明了具有大边界的klt对的最小模型程序完全终止。
AI.motivation: 极小模型程序（MMP）的终止性是双有理几何的核心未决问题之一。对于带大边界的klt对，已有部分终止性结果，但"完全终止"（即所有维度、所有序列）尚未确立，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 对带大边界的klt对（klt pairs with big boundaries）运用极小模型程序的框架进行论证，通过双有理几何中的终止性技术证明其完全终止。
AI.result: 证明了带大边界的klt对的极小模型程序完全终止。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了带大边界klt对的MMP完全终止性，推进了极小模型程序终止性这一核心问题的研究。

title: Hall conductance of dilute electrolytes from odd stochastic density functional theory
summary: Electrolytes under an external magnetic field exhibit a Hall conductivity, much like metals and semiconductors. However, existing theories fail to quantitatively account for their measured Hall conductivities. To make progress toward such a theory, we develop a stochastic density functional framework for electrolytes in a magnetic field. This framework, which we dub odd SDFT, extends the celebrated stochastic density functional theory (SDFT) to incorporate transverse mobilities and chiral time-correlated noise. Using this framework, we calculate the Hall conductivity in the absence of hydrodynamic solvent effects through three approaches: (i) direct response, (ii) Green-Kubo relation, and (iii) a hybrid fluctuation-dissipation relation. We further show that odd SDFT applies more broadly to fluids with broken time-reversal and mirror symmetry, including odd-diffusive fluids and chiral active matter. Our results generalize the relaxation correction of Debye-Hückel-Onsager theory to magnetized electrolytes and provide a foundation for incorporating additional effects mediated by the solvent that could quantitatively reconcile theory and experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"奇性随机密度泛函理论"（odd SDFT）框架，将随机密度泛函理论推广至磁场中的电解质，计入横向迁移率与手性时间关联噪声，并通过三种方法计算霍尔电导率。
AI.motivation: 外磁场下电解质表现出类似于金属和半导体的霍尔电导率，但现有理论无法定量解释其测量值，亟需一个能够定量描述该现象的理论框架。
AI.method: 在随机密度泛函理论（SDFT）基础上，纳入横向迁移率与手性时间关联噪声，构建 odd SDFT 框架；在不考虑流体力学溶剂效应的条件下，采用(i)直接响应、(ii)Green-Kubo 关系、(iii)混合涨落-耗散关系三种途径计算霍尔电导率。
AI.result: 给出三种途径下无溶剂效应的霍尔电导率计算结果，并将 Debye-Hückel-Onsager 理论的弛豫修正推广到磁化电解质；同时表明 odd SDFT 可适用于具有时间反演与镜像对称性破缺的更广泛流体。
AI.conclusion: odd SDFT 为磁化电解质提供了统一的理论描述，并可作为进一步纳入溶剂介导效应、从而定量弥合理论与实验差距的基础。

title: Morphology, interactions, and evolution of laminar thermal plumes revealed by time-resolved volumetric velocity measurements and analysis: Application to Earth's mantle
summary: Plume-laden convection plays a fundamental role in thermal transport in geophysical and industrial flows. While the dynamics of isolated laminar plumes have been extensively studied, their collective interactions and evolution in a multi-plume system remains poorly quantified due to the lack of four-dimensional (4D, in space and time) flow measurements for viscous convection, common in the turbulence community. Here we present a time-resolved experimental study of clustered plume dynamics in a high-Prandtl-number Rayleigh-Bénard system with temperature-dependent viscosity from 4D velocity measurements. Building on our companion methodology (Bao and Lithgow-Bertelloni, 2025), we characterize the spatiotemporal distribution, morphological evolution, and interaction modes of tens of coexisting plumes. We identify a wide spectrum of dynamical behaviors--merging, splitting, branching, pulsing, and head detachment--that arise from coupled interactions among plumes, multiscale flow, and the evolving thermal boundary layers. We synthesize prior behaviors into a unified, time-resolved framework of plume evolutionary pathways. Characteristic length and timescales, including spacing and initiation times, are compared with previous theoretical and experimental studies. We find thinner plumes with greater minimum spacing. The fraction of isolated plumes (e.g., Hawaii-like) varies dramatically (0--60%) as the flow evolves. Our results provide new insight into plume self-organization and spatiotemporal variability under Earth-like conditions, crucial for understanding geochemical evolution and mapping geochemical anomalies from hotspot lavas to deep sources. These results quantitatively complement previous experimental work and numerical studies on interacting plumes, serving as a benchmark for comparison with geodynamical simulations of mantle convection.

AI.tldr: 本文利用4D速度测量技术，对高普朗特数、变粘度的瑞利-贝纳德系统中成簇地幔柱动力学进行了时间分辨实验研究，揭示了多种演化行为并构建了统一的演化路径框架。
AI.motivation: 孤立层流地幔柱动力学已有广泛研究，但多柱系统中柱间的集体相互作用与演化因缺乏粘性对流（高普朗特数）的4D（空间+时间）流动测量而量化不足。
AI.method: 采用时间分辨的4D速度测量实验，研究高普朗特数、温度依赖粘度的瑞利-贝纳德系统中的成簇地幔柱；基于配套方法学（Bao and Lithgow-Bertelloni, 2025），表征数十个共存地幔柱的时空分布、形态演化与相互作用模式。
AI.result: 识别出合并、分裂、分支、脉动、头部脱离等广泛动力学行为；发现更细的柱体对应更大的最小间距；孤立柱（如夏威夷型）比例随流动演化在0—60%间剧烈变化；特征长度与时间尺度（间距、启动时间）与前人理论及实验研究进行了对比。
AI.conclusion: 研究为类地球条件下地幔柱自组织与时空变异性提供了新认识，有助于理解地球化学演化及从热点熔岩到深部源区的地球化学异常；定量补充了已有实验与数值研究，可作为地幔对流地球动力学模拟的基准。

title: Optimal mixing and enhanced dissipation for a smooth velocity field in any spatial dimension
summary: In this note, we consider the advection-diffusion equation on the $d$-dimensional torus, where $d$ is arbitrary. First, for the associated transport equation, we provide an explicit example of a space-time smooth, divergence-free, random velocity field that is a universal exponential mixer. Second, we set the molecular diffusivity to a (small) positive value, and we show that the same velocity field is dissipation enhancing with optimal rate. Our construction is based on the Random Dynamical Systems viewpoint, and relies on the uniform ergodicity of the two-point Markov process associated with the two-dimensional Pierrehumbert model.

AI.tldr: 本文在 $d$ 维环面上研究对流-扩散方程，构造了一个时空光滑、无散度的随机速度场，它既是传输方程的通用指数混合器，又能在小扩散率下实现最优速率的耗散增强，证明基于随机动力系统观点与二维 Pierrehumbert 模型两点马尔可夫过程的一致遍历性。
AI.motivation: 研究如何构造兼具混合与耗散增强功能的速度场，以理解对流-扩散方程中增强扩散的最优速率问题。
AI.method: 基于随机动力系统（Random Dynamical Systems）视角，利用与二维 Pierrehambard 模型相关联的两点马尔可夫过程的一致遍历性进行构造。
AI.result: 给出了一个显式的时空光滑、无散度、随机速度场，为通用指数混合器；在加入小正分子扩散率后，同一速度场实现最优速率的耗散增强。
AI.conclusion: 所构造的速度场同时实现了通用指数混合与最优耗散增强，验证了该构造方法的有效性。

title: Sampled-Max Subgradient Method for Convex Finite-Max Optimization
summary: We study the Sampled-Max Subgradient Method (SMax-SGM) for large convex finite-max problems. Each iteration maximizes over a fresh random subset of the $N$ components and takes one subgradient of the sampled maximizer. The method is therefore stochastic subgradient descent on a sampled-max surrogate. We bound the surrogate error by an average-top-$k$ gap plus the probability of missing all top-$k$ components. A localization argument requires these quantities only on a near-optimal sublevel set. Under a bounded subgradient-moment assumption, this yields $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ subgradient queries and, when $k$ components remain nearly active in that set, $\widetilde O((N/k)\varepsilon^{-2})$ component-value queries, capped by the full-scan cost. Conversely, a one-dimensional affine construction shows that $Ω(N/k)$ component-value queries can be necessary even when the average-top-$k$ gap vanishes everywhere and subgradient queries are unlimited. A tensor-grid specialization explains when the subset size can become independent of grid cardinality. Experiments on finite maxima with $2\times10^5$ and $5\times10^6$ components show that, under the reported protocols, SMax-SGM reaches a 5% numerical-reference gap with fewer component-value queries and lower optimizer time than each comparison method that reaches the target.

AI.tldr: 本文研究求解大规模凸有限极大问题的Sampled-Max Subgradient Method（SMax-SGM）：每次迭代在N个分量中随机抽取子集并取其极大值的次梯度，本质是对采样极大替代函数的随机次梯度下降。作者用平均top-k间隙与漏掉全部top-k分量的概率界定替代误差，并在近优下水平集上做局部化，得到O(ε^{-2})次梯度查询与约O((N/k)ε^{-2})分量值查询的复杂度；同时给出下界Ω(N/k)及张量网格特化与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 针对大规模凸有限极大问题，传统方法每步需扫描全部N个分量，代价高昂。SMax-SGM通过随机采样子集来降低单步成本，但其替代误差、复杂度保证及查询下界此前缺乏系统刻画，尤其需要明确分量值查询能否随k增大而减少、以及最优依赖是否为N/k。
AI.method: 方法上将SMax-SGM视为对采样极大替代函数的随机次梯度下降。误差分析引入平均top-k间隙并加上漏掉全部top-k分量的概率，通过近优子水平集上的局部化论证，使得这些量只需在该集合上控制。在次梯度矩有界假设下推导复杂度上界；并用一维仿射构造给出分量值查询下界；进一步针对张量网格结构给出特化分析，说明子集规模何时可独立于网格基数。
AI.result: 在次梯度矩有界假设下，算法需O(ε^{-2})次次梯度查询；当近优集合中仍有k个分量近乎活跃时，需约O((N/k)ε^{-2})次分量值查询，且不超过全量扫描代价。下界方面，一维仿射构造表明即使平均top-k间隙处处为零且次梯度查询不受限，分量值查询仍需Ω(N/k)。张量网格特化给出子集规模可独立于网格基数的条件。实验在含2×10^5与5×10^6个分量的有限极大问题上，按报告协议，SMax-SGM在达到5%数值参考间隙时，所用分量值查询更少且优化器时间低于所有达到目标的对比方法。
AI.conclusion: SMax-SGM为大规模凸有限极大问题提供了带有匹配阶复杂度保证的随机一阶方法，其分量值查询复杂度由N/k主导并可由下界证明其必要性；张量网格特化与实验进一步支持其在大规模场景下的有效性与效率优势。

title: Learning What to Evaluate: Correlation-Aware Decoupling for Multiobjective Bayesian Optimization
summary: Multiobjective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) with Gaussian process (GP) surrogates is a sample efficient approach to solving multiobjective optimization problems. In MOBO, a Bayesian decision theoretic acquisition function guides the adaptive selection of new candidate inputs, on which objectives and constraints are evaluated to update the surrogate model sequentially. Existing approaches maintain independent GP models for the objectives and constraints, with new observations evaluating all objectives and constraints in a coupled fashion. However, the objectives and constraints often contain inherent correlations which, if exploited, can enable ${decoupled}$ evaluations where only a subset of them are evaluated at each round. We present a new approach that leverages a multitask GP model to jointly learn all objectives and constraints, and propose a total correlation metric that enables identifying an ${optimal}$ subset of objectives and constraints to be evaluated at every round, even under uniform evaluation costs. Theoretically, we show that our acquisition policy is asymptotically consistent despite decoupling and that our proposed decoupled subset selection rule maximizes the expected posterior entropy reduction about unevaluated tasks under mild conditions. Empirically, we show that our approach outperforms coupled and decoupled baselines in the state of the art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用多任务高斯过程联合建模目标与约束的多目标贝叶斯优化方法，通过总相关度指标选择每轮最优评估子集，实现解耦评估并保持渐近一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有MOBO方法为各目标与约束维护独立GP模型，且每轮耦合评估全部目标与约束，忽视了目标与约束间的内在相关性，导致样本效率受限，无法进行解耦评估。
AI.method: 采用多任务高斯过程模型对所有目标与约束进行联合学习，并提出总相关度（total correlation）指标用于在每轮识别最优的待评估目标与约束子集，即使在评估代价相同的情况下也能实现解耦评估；理论证明采集策略的渐近一致性和子集选择规则在温和条件下最大化未评估任务的期望后验熵缩减。
AI.result: 理论上证明了所提采集策略尽管解耦仍具渐近一致性，且解耦子集选择规则在温和条件下最大化未评估任务的期望后验熵缩减；实验上在先进基线中优于耦合与解耦的对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过多任务GP联合建模并结合总相关度驱动的解耦子集评估，可在不牺牲理论保证的前提下提升多目标贝叶斯优化的样本效率与整体性能。

title: Finite Expression Approximation of High-Dimensional PDEs Without the Curse of Dimensionality
summary: We establish that finite expressions form a symbolic representation class capable of overcoming the curse of dimensionality for several classes of high-dimensional partial differential equations. For semilinear heat equations, we show how finite expression approximations of the terminal condition and nonlinearity can be propagated through the multilevel Picard framework to produce randomized pointwise approximations with prescribed root-mean-square accuracy. For semilinear Kolmogorov equations with Laplacian diffusion and zero drift, diagonal Black--Scholes equations, and the Laplace Dirichlet problem on a half-space, we construct deterministic finite expression approximations with arbitrarily small spatial $L^p$ error. Under suitable growth and regularity assumptions, the evaluation cost of the resulting approximants is bounded polynomially in the dimension and the reciprocal accuracy. A key ingredient in the nonlinear setting is the construction of finite expressions that approximate the PDE solution while preserving the growth and Lipschitz structures required by the stochastic solution theory. More broadly, our results show that dimension-robust approximation of high-dimensional PDEs is not restricted to conventional neural-network architectures: structured symbolic expressions generated from a fixed dictionary can achieve comparable polynomial-complexity guarantees. This provides a rigorous foundation for finite expression methods as a representation paradigm for high-dimensional scientific computing.

AI.tldr: 本文证明有限表达式（finite expression）可作为一种符号表示类，在多类高维偏微分方程上克服维数灾难：对半线性热方程通过多层Picard框架传播终端条件与非线性项的有限表达式近似，得到给定均方根精度的随机逐点近似；对半线性Kolmogorov方程（拉普拉斯扩散、零漂移）、对角Black–Scholes方程及半空间上的Laplace Dirichlet问题，构造出空间L^p误差任意小的确定性有限表达式近似，其求值成本在维数与精度倒数上呈多项式界。
AI.motivation: 高维PDE近似通常依赖神经网络架构来获得维数鲁棒性，本文旨在探究这种维数鲁棒性是否可由其他表示类（结构化符号表达式）实现，从而为有限表达式方法作为高维科学计算的表示范式提供严格理论基础。
AI.method: 对半线性热方程，先构造终端条件与非线性项的有限表达式近似，再通过多层Picard框架将其传播，得到满足预设均方根精度的随机逐点近似；对半线性Kolmogorov方程（拉普拉斯扩散、零漂移）、对角Black–Scholes方程和半空间Laplace Dirichlet问题，构造确定性有限表达式近似，空间L^p误差可任意小；非线性情形的关键构造是使有限表达式在逼近PDE解的同时保持随机解理论所需的增长性与Lipschitz结构。
AI.result: 在适当的增长与正则性假设下，所得近似器的求值成本在维数与精度倒数上均为多项式界，即实现了对上述多类高维PDE的维数鲁棒近似。
AI.conclusion: 高维PDE的维数鲁棒近似并不局限于传统神经网络架构；由固定字典生成的结构化符号表达式同样可达到可比的多项式复杂度保证，这为有限表达式方法作为高维科学计算的表示范式奠定了严格基础。

title: When Does Domain Adaptation Help on Physical Vibration Sensors? A Held-Out-Bearing Study of Neural-Operator and Convolutional Models
summary: Diagnosing rolling-element bearing faults from vibration is a canonical physical-sensing task and a widely used benchmark for domain adaptation under operating-condition shift. Accuracies above 99 percent are commonly reported, but under evaluation splits that place the same physical bearing in both training and test. We revisit the task under a held-out-bearing protocol, assigning every bearing unit entirely to either the training or the test set, and find that source-only transfer is far weaker than such numbers suggest: on a change of shaft speed it reaches only $0.36$, against a target-supervised ceiling of 0.97. We then study what governs transfer. Treating computed order tracking, a shaft-angle resampling that places fault frequencies at fixed shaft orders independent of running speed, as a controlled change of representation, we find that a Fourier Neural Operator raises source-only transfer from $0.36$ to $0.61$ on the speed shift, where the fault peaks move, while a convolutional network of matched feature dimension stays near chance in both representations. The representation also decides whether unsupervised alignment can work: with the same normalized RBF-MMD loss and no target labels, the operator reaches 0.71 in the frequency domain but 0.95 in the order domain, within 0.02 of the target-supervised ceiling and above $0.86$ on every held-out bearing fold. Once the representation is right, a small label budget adds little. These results indicate that, for this task, the input representation rather than the alignment method decides whether adaptation helps. A second dataset, whose held-out units are fault diameters rather than bearings, shows that the same protocol exposes failures that even a target-supervised model cannot avoid.

AI.tldr: 在留出轴承（held-out-bearing）协议下，滚动轴承故障诊断的源域单独迁移远弱于常见99%以上的报告值（变转速下仅0.36，目标监督上限0.97）；把计算阶次跟踪视为受控的表征变换后，Fourier Neural Operator将源域单独迁移提升至0.61，并使无监督对齐在阶次域达到0.95（距目标监督上限0.02）；结论是输入表征而非对齐方法决定迁移是否有效。
AI.motivation: 滚动轴承振动故障诊断是物理感知与工况偏移下域适应的经典基准，但现有工作普遍报告99%以上精度，其评测划分却把同一物理轴承同时放入训练集与测试集，导致数据泄漏式的高估。论文希望厘清：在真正留出物理轴承单元、更贴近部署条件的协议下，源域迁移能力究竟如何，以及什么因素决定迁移成败。
AI.method: 采用留出轴承协议，将每个轴承单元整体划入训练集或测试集；以只源域（source-only）迁移为基线，对比目标监督上限。将计算阶次跟踪（shaft-angle 重采样，把故障频率固定到与转速无关的轴阶）作为一次受控的表征变换，在同一任务上比较两种模型：Fourier Neural Operator（算子）与特征维度匹配的卷积网络。进一步在相同归一化RBF-MMD损失、无目标标签条件下，分别在频率域与阶次域进行无监督对齐，并考察小标签预算的增益。
AI.result: 变转速条件下源域单独迁移仅0.36，目标监督上限0.97；算子将源域单独迁移提升到0.61，而特征维度匹配的卷积网络在两种表征下都接近随机水平。同一MMD对齐损失下，算子无监督迁移在频率域为0.71，在阶次域为0.95（距目标监督上限仅0.02，且在每个留出轴承折上均高于0.86）。表征正确后，小额标签预算带来的增益很小。另一数据集将留出单元设为故障直径而非轴承，同一协议暴露出连目标监督模型也无法规避的失败。
AI.conclusion: 对该任务而言，决定域适应是否奏效的是输入表征（如阶次域）而非对齐算法；传统按样本随机划分所报告的极高精度掩盖了真实迁移难度，留出轴承协议能更诚实地暴露跨工况与跨故障尺寸的泛化瓶颈。

title: Obstructions to the ampleness of invariant jet differentials on complete intersections
comment: 22 pages, comments very welcome as usual
summary: We show that on every smooth hypersurface $X\subset\mathbb P^4$ the Demailly--Semple bundle $E_{3,5q}T^*_X$ of invariant jet differentials of order $3$ and weighted degree $5q$ is not ample, for every integer $q\ge1$. This contradicts the Diverio--Trapani conjecture in the form ``$E_{k,m}T^*_X$ is ample for all $m\gg0$'' for hypersurfaces in $\mathbb P^4$ at $k=3$. We then extend the obstruction to complete intersections of any dimension, to jet differentials of order $4$, and to all sufficiently divisible weights, and we discuss how ampleness of $E_{k,m}T^*_X$ depends on $m$.

AI.tldr: 证明了光滑超曲面 $X\\subset\\mathbb P^4$ 上三阶不变射流微分丛 $E_{3,5q}T^*_X$ 对任意 $q\\ge1$ 均非丰沛，从而在 $k=3$ 情形下否定了 Diverio--Trapani 猜想，并将该障碍推广至任意维完全交、四阶射流微分及充分可除的权。
AI.motivation: Diverio--Trapani 猜想断言射流微分丛 $E_{k,m}T^*_X$ 对充分大的 $m$ 是丰沛的，这与双曲性及射流微分理论中的核心问题密切相关。本文旨在检验该猜想，特别是 $k=3$ 的情形，并刻画丰沛性对权 $m$ 的依赖关系。
AI.method: 通过对不变射流微分丛 $E_{3,5q}T^*_X$ 构造障碍（obstruction），证明其在 $\\mathbb P^4$ 的光滑超曲面上非丰沛；随后将障碍技术推广至任意维完全交、四阶射流微分以及充分可除的权。
AI.result: 对每个整数 $q\\ge1$，$\\mathbb P^4$ 上任意光滑超曲面 $X$ 的 $E_{3,5q}T^*_X$ 均非丰沛；由此在 $k=3$ 时否定了"Diverio--Trapani 猜想"中"对所有 $m\\gg0$，$E_{k,m}T^*_X$ 丰沛"的表述；并进一步给出完全交、四阶与充分可除权情形的推广。
AI.conclusion: $E_{k,m}T^*_X$ 的丰沛性并非对所有充分大的 $m$ 成立，其性质对权 $m$ 具有非平凡的依赖性；Diverio--Trapani 猜想需作修正。

title: A wave-particle decomposition framework for multiscale kinetic transport: continuous-spectrum equations and coupled wave-particle iteration
summary: The wave-particle decomposition is presented as a framework for multiscale kinetic transport, comprising a theory and an algorithm. Along the characteristics of the kinetic equation, the equilibrium integral of the solution over a local kinetic horizon defines a wave, which depends only on the conservative variables, and its exact complement defines a particle. Both obey kinetic equations whose moments are extended Navier-Stokes equations, and the conservation laws together with the particle equation form a closed system that is equivalent to the kinetic equation for every horizon. Parametrized by the ratio of the horizon to the relaxation time, these systems form a continuous spectrum from kinetic theory to Navier-Stokes hydrodynamics that adapts to the flow from cell to cell. The algorithm is a coupled wave-particle iteration for steady flows. It alternates a macroscopic iteration for the conservative variables, with the particle frozen, and a kinetic iteration for the particle, with the wave fixed. Its fixed point is the discrete kinetic solution, it is asymptotic preserving, and its near-continuum convergence factor is bounded by the share of the transport carried by the particle, a share that decays exponentially with the horizon-to-relaxation ratio. The collision model enters only through a conservative remainder, and the equations and the iteration are written out for the Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook, Shakhov and ellipsoidal statistical models, the Boltzmann and Landau equations, neutron transport and radiative transfer. The decomposition is related to the unified gas-kinetic wave-particle method, the micro-macro decomposition, penalization and synthetic acceleration. Computations of hypersonic flows past a cylinder and around the three-dimensional X38 vehicle illustrate how the division of the distribution adapts to the flow and how strongly the iteration is accelerated.

AI.tldr: 提出波粒分解作为多尺度动理学输运的统一理论与算法框架，构建从动理学到Navier-Stokes的连续谱，并给出耦合波粒迭代算法。
AI.motivation: 多尺度动理学输运中，动理学方程与流体力学极限之间存在尺度跨度，需要一种能自适应地在不同流区（连续区与稀薄区）之间切换的统一框架与高效算法。
AI.method: 沿动理学方程特征线，将局部动理学时间窗内解的平衡积分定义为"波"（仅依赖守恒变量），其精确余项定义为"粒子"；两者各自满足动理学方程，其矩为扩展Navier-Stokes方程，与守恒律共同构成与原动理学方程等价封闭系统。以时间窗与弛豫时间之比为参数形成连续谱。算法为稳态流的波粒耦合迭代：冻结粒子做宏观守恒量迭代，固定波做动理学粒子迭代。
AI.result: 不动点即离散动理学解，算法具有渐近保持性；近连续区收敛因子由粒子携带的输运份额界定，该份额随时间窗与弛豫时间之比指数衰减。碰撞模型仅通过守恒余项进入，给出BGK、Shakhov、椭球统计模型、Boltzmann与Landau方程、中子输运及辐射输运的方程与迭代格式。
AI.conclusion: 该分解与统一气体动理学波粒方法、微宏观分解、罚化及合成加速等方法相关；圆柱高超声速绕流与三维X38外形算例表明分布函数的波粒划分可自适应流动，且迭代显著加速。

title: Near-cancellation of enstrophy and strain requires shear or a balanced vortex
summary: In the nonlinear source of the pressure Poisson equation the fluctuating enstrophy and strain nearly cancel. We ask where the cancellation is complete, which we call silent, and how the source escapes it. Pointwise the source depends only on the eigenvalues of the velocity gradient. Pure shear has none, so it is silent. It is the origin of the normalised invariant plane, whose second-invariant coordinate is the normalised source. Let $f$ be the shear fraction of the gradient and $m$ its distance from that origin. We prove that $m\le1-f\le3m$ at every point of every incompressible flow. Wherever the source nearly vanishes and the third invariant is small, the gradient is nearly pure shear. Otherwise the cancelling gradient is a balanced vortex, a swirl its own strain cancels at any strength. At a no-slip wall the silent object is exact: the wall shear-stress fluctuation, a rank-one sheet. Away from the wall we assume the same sheet, dressed with a small residual, and derive how it escapes. The escape passes through one element of the residual, the along-sheet variation of the sheet-normal velocity. Its amplitude is the geometric mean of sheet and residual, and its sign selects swirl or strain. A rank-two silent object has the same source through the same gates but balanced eigenvalues, so the assumption fixes the escape's topology, not its source. The shear fraction is thus a pointwise proxy for cancellation by shear, and a model of the source must be built on what escapes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究压力泊松方程非线性源项中脉动拟涡能与应变的抵消机制，指出源项逐点仅依赖速度梯度特征值，纯剪切因而"静默"，并证明剪切分数f与偏离原点距离m满足 m≤1−f≤3m。在无滑移壁面，静默对象为壁面剪应力脉动（秩一薄片）；远离壁面时通过薄片法向速度的沿片变化逃逸，逃逸振幅为薄片与残差的几何平均，其符号决定旋涡或应变。
AI.motivation: 压力泊松方程非线性源项中脉动拟涡能与应变项近乎抵消，这使湍流建模与源项重构困难。作者希望刻画这种抵消在何处完全（"静默"），以及源项如何从静默状态中逃逸出来，从而为源项建模提供几何与结构基础。
AI.method: 将源项视为速度梯度特征值的逐点函数，引入归一化不变量平面（第二不变量坐标即归一化源项）；定义剪切分数f为梯度的剪切比例、m为其到原点的距离，并证明不等式 m≤1−f≤3m。区分纯剪切（静默）、平衡旋涡（其自身应变在任意强度下抵消）与秩一/秩二静默对象；在壁面用秩一薄片（壁面剪应力脉动）描述，远离壁面以薄片加小残差建模，分析沿片法向速度变化作为逃逸通道。
AI.result: 证明了对任意不可压缩流动的每一点均有 m≤1−f≤3m；源项近乎消失且第三不变量较小时梯度接近纯剪切，否则抵消梯度为平衡旋涡。无滑移壁面处静默对象精确为秩一薄片（壁面剪应力脉动）；远离壁面时逃逸通过残差的一个元素——薄片法向速度的沿片变化——实现，其振幅为薄片与残差的几何平均，符号决定旋涡或应变。秩二静默对象经相同"闸门"产生相同源项但特征值平衡，故该假设仅固定逃逸拓扑而非其源项。
AI.conclusion: 剪切分数f可作为逐点表征剪切抵消的代理量，而源项模型必须建立在对"逃逸"部分的刻画之上，而非仅依赖静默结构的假设。

title: No Spurious Local Minima in Full-Order Linear Quadratic Gaussian Control
summary: This paper studies the nonconvex optimization landscape of Linear Quadratic Gaussian (LQG) control under direct state-space parameterization. Although the LQG cost may possess suboptimal stationary points, whether it admits suboptimal local minima has remained open. We answer this question negatively: Every local minimum of the full-order LQG cost is globally optimal. More generally, at any controller order, every local minimum corresponding to an uncontrollable or unobservable realization attains the globally optimal LQG cost over all stabilizing policies of arbitrary orders. We further show that any suboptimal policy can be augmented with decoupled stable controller states, so that the augmented policy admits a direction of negative curvature with probability one. Consequently, any suboptimal stationary point in full-order LQG cost can be converted into a strict saddle with probability one. One key proof idea connects the state-space Hessian to a frequency-domain global-optimality condition derived from the Youla parameterization. These results reveal a benign local-minimum landscape despite the presence of suboptimal stationary points.

AI.tldr: 本文研究直接状态空间参数化下LQG控制的非凸优化景观，证明全阶LQG代价的每个局部极小都是全局最优，且任何次优平稳点可以概率1转化为严格鞍点。
AI.motivation: LQG代价可能含有次优平稳点，但其是否包含次优局部极小此前仍未解决。该问题关系到直接状态空间参数化优化是否具有良性景观。
AI.method: 通过将状态空间Hessian与基于Youla参数化的频域全局最优性条件相连接，分析不同控制器阶数下局部极小对应的可控性/可观性实现结构，并研究解耦稳定控制器状态增广后的负曲率方向。
AI.result: 全阶LQG代价的每个局部极小均为全局最优；任意控制器阶数下，对应不可控或不可观实现的局部极小达到所有任意阶镇定策略中的全局最优LQG代价；任意次优策略可通过解耦稳定控制器状态增广，使增广策略以概率1存在负曲率方向；全阶LQG中的任意次优平稳点均可概率1转化为严格鞍点。
AI.conclusion: 尽管存在次优平稳点，LQG控制优化仍具有良性局部极小景观。该结论为直接状态空间参数化下的LQG优化提供了全局最优性保证。

title: Affine Geometry of Gaussian ReLU Networks via Conditional Kac-Rice Formulas
summary: We study how the affine geometry of finite ReLU networks is created at random initialization and reorganized by supervised training. We call a sign-changing zero of a hidden preactivation an activation switch and a point where the scalar network output is nondifferentiable a scalar kink. For one-dimensional input, conditioning on the preceding layers makes each preactivation Gaussian and affine on the cells of a random finite partition. This yields an exact finite-width conditional Kac-Rice formula for the expected number of activation switches along an input interval. For fixed depth and proportionally growing widths, the resulting switch intensities converge to explicit deterministic limits. A visibility estimate shows that the expected number of switches that do not produce scalar kinks is negligible, yielding an explicit leading formula for the expected number of scalar kinks and hence affine regions. In higher input dimensions d >= 2, the analogous conditional surface formula yields the leading expected (d-1)-dimensional Hausdorff measure of the scalar kink set. On the Breast Cancer Wisconsin data, the initialization formula accurately predicts switch counts along held-out segments. After training, switch counts decrease along within-class segments and increase along between-class segments. Thus, training redistributes rather than merely contracts affine complexity.

AI.tldr: 研究了有限宽度ReLU网络随机初始化时仿射几何结构的形成以及监督训练对其的重组，给出激活开关与标量拐点的精确期望公式，并发现训练是重新分布而非单纯压缩仿射复杂度。
AI.motivation: 理解ReLU网络分段仿射几何在随机初始化时如何产生、在监督训练中如何被重组，是刻画网络表达力与训练动力学的重要问题，作者希望给出关于激活开关和标量拐点（即仿射区域边界）期望数量的精确理论刻画。
AI.method: 将隐藏层预激活的符号变化定义为激活开关，将网络标量输出不可微点定义为标量拐点。对一维输入，在某层之前条件化后，每个预激活在前层形成的随机有限分割单元上为高斯的仿射函数，由此导出沿输入区间激活开关期望数量的精确有限宽度条件Kac-Rice公式；在深度固定、宽度按比例增长的极限下得到显式确定性强度极限。通过可见性估计证明不产生标量拐点的激活开关期望数量可忽略，得到标量拐点及仿射区域数量的主项公式。对输入维度 d>=2，用类似条件曲面公式得到标量拐点集的(d-1)维Hausdorff测度主项。
AI.result: 固定深度、宽度按比例增大时激活开关强度收敛到显式确定性极限；不产生标量拐点的激活开关期望数量可忽略，从而给出标量拐点与仿射区域的显式主项公式；对 d>=2 得到标量拐点集的(d-1)维Hausdorff测度主项。在Breast Cancer Wisconsin数据上，初始化公式能准确预测留出片段上的开关数量；训练后类内片段开关数减少、类间片段开关数增加。
AI.conclusion: 随机初始化ReLU网络的仿射几何可由有限宽度Kac-Rice型公式精确刻画，并可在比例宽度极限下化为显式表达式；训练并非简单压缩仿射复杂度，而是重新分布仿射复杂度——类内减少、类间增加，说明训练在重组网络的仿射区域结构。

title: Measure Learning at Steady State: A BIRD-SQL Formula 1 Case Study
summary: Continual Learning Bench scores learning as short-horizon gain versus a reset baseline and finds naive full-context ICL strongest among the memories it tested. We treat ICL as one learning system and score it on a longer shared-world schedule. Steady-state learning is the gap versus baseline on a pre-set late window (last 40 of 174 BIRD-SQL formula-1 questions). We split the score into exploration efficiency (SQL probes), task reward (hits), and delivery cost (API dollars and context size). On gpt-5.6-luna, late probes fall from 4.6-5.6 to 0.95 while hits rise only modestly and ICL context grows to about 95k tokens with cost roughly doubling. Short-horizon gain understates the late probe saving and misses the cost inversion, so we find that unbounded ICL is a poor candidate for the learning mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文将ICL视为一个学习系统，在更长共享世界（shared-world）调度上评分，发现无界ICL并非理想的学习机制。
AI.motivation: Continual Learning Bench以短视界收益（short-horizon gain）相对重置基线评分，并认为朴素全上下文ICL在测试的记忆中最强。作者认为该短视界设定可能低估了探索效率的节省并遗漏成本反转，因此希望用更长的调度来重新评估ICL。
AI.method: 将ICL作为单一学习系统，在更长的共享世界调度上评分。以预设的晚期窗口（174道BIRD-SQL formula-1题的最后40题）相对基线的差距定义为稳态学习（steady-state learning），并将得分拆解为探索效率（SQL探测）、任务奖励（命中）与交付成本（API美元与上下文规模）三个维度。
AI.result: 在gpt-5.6-luna上，晚期探测次数从4.6-5.6降至0.95，而命中仅小幅上升；ICL上下文增长至约95k tokens，成本约翻倍。
AI.conclusion: 短视界收益低估了晚期探测的节省，也遗漏了成本反转，因此无界ICL（unbounded ICL）并非适合作为学习机制的候选方案。

title: Equivariant Riemann-Roch for Surfaces via Connections and Residues
summary:
Let $X$ be a smooth projective surface over $\mathbb{C}$ with an effective action of a finite group $G$, and let $L$ be a $G$-linearized line bundle. We develop a residue-theoretic and birational approach to computing the equivariant Euler characteristic $χ_G(X,L)$. Every such $L$ admits an equivariant divisor presentation. Divisor peeling applies the divisor exact sequences one layer at a time, treating whole $G$-orbits of components together. It reduces the problem to the structure sheaf and lower-dimensional equivariant contributions.
  On a resolution of $X/G$, the natural extensions of the isotypic direct-image sheaves preserve Euler characteristics, but their induced connections need not be logarithmic, as an explicit $D_4$ calculation shows. Blowing up fixed points before taking the quotient reduces the local calculation to diagonal actions and cyclic Hirzebruch-Jung singularities. We obtain explicit correction class functions for the ADE singularities and a uniform procedure for general diagonal actions, including quasi-reflections. In the diagonal case, the natural extensions are logarithmic, and their residues are computed from monomial valuations on the Hirzebruch-Jung resolution. Combining these residue calculations with the branch-curve terms and divisor peeling gives a procedure for computing the equivariant Euler characteristic of every $G$-linearized line bundle. We compare the local classes with the holomorphic Lefschetz formula and the Kleinian coefficients of Lim and Rota, and give examples on $\mathbb{P}^2$, including one with fixed curves.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个留数理论与双有理方法，用于计算有限群作用光滑射影曲面上等变线丛的等变Euler示性数，核心工具为除子剥离与Hirzebruch-Jung分辨率上的单项赋值留数。
AI.motivation: 等变Euler示性数χ_G(X,L)的计算在一般情况下较为困难，缺乏统一且可操作的程序，尤其是涉及商奇点、等变线丛的除子表示以及局部修正项时，需要一套系统的留数与双有理框架。
AI.method: 引入等变除子表示，发展除子剥离技术，按G-轨道逐层应用除子正合列，将问题归约到结构层与低维等变贡献；在X/G的分辨上研究同型直像层的自然扩张，指出其诱导联络未必是对数联络（以D_4算例说明）；通过在取商前爆破不动点，将局部计算化为对角作用与循环Hirzebruch-Jung奇点；给出ADE奇点的显式修正类函数与一般对角作用（含准反射）的统一流程；在对角情形下，自然扩张为对数型的，其留数由Hirzebruch-Jung分辨上的单项赋值计算，再结合分支曲线项与除子剥离得到完整计算程序；最后与全纯Lefschetz公式及Lim-Rota的Kleinian系数比较。
AI.result: 获得了ADE奇点的显式修正类函数；建立了对角作用（含准反射）的统一计算流程；证明对角情形下自然扩张为对数型并可由分辨上的单项赋值计算其留数；给出结合分支曲线项与除子剥离的通用计算程序；与全纯Lefschetz公式及Lim-Rota的Kleinian系数进行了比较；在P^2上给出算例，其中包括含固定曲线的例子。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为任意G-线性化线丛的等变Euler示性数提供了统一可操作的留数-双有理计算框架，揭示了自然扩张的联络性质与奇点类型之间的关系，并在具体曲面算例中验证了方法的有效性。

title: Fluctuations and multifractality in stochastic models of interface growth and population dynamics
summary: This thesis studies how disorder and fluctuations shape large-scale growth phenomena in three related settings: fluctuating interfaces, random spring chains, and random multiplicative growth. The first part concerns interface growth and a phenomenon denoted anomalous scaling, where local and global exponents differ.To clarify its origin, we study two models in which this mismatch has different causes. The first is a heterogeneous elastic line, where we show that the apparent anomaly is a purely statistical effect. The second is the stochastic porous medium equation, a strongly nonlinear model in which the anomaly is genuine. The second part concerns Anderson localization, which appears here through the spectral properties of the heterogeneous elastic lines. We study chains with both random masses and random spring constants, with particular emphasis on the strong-disorder regime, where standard weak-disorder expansions break down. We develop a new combinatorial method to probe this regime. The last part concerns random multiplicative growth with redistribution. In such models, changes in wealth, population, or mass, for instance, are proportional to the amount already present, so that small differences are amplified over time. This naturally generates broad distributions and provides a simple mechanism for the emergence of inequality and concentration, with applications to population dynamics, wealth distribution, city growth, and ecology. We in particular study models in which each site has its own quenched growth rate, representing a persistent advantage or disadvantage, and is also subject to transient fluctuations. Redistribution competes with these mechanisms by homogenizing the system. This competition leads to rich phase diagrams.

AI.tldr: 本论文在三个相关背景下研究无序与涨落如何塑造大尺度增长现象：涨落界面、随机弹簧链与随机乘性增长。工作分别澄清了反常标度的不同来源、发展了强无序区Anderson局域化的组合方法，并揭示了乘性增长与再分配竞争产生的丰富相图。
AI.motivation: 无序与涨落普遍存在于界面生长、弹性链与增长型随机系统中，但反常标度的起源、强无序下标准微扰展开失效、以及乘性增长导致的分布展宽与集中机制等问题尚缺乏统一理解，因此需要在多个相关模型中进行系统研究。
AI.method: 第一部分通过异构弹性线与随机多孔介质方程两个模型区分反常标度的统计效应与真实反常；第二部分针对同时含随机质量与随机弹簧常数的链路，在强无序区发展新的组合方法研究谱性质与Anderson局域化；第三部分研究带再分配的随机乘性增长模型，其中各站点具有淬火增长率并受瞬态涨落影响，分析再分配与这些机制的竞争。
AI.result: 研究表明：异构弹性线中的表观反常是纯统计效应，而随机多孔介质方程中的反常是真实的；新组合方法可用于强无序区谱性质的探测；乘性增长与再分配的竞争产生丰富相图，并给出分布展宽、集中与不平等的简单机制。
AI.conclusion: 无序与涨落在不同系统中均可显著改变大尺度增长行为：反常标度可能源于统计效应或真实物理机制，强无序需要新的非微扰方法，而乘性增长与再分配的竞争可产生多种相态，对种群动态、财富分配、城市增长与生态学等具有应用意义。

title: Analytical Criterion for the Turbulent-to-Laminar Transition in Channel Flow
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, AMITANS 2026 conference, Albena, Bulgaria, June 26- Jyly 03 2026
summary: An analytical criterion for the disappearance of turbulent flow in a channel is developed within the Alexeev hydrodynamic equations (AHE). The analysis builds on an analytical representation of the streamwise velocity as a superposition of a parabolic component and a nonlinear turbulent component coupled to the transverse velocity field. The critical Reynolds number is obtained from the balance of viscous dissipation of kinetic energy associated with the turbulent component. The resulting critical Reynolds number is expressed analytically as \(Re_c=f(δ,γ,n)\), where \(δ\) is the Reynolds-independent AHE similarity parameter, \(γ\) is the weighting coefficient of the turbulent component, and \(n\) is the transverse-velocity mode number. The criterion describes the disappearance of the turbulent solution as the Reynolds number is decreased and therefore addresses the turbulent-to-laminar transition rather than the linear instability of the laminar solution. Unlike a criterion based on a single universal critical Reynolds number, the AHE criterion predicts a transition threshold that depends on the parameters characterizing the flow. For representative channel-flow parameters, the predicted critical Reynolds number is approximately \(Re_c=1000\text{--}1200\). The predicted threshold is compared with experimental observations of transition and of the persistence of laminar flow in channel flows. The analysis suggests that viscous dissipation provides a mechanism limiting the persistence of the turbulent solution below a critical Reynolds number.%

AI.tldr: 在Alexeev流体动力学方程框架下，通过湍流分量黏性耗散平衡导出了湍流解消失的临界雷诺数解析判据 Re_c=f(δ,γ,n)，预测的转捩阈值约为1000–1200，与实验观测相符。
AI.motivation: 已有转捩判据多基于层流解的线性不稳定性，或依赖单一普适临界雷诺数，无法刻画湍流解随雷诺数降低而消失的过程，也难以反映流动参数对转捩阈值的影响。
AI.method: 在Alexeev流体动力学方程（AHE）内建立解析判据：将流向速度表示为抛物型分量与非线性湍流分量（与横向速度场耦合）的叠加，并由湍流分量动能黏性耗散的平衡确定临界雷诺数，得到解析式 Re_c=f(δ,γ,n)。
AI.result: 临界雷诺数可解析表示为 Re_c=f(δ,γ,n)，其中δ为AHE相似参数、γ为湍流分量权重系数、n为横向速度模态数；对代表性槽道流参数，预测 Re_c≈1000–1200，并与转捩及层流持续性的实验观测进行了对比。
AI.conclusion: 该判据描述的是随雷诺数降低湍流解的消失，即湍流→层流转捩而非层流解的线性失稳；转捩阈值依赖流动参数而非单一普适值，并提示黏性耗散是限制湍流解在临界雷诺数以下持续存在的机制。

title: Formalising Linear Elliptic PDE Theory in Lean 4
comment: 30 pages, 1 figure. Lean library available at https://github.com/alejandro-soto-franco/EllipticPDE
summary: We formalise in Lean 4, on top of Mathlib, the solvability of the Dirichlet problem for second-order linear elliptic operators in divergence form. The machine-verified results, with no sorry in the development, include the Poincaré inequality, the existence of weak solutions by the Lax-Milgram theorem, Rellich-Kondrachov compactness, the Fredholm alternative, the spectral theorem, interior regularity estimates, and the Sobolev embedding theorem. From these results we obtain a formalisation of classical solvability for sufficiently regular coefficients and data. Our Lean library includes a self-contained theory of Sobolev spaces developed independently of existing formalisations. Throughout the paper we associate each prose statement with the named machine-checked Lean declaration that discharges it.

AI.tldr: 本文在 Lean 4 与 Mathlib 基础上形式化验证了散度型二阶线性椭圆算子 Dirichlet 问题的可解性，涵盖 Sobolev 空间、Poincaré 不等式、Lax-Milgram 弱解存在性、Rellich-Kondrachov 紧性、Fredholm 二择一定理、谱定理、内部正则性估计与 Sobolev 嵌入定理，无 sorry，进而得到正规系数与数据下经典可解性的形式化。
AI.motivation: 椭圆偏微分方程 Dirichlet 问题可解性是分析学的核心结果，但其机器验证涉及 Sobolev 空间、泛函分析与正则性等多层理论。本文旨在建立一套自足、无 sorry 的 Lean 4 形式化框架，将经典证明链条完整地机器验证，并独立于已有形式化发展 Sobolev 空间理论。
AI.method: 在 Lean 4 与 Mathlib 之上，独立构建 Sobolev 空间理论，并逐步形式化 Poincaré 不等式、Lax-Milgram 定理给出的弱解存在性、Rellich-Kondrachov 紧性、Fredholm 二择一、谱定理、内部正则性估计及 Sobolev 嵌入定理；论文将每一段数学陈述与其对应的具名 Lean 声明相互关联。
AI.result: 开发成果在 Lean 4 中机器验证且不含 sorry，涵盖上述一系列核心分析定理，并由此获得充分正则系数与数据情形下经典可解性的形式化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了在 Lean 4 中完整形式化二阶线性椭圆方程 Dirichlet 问题可解性证明链的可行性，并提供了独立自足的 Sobolev 空间形式化库，为后续偏微分方程的形式化验证奠定基础。

title: On the T-Adaptive Segment Routing Problem
summary: In this paper, we present a multi-period optimization problem arising from the traffic engineering of core IP/MPLS networks, called T-ASR. This problem aims at computing a sequence of segment routing paths that adapt to a multi-period scheduled maintenance, while allowing limited number of path reconfigurations between successive time steps. Rather than focusing solely on minimizing the classical Maximum Link Utilization (MLU) criteria, we introduce a more refined lexicographic objective that minimizes the entire sorted vector of link loads providing a more efficient resource utilization for all the links. We propose a generic approach that decomposes this problem into a sequence of subproblems. To model each subproblem, we introduce two Mixed Integer Linear Programming (MILP) formulations, ALEXA and STELA, resulting in two variants of our approach. Finally, we evaluate and compare the efficiency of both variants on small to medium-sized network instances.

AI.tldr: 本文研究核心IP/MPLS网络流量工程中的多周期优化问题T-ASR，提出以字典序目标最小化排序后的链路负载向量，并给出分解框架及两种MILP建模（ALEXA与STELA）进行求解与对比。
AI.motivation: 多周期计划性维护下网络流量需动态调整，同时要限制相邻时间步之间的路径重配置次数。传统仅最小化最大链路利用率（MLU）的目标较粗糙，无法兼顾所有链路的资源利用效率，因此需要更精细的优化目标与求解方法。
AI.method: 将T-ASR问题分解为一组子问题序列；对每个子问题构建两种混合整数线性规划（MILP）形式——ALEXA与STELA，由此形成两种求解变体。目标采用字典序方式，最小化整个排序后的链路负载向量，而非仅MLU。
AI.result: 在小型至中型网络实例上对ALEXA与STELA两种变体进行了评估与比较，验证了其效率表现。
AI.conclusion: 提出的分解方法与两种MILP建模能够处理带维护计划与受限重配置的多周期段路由优化，字典序目标可实现更均衡的链路资源利用，为后续大规模应用提供基础。

title: Domain Adaptation with Target Information via Doubly-Anchored Distributionally Robust Optimization
summary: Domain Adaptation (DA) often lacks worst-case guarantees, while Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) based only on source data centers its ambiguity set at the source law and ignores available target structure. To bridge this gap, we introduce a doubly-anchored DRO framework whose ambiguity set is the intersection of $φ$-divergence balls centered at the source law and a source-completed target reference law, the latter pairing the target covariate law with the source conditional law. We derive dual-induced adversarial bridge geometries for symmetric and asymmetric divergence pairings, notably introducing a Kullback--Leibler/squared-Hellinger (KL/HD) bridge. This asymmetric formulation yields a Lambert-$W$ geometry in which source-side exponential risk tilting and target-side Hellinger stabilization enter through distinct terms, attenuating, but not bounding, the effect of large likelihood ratios. Furthermore, without imposing covariate shift, we establish finite-sample generalization bounds for the minimizer of a structural, loss-agnostic density-bridge risk under bounded-overlap conditions; these bounds do not apply directly to the loss-aware DRO min--max estimator. We translate our framework into a bridge-weighted Nadaraya--Watson estimator, proving uniform consistency for the source regression function and pointwise asymptotic normality, with target recovery when the source and target regression functions coincide, as under covariate shift. Finally, an empirical evaluation on a domain-shifted Fashion-MNIST dataset illustrates the finite-sample stability of the asymmetric KL/HD bridge under severe synthetic target-covariate corruption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双锚定分布鲁棒优化（doubly-anchored DRO）框架，将模糊集定义为源分布与“源补全目标参考分布”两个锚点上的 f-散度球交集，并推导出KL/平方-Hellinger桥等对抗桥几何，给出有限样本泛化界与桥加权Nadaraya-Watson估计器的理论性质及实验验证。
AI.motivation: 域适应（DA）通常缺乏最坏情况保证，而仅基于源数据的分布鲁棒优化（DRO）将模糊集中心设在源分布上，忽略了可用的目标域结构。作者试图弥合这一差距，在保留DRO鲁棒性保证的同时利用目标协变量结构。
AI.method: 提出双锚定DRO框架：模糊集为以源分布为心与以“源补全目标参考分布”（目标协变量分布配对源条件分布）为心的 f-散度球之交集。推导对称与非对称散度配对下的对偶诱导对抗桥几何，重点引入KL/平方-Hellinger（KL/HD）桥，其呈现Lambert-W几何：源侧指数风险倾斜与目标侧Hellinger稳定化通过不同项进入。在非协变量偏移假设下，对结构性、与损失无关的密度桥风险最小化器建立有限样本泛化界（有界重叠条件）。将框架转化为桥加权Nadaraya-Watson估计器。
AI.result: 非对称KL/HD桥可减弱但不界定大似然比的影响；在非协变量偏移、有界重叠条件下得到有限样本泛化界（但不直接适用于损失感知的DRO min-max估计器）；证明桥加权Nadaraya-Watson估计器对源回归函数的一致相合性与逐点渐近正态性，当源与目标回归函数一致（如协变量偏移）时实现目标恢复；在域偏移Fashion-MNIST上，严重合成目标协变量污染下非对称KL/HD桥表现出有限样本稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 双锚定DRO通过引入源补全目标参考锚点，弥补了传统DRO忽视目标结构的不足，并借助KL/HD等对抗桥几何在理论与估计器层面提供了可分析、可实现的鲁棒域适应方案，实验表明其在严重协变量污染下具有有限样本稳定性。

title: Application of Machine Learning to the Computation of Parameters in the SUPG Method for Unstructured and Anisotropic Meshes
summary: Solution of convection-dominated problems using stabilized methods often requires to specify stabilization parameters whose optimal choice is not known but which considerably influence the quality of the approximate solution. In a recent work of the authors, an approach for computing these parameters by machine learning was proposed and applied to the streamline upwind/Petrov-Galerkin (SUPG) method for convection-diffusion equations. In the present paper, this approach is studied numerically for unstructured meshes and extended to meshes obtained by anisotropic mesh adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文将机器学习求解稳定化参数的思路推广至非结构网格及各向异性自适应网格，并在对流扩散方程SUPG方法上进行数值验证。
AI.motivation: 对流主导问题的稳定化方法（如SUPG）需指定稳定化参数，其最优取值未知且显著影响近似解质量。
AI.method: 延续作者此前提出的基于机器学习计算稳定化参数的框架，针对非结构网格开展数值研究，并将其扩展至各向异性网格自适应生成的网格。
AI.result: 在非结构网格与各向异性自适应网格上对SUPG方法进行了数值验证，考察了所提学习型参数选取方式的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于机器学习的稳定化参数计算可推广到非结构网格和各向异性自适应网格情形。

title: Product-Aware Deterministic Rounding for Quantized Matrix Multiplication
summary:
Scalar rounding decisions interact through matrix multiplication. We study deterministic
  product-aware rounding after scales, clipping bounds, and grids are fixed, with each active
  scalar choosing between adjacent levels. For dynamic activation rounding, null-space
  reduction preserves the relaxed product while leaving at most $r$ fractional decisions, where
  $r$ is the rank of the active gap-weighted weight block. Conditional-expectation completion
  gives a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm with squared product error at most $
  \mathrm{OPT}_{\mathrm{dyn}}+rν_{\max}^2/4$, where $\mathrm{OPT}_{\mathrm{dyn}}$ is the best
  admissible error and $ν_{\max}$ is the largest row norm of that block. For reusable static
  weights, the exact expected product-loss metric is the uncentered input second moment with
  fixed output bias; free bias recalibration yields the centered covariance. Exact optimization
  is NP-hard even at rank one. In balanced blocks with $K=1024$ and $r=16$, conditional-
  expectation completion attains a dither-normalized median error of $0.010$, compared with
  $0.899$ for round-to-nearest. Clipping-aware initialization reduces median normalized error
  by a factor of $43.4$ at ten-percent clipping. Held-out Digits experiments show that
  retaining the input mean or correcting the output bias improves median product error over
  round-to-nearest in all four tested bit-width and calibration-size settings.

AI.tldr: 研究在固定scale、裁剪界与网格后，通过矩阵乘法耦合的标量舍入决策，提出确定性的乘积感知舍入方法。
AI.motivation: 舍入决策并非独立，而是经矩阵乘法相互作用，因此需在固定量化配置后进行乘积感知的舍入优化。
AI.method: 对动态激活舍入，用零空间约简保留松弛乘积并将分数决策降至至多r个（r为激活间隙加权权重块的秩），再用条件期望补全得到确定性多项式时间算法；对可复用静态权重，导出精确期望乘积损失为未中心化输入二阶矩（固定输出偏置），自由偏置重校准给出中心化协方差。
AI.result: 动态情形平方乘积误差不超过OPT_dyn+rν_max²/4；rank one时精确优化亦NP-hard；K=1024、r=16的平衡块中，方法抖动归一化中位误差0.010，而round-to-nearest为0.899；10%裁剪下裁剪感知初始化将中位归一化误差降低43.4倍；Digits实验中保留输入均值或校正输出偏置在四种位宽与校准规模设置下均优于round-to-nearest。
AI.conclusion: 乘积感知的确定性舍入可在多项式时间内接近最优，并显著优于常规round-to-nearest，偏置校准与裁剪感知初始化是关键增益来源。

title: A two-parameter family of complex structures on $S^6$
summary: We construct a two-parameter family of complex structures on the standard six-sphere, starting from a rational elliptic surface with singular fibers $III^*,I_1,I_1,I_1$. The resulting torus fibration over $\mathbb{P}^1$ has one multiple fiber of multiplicity four, one hexagonal fiber, and two rank-one degenerations. These complex structures are not biholomorphic to the original Alpöge--Claude examples.

AI.tldr: 本文在标准六维球面上构造了一个双参数复结构族，来源于具有 $III^*,I_1,I_1,I_1$ 奇异纤维的有理椭圆曲面，所得环面纤维化的复结构不与 Alpöge–Claude 例子双全纯等价。
AI.motivation: 在六维球面上构造复结构是复几何中长期关注的问题，尤其是构造与已知例子不同的复结构，以丰富对六维球面复结构模空间的理解。
AI.method: 从具有奇异纤维 $III^*,I_1,I_1,I_1$ 的有理椭圆曲面出发，构造 $\mathbb{P}^1$ 上的环面纤维化，该纤维化含一个四重多重纤维、一个六边形纤维和两个秩一退化；由此得到六维球面上的双参数复结构族。
AI.result: 得到标准六维球面上的一族双参数复结构，其纤维化结构包含多重纤维与退化纤维的特定组合，且这些复结构与 Alpöge–Claude 的原始例子不双全纯等价。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了六维球面上新的复结构例子，与既有 Alpöge–Claude 例子不同，表明六维球面复结构存在更丰富的多样性。

title: Out-of-equilibrium finite-time percolation transitions and spinodal-like behaviors after quenches across magnetic first-order transitions of Ising systems
summary: We analyze the out-of-equilibrium relaxational dynamics of ferromagnetic Ising-like systems driven across their low-temperature magnetic first-order transition (FOT) line, by sudden and slow variations of an external homogenous magnetic field $h$. As a paradigmatic example, we consider a two-dimensional Ising system driven across its low-temperature FOT line by suddently quenching $h$ from $h_i<0$ to $h>0$, inducing a transition from the negatively to the positively magnetized phase. We show the emergence of a dynamic percolation transition at a finite critical time $t_c(h)$ along the post-quench evolution for finite (sufficiently small) values of $h$, which is marked by the percolation of the largest positive-spin cluster and the antipercolation of the largest negative-spin cluster. This out-of-equilibrium percolation transition displays a finite-size scaling behavior as in the standard random-percolation case. However, while the fractal dimension of the percolating clusters is consistent with the random-percolation value, the exponent controlling the approach to criticality differs and depends on $h$. We also show that the percolation transition marks the passage from the metastable negatively-magnetized phase to the stable positively-magnetized one. Therefore, in the small-$h$ limit, the percolation critical behavior is related to the spinodal-like behavior of the magnetization, implying that the percolation time $t_c(h)$ exhibits a spinodal-like exponential dependence on $h$. The existence of percolation transitions is likely a generic phenomenon at magnetic Ising-like FOTs. For example, we observe an analogous behavior in dynamic (Kibble-Zurek-like) protocols entailing slow variations of the magnetic field driving the crossing of the FOT line.

AI.tldr: 研究了二维类Ising铁磁系统在外场驱动下跨越低温一级相变时出现的动力学渗流转变及其标度行为。
AI.motivation: 理解磁性一级相变（FOT）的非平衡弛豫动力学中是否存在渗流转变，以及其临界行为与相变机制的联系。
AI.method: 对二维Ising系统施加均匀磁场h，通过淬火（从h_i<0到h>0）和缓慢变化（类Kibble-Zurek协议）驱动系统跨越低温FOT线，分析最大正/负自旋团簇的渗流与反渗流行为。
AI.result: 在淬火后演化中发现有限临界时间t_c(h)处的动力学渗流转变；具有标准随机渗流的有限尺寸标度行为，分形维数一致但临界趋近指数依赖h；渗流转变标志从亚稳负磁化相到稳定正磁化相的转变；t_c(h)呈自旋odal-like指数依赖。缓慢驱动协议中观察到类似行为。
AI.conclusion: 渗流转变很可能是磁性Ising类FOT的普遍现象，其临界行为与小h极限下的自旋odal行为相关。

title: Compressible unsteady aerodynamics of finite-chord porous aerofoils
summary: A unified linear theory is developed for the unsteady loading of finite-chord aerofoils, rigid or porous, in compressible subsonic flow. The formulation combines Possio's integral operator with a convective permeable boundary condition, allowing chordwise-varying admittance while retaining the wake and unsteady Kutta condition. The loading exponents at aerofoil edges and admittance discontinuities keep their incompressible form in terms of the local permeability parameter, so weighted-Jacobi collocation carries over. The solution is verified against published incompressible results and an independent compressible formulation. Gust and heave responses and their indicial counterparts reveal that permeability controls the sensitivity of unsteady loading to compressibility. As permeability increases, the material impedance rather than the surrounding flow sets the pressure jump, but only gradually: at Mach number 0.7 the gust load on a weakly permeable surface changes by a third to a half, and closed-form steady and high-frequency limits for resistive surfaces show that it vanishes only when the permeability parameter greatly exceeds the Mach number. The porous-to-impermeable load ratio, by which a treatment is judged, cannot be obtained by combining incompressible porous and compressible rigid theories, which misjudge it by up to a factor of two. Incompressible theory overestimates this ratio for an acoustically compact chord and underestimates it for a non-compact one, by factors of 1.4 to 4.3 at Mach numbers 0.5 to 0.7 and reduced frequencies 5 to 20, overstating the load reduction. Since compactness depends on Mach number times reduced frequency, the error persists at low speed, exceeding 10 per cent at Mach number 0.05 for reduced frequencies above 10.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了有限弦长翼型（刚性或可渗透）在可压缩亚声速流中非定常载荷的统一线性理论，揭示渗透率调控载荷对压缩性敏感度的机制，并指出不可压缩理论及简单叠加方法在评估多孔减载比时存在显著误差。
AI.motivation: 多孔翼型减载研究长期依赖不可压缩理论，或将不可压缩多孔理论与可压缩刚性理论简单叠加来估计多孔-不可渗透载荷比。作者旨在厘清可压缩性与表面渗透率之间是否及如何耦合，并检验上述近似方法的适用范围与误差。
AI.method: 将Possio积分算子与对流可渗透边界条件结合，允许展向（弦向）变化的导纳，同时保留尾迹与非定常Kutta条件。利用翼型边缘及导纳间断处的载荷奇性指数在可压缩情形下仍保持不可压缩形式（以局部渗透率参数表示），从而将加权Jacobi配点法推广适用。与已发表的不可压缩结果及独立可压缩公式进行验证。
AI.result: 渗透率控制非定常载荷对压缩性的敏感度。随渗透率增大，压力跃变由材料阻抗而非绕流决定，但这一转变是渐进的：马赫数0.7时弱渗透表面阵风载荷变化三分之一至一半。阻力型表面的稳态与高频闭式极限表明，仅当渗透率参数远大于马赫数时载荷才消失。多孔-不可渗透载荷比无法由不可压缩多孔理论与可压缩刚性理论叠加获得，误差可达两倍；不可压缩理论在声学紧凑弦长下高估该比值、非紧凑弦长下低估，在马赫数0.5至0.7、折合频率5至20时误差为1.4至4.3倍。由于紧凑性取决于马赫数乘以折合频率，低速下误差依然存在，马赫数0.05、折合频率高于10时误差超过10%。
AI.conclusion: 可压缩性与表面渗透率存在不可忽略的耦合，多孔减载评估必须采用统一的可压缩理论；简单叠加或纯不可压缩方法会高估减载效果，且在非紧凑弦长与较宽马赫数、频率范围内误差显著。

title: On solutions for damped fractional Navier-Stokes equations in a critical Lei-Lin-Gevrey space
summary: We study the fractional Navier-Stokes equations with cubic damping in the specific Lei-Lin-Gevrey space $\mathcal{X}^0_{a,σ}(\mathbb{R}^3)$ (with $a\geq0$ and $σ\geq1$). We establish local and small-data global well-posedness, quantitative blow-up criteria, Gevrey loss-of-radius estimates, and perturbative stability in the critical endpoint case $γ=\frac12$ of the usual Navier-Stokes system.

AI.tldr: 研究了带三次阻尼的分数阶Navier-Stokes方程在特定Lei-Lin-Gevrey空间中的适定性与爆破判据，给出了临界端点情形下的定量结果。
AI.motivation: 考察带三次阻尼的分数阶Navier-Stokes方程在Lei-Lin-Gevrey型空间中的可解性，并关注临界端点γ=1/2这一难度最高的情形。
AI.method: 在Lei-Lin-Gevrey空间X^0_{a,σ}(R^3)（a≥0, σ≥1）框架下，结合阻尼项的能量估计与Gevrey解析性分析，建立适定性与爆破理论。
AI.result: 得到了局部适定性与小初值整体适定性、定量爆破判据、Gevrey半径损失估计，以及临界端点γ=1/2处的扰动稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明在临界端点γ=1/2时，该方程在Lei-Lin-Gevrey空间中仍具有良好的适定性与稳定性，并给出显式的爆破与解析半径控制。

title: The Complexity of Convex Optimization with Mismatched Geometry
summary: Optimal first-order methods on non-Euclidean domains such as the $\ell_1$ ball $B_1^n(R)=\{x\in\mathbb R^n:\|x\|_1\le R\}$ pair the prox-function with the norm in which smoothness is measured. When the gradient is $L$-Lipschitz in the Euclidean norm only, the accelerated method with a Euclidean prox-setup reduces the functional gap $f(x_N)-\min_{B_1^n(R)}f$ to $O(LR^2/N^2)$ after $N$ first-order queries (an entropic $\ell_1$ prox-setup replaces $L$ by the $\ell_1\to\ell_\infty$ constant $L_1\le L$, at the cost of a factor $\log n$ and with the same exponent). The lower bound of Guzmán and Nemirovski is of order $LR^2/N^3$, and whether the upper bound can be brought down to that order is a question of A. S. Nemirovski. We show that for this mismatched problem the minimax value of the gap is of order $LR^2/N^3$ up to logarithmic factors, for deterministic and for randomized methods alike, and already in dimension proportional to the number of queries. The upper bound is attained by a Steiner-point level method: every supporting hyperplane seen so far is kept as a level cut, and the next query is made near the Steiner point of the resulting localization polytope. The analysis rests on a single geometric fact: along nested subsets of the ball the Steiner points travel a distance that is polylogarithmic in the dimension, in contrast to $\sqrt n$ for the Euclidean ball. All queries stay feasible, and a randomized selector keeps the internal work polynomial. The same geometry yields optimal rates for nonsmooth objectives, Hölder gradients, higher-order oracles and Lipschitz monotone operators, the last with a matching deterministic lower bound. For convex quadratics, a curvature-learning method attains the optimal rate on every $\ell_p$ ball with $1\le p<2$ and without logarithmic loss. Experiments confirm the predicted $N^{-3}$ behaviour on objectives that are hard for Euclidean methods.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了Nemirovski提出的错配问题：当梯度仅在欧氏范数下Lipschitz而域为ℓ1球时，minimax间隙可达LR²/N³（忽略对数因子），由Steiner点水平方法实现，且在维数与查询数成正比时已成立。
AI.motivation: 在ℓ1球等非欧域上，最优一阶方法需将prox函数与度量光滑性的范数配对。但当梯度仅在欧氏范数下Lipschitz时，欧氏prox-setup的加速法上界为O(LR²/N²)，而Guzmán-Nemirovski下界为LR²/N³，上界能否降至该阶数是Nemirovski提出的公开问题。
AI.method: 提出Steiner点水平方法：保留迄今所有支撑超平面作为水平割，在所得定位多面体的Steiner点附近选取下一次查询。分析基于单一几何事实——沿球体的嵌套子集，Steiner点移动距离仅对维数呈多对数级（相对地欧氏球为√n）。所有查询均保持可行，随机选择器保持内部计算为多项式时间。
AI.result: 证明该错配问题的minimax间隙阶为LR²/N³（至多对数因子），对确定性与随机方法均成立，且维数与查询数成正比时即已发生。同一几何还给出非光滑目标、Hölder梯度、高阶oracle及Lipschitz单调算子的最优速率（后者有匹配的确定性下界）。对凸二次型，曲率学习法在任意ℓp球（1≤p<2）上达到最优速率且无对数损失。实验验证了对欧氏方法困难的目标准确呈现N⁻³行为。
AI.conclusion: 通过Steiner点结构性质刻画ℓ1球的几何，将错配问题的上界从N⁻²改进至最优的N⁻³，统一解决确定与随机情形，并推广至多种设置与更一般ℓp域。

title: Sliced Orlicz-Wasserstein
summary: We propose sliced Orlicz-Wasserstein (SOW) distance which is a generalization of sliced Wasserstein (SW) distance. SOW replaces the $L^p$ norm in SW with a Luxemburg norm cost induced by an Orlicz function $φ$. First, we prove that SOW distance is a metric on the space of measures with finite Orlicz norm, and show that it recovers the SW distance when the Orlicz function is $φ(x)=x^p$. Next, we derive the topological properties of the SOW distance. In particular, we show that convergence under SOW implies weak convergence, and the converse is true under the compact support condition. We then present the theoretical results for estimating the SOW distance. We derive sample complexity for both the distance itself and the powered functional of the distance, and prove their minimax optimality. In addition, we discuss the computational algorithm for approximating the SOW distance by Monte-Carlo estimation and bisection search, as well as the associated approximation error and computational complexity analysis. Our experimental results reveal the superior computational efficiency of SOW compared with Orlicz-Wasserstein (OW) distance. Also, in the experiments, we demonstrate the favorable flexibility of SOW distance over SW in detecting differences between distributions by comparing their performance in two-sample tests and evaluating generative models on image datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出切片Orlicz-Wasserstein（SOW）距离，将SW中的L^p范数替换为Orlicz函数诱导的Luxemburg范数代价，并给出度量性、拓扑性、统计与计算性质及实验验证。
AI.motivation: SW距离计算高效但对分布差异的刻画受限于L^p代价；Orlicz-Wasserstein（OW）更灵活但计算代价高。作者希望在保留切片方法计算效率的同时，引入Orlicz函数的灵活性以更好地检测分布差异。
AI.method: 定义SOW：在随机一维投影上以Orlicz函数φ诱导的Luxemburg范数替代L^p范数；证明其为有限Orlicz范数测度空间上的度量，并给出φ(x)=x^p时退化为SW。分析拓扑性质（SOW收敛蕴含弱收敛，紧支撑下反之成立）。推导距离及其幂次泛函的样本复杂度并证明极小极大最优性。给出基于Monte-Carlo估计与二分搜索的近似算法及误差与复杂度分析。
AI.result: SOW为度量且在φ(x)=x^p时恢复SW；SOW收敛蕴含弱收敛，紧支撑下等价；距离及幂次泛函的样本复杂度达极小极大最优；给出近似误差与计算复杂度分析；实验显示SOW计算效率优于OW，且在双样本检验与图像生成模型评估中比SW更具灵活性。
AI.conclusion: SOW在保持切片方法计算效率的同时，通过Orlicz代价获得更强的分布差异检测灵活性，兼具理论保证（度量性、拓扑性、最优样本复杂度）与实用价值。

title: Active Subspace-Guided Free-Form Deformation with Sinkhorn Autoencoders for Reduced-Order Modelling of Parametrised Shape Problems
summary: Geometrically parametrised PDEs arise in shape optimisation, where solving a PDE over many deformed domains at manageable cost is a central challenge. Free-form Deformation (FFD) parametrises shape variations through a lattice of control points, but the resulting parameter space is typically high-dimensional, with most directions barely affecting the quantity of interest (QoI). We address this with a two-stage reduction pipeline. An Active Subspace (AS)-guided structured control-point selection identifies the low-dimensional subspace of FFD weights driving the QoI. A Sinkhorn Autoencoder (SAE) is then trained on the reduced weights, learning their distribution in a compact latent space by minimising the Wasserstein distance between aggregated posterior and prior. We compare three non-intrusive Reduced-order Models (ROMs), mapping full FFD weights, AS-reduced weights, or SAE latent codes to the QoI, each using Random Forests, Gaussian Processes, and K-Nearest Neighbours. We test the methodology on a non-linear heat equation with Gaussian random Robin boundary data on a deformed Stanford Bunny, and on drag prediction for the DTC Hull bulb under FFD deformations. In both cases, the generative model captures the bulk of the QoI distribution over a comparable support, thinning the shoulder opposite the design objective, while its extremes in the design-relevant direction match the FFD sample within numerical and sampling uncertainty. ROMs learned in the SAE latent space yield smaller test errors than those on full FFD weights in most regressor-metric combinations, whereas AS-reduced weights give no comparable gain. Only the latent representation attains a positive predictive coefficient $Q^2$.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对几何参数化PDE（形状优化中需在大量变形域上求解PDE）的高维参数空间问题，提出"主动子空间(AS)引导的控制点选择 + Sinkhorn自编码器(SAE)"两阶段降维流程，并比较三种非侵入式ROM在FFD全权重、AS降维权重和SAE潜码上的性能。
AI.motivation: 自由变形(FFD)通过控制点格架参数化形状变化，但所得参数空间通常维度很高，且大多数方向对目标量(QoI)影响甚微，导致在众多变形域上以可接受成本求解PDE成为核心挑战。因此需要有效降维以降低ROM构建成本。
AI.method: 两阶段降维pipeline：(1) 主动子空间(AS)引导的结构化控制点选择，识别驱动QoI的低维FFD权重子空间；(2) 在降维后的权重上训练Sinkhorn自编码器(SAE)，通过最小化聚合后验与先验之间的Wasserstein距离，在紧致潜空间中学习其分布。随后比较三种非侵入式ROM（以随机森林、高斯过程、K近邻为回归器），分别将FFD全权重、AS降维权重、SAE潜码映射到QoI。
AI.result: 在变形Stanford Bunny上带高斯随机Robin边界数据的非线性热方程，以及DTC Hull球鼻艏在FFD变形下的阻力预测两个算例中：生成模型在相近支撑上捕获了QoI分布的主体，削薄了背离设计目标的肩部，而其设计相关方向的极值在数值与采样不确定性内与FFD样本一致。在多数回归器-度量组合中，SAE潜空间学习的ROM测试误差小于FFD全权重ROM；AS降维权重则未带来可比增益。仅潜表示取得正的预测系数Q²。
AI.conclusion: SAE潜码表示在几何参数化PDE的降维与代理建模中优于FFD全权重及AS降维权重，是唯一获得正预测系数Q²的表示形式，表明结合AS引导控制点选择与SAE潜空间学习的降维流程能有效提升非侵入式ROM的预测精度。

title: Information Design Against Gaming and Learning Adversaries
summary: A principal who deploys a binary classifier with an abstention option must decide which queries the mechanism abstains on. The right choice depends on the adversary. A gaming adversary already knows the classifier and tries to manipulate features across the boundary, so the principal does best by abstaining on queries close to that boundary. The same boundary-localizing rule is the worst possible choice against a learning adversary who does not know the classifier: each abstention now tells the adversary that the boundary is nearby, which is enough to drive a binary search. We analyze this tension. The two natural defenses, abstaining at a fixed rate and abstaining near the boundary, are Blackwell-incomparable: neither can be simulated by post-processing the other's responses. The number of queries needed to reconstruct the boundary to error $\eps$ is $\tildeΘ(d/\eps)$ under the first defense and $Θ(d \log(1/\eps))$ under the second, where $d$ is the VC dimension of the classifier family and $\tildeΘ$ suppresses factors polylogarithmic in $d$ and $1/\eps$. The first rate is a worst case over query distributions; no reconstruction algorithm can close the gap at the distributions that attain it. We characterize the Pareto frontier between the two defense objectives, and confirm both rates on seven binary-classification tasks spanning tabular, image, and language-model-feature inputs: label-plus-counterfactual access extracts the boundary with up to $200\times$ fewer queries than a published label-only baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文分析二元分类器在"弃权"机制下面临的两类对手（博弈型与学习型）之间的张力，指出两种防御（固定比率弃权与边界附近弃权）在Blackwell意义下不可比，并给出边界重构的查询复杂度：前者为 $\tilde\Theta(d/\eps)$，后者为 $\Theta(d\log(1/\eps))$，最后刻画了二者防御目标间的Pareto前沿。
AI.motivation: 部署带弃权选项的二元分类器时，弃权规则的选择取决于对手类型：博弈型对手已知分类器并试图操纵特征跨越边界，因此应在大边界附近弃权；而学习型对手不知道分类器，此时同样的边界定位规则反而最糟——每次弃权都泄露"边界就在附近"的信息，足以驱动二分搜索。论文旨在系统分析这一张力，明确哪种弃权策略在何种对手下有效，并量化其代价。
AI.method: 作者从理论上定义并对比两种自然防御策略：固定比率弃权和边界附近弃权。利用Blackwell可比性分析证明二者不可互相通过后处理模拟；通过查询复杂度分析，推导边界重构至误差 $\eps$ 所需查询数；并刻画两种防御目标之间的Pareto前沿。实验上在七个二元分类任务（表格、图像、语言模型特征）上验证理论速率，并比较label-plus-counterfactual访问与已发表的label-only基线。
AI.result: 理论结果：(1) 两种防御Blackwell不可比，任一方都无法通过后处理另一方的响应来模拟；(2) 边界重构至误差 $\eps$ 的查询数在固定比率弃权下为 $\tilde\Theta(d/\eps)$，在边界附近弃权下为 $\Theta(d\log(1/\eps))$，其中 $d$ 为分类器族的VC维；(3) 前者是查询分布上的最坏情况，且无算法能在达到该速率的分布上缩小差距。实验上在七个二元分类任务上证实了两种速率，且label-plus-counterfactual访问比已发表的label-only基线最多少用 $200\times$ 查询即可提取边界。
AI.conclusion: 弃权策略的选择本质上是对手依赖的：面对博弈型对手，边界附近弃权最优；面对学习型对手，则因泄露边界信息而最差。固定比率弃权与边界附近弃权在信息论上不可比，两者构成Pareto权衡。边界重构速率由VC维和误差决定，且label-plus-counterfactual访问显著提升提取效率。该工作为设计对抗环境下的弃权机制提供了理论框架与实践指导。

title: Perfectoidness of Proper Shimura Varieties With Limpid Integral Models
summary: We prove that any proper Shimura variety admitting a limpid integral model in the sense of Madapusi Pera becomes a perfectoid space at infinite level at $p$. Our method provides a new geometric approach that circumvents the need for a universal abelian scheme, making it applicable beyond Shimura varieties of Hodge type. Inspired by Scholze's proof of the perfectoidness of the Siegel modular variety, we construct analogues of the canonical subgroup and the anticanonical tower within a strict neighborhood of the ordinary locus. To achieve this we utilize the geometry of the universal $G$-aperture over the limpid integral model. Because every Shimura variety admits a limpid integral model for sufficiently large primes, our result implies that all proper Shimura varieties are globally perfectoid at infinite level for big enough primes.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明：任何具有limpide整模型的真Shimura簇在无穷层于p处成为完美空间，从而推出足够大的素数下所有真Shimura簇在无穷层整体是完美空间。
AI.motivation: Scholze对Siegel模簇完美性的证明依赖于通用阿贝尔簇，这一方法难以推广到Hodge型以外的Shimura簇。作者希望找到一种不依赖通用阿贝尔簇的几何方法，以突破Hodge型的限制。
AI.method: 受Scholze证明Siegel模簇完美性的启发，在普通轨迹的严格邻域内构造规范子群与反规范塔的类比；利用limpide整模型上通用G-aperture的几何性质，避开通用阿贝尔簇的使用。
AI.result: 证明了任何承认Madapusi Pera意义下limpide整模型的真Shimura簇在无穷层于p处是完美空间。
AI.conclusion: 由于每个Shimura簇在足够大的素数下都存在limpide整模型，因此所有真Shimura簇在足够大的素数下于无穷层整体是完美空间。

title: Speed-Fisher Information: Chaos and Irreversibility in Classical and Quantum Dynamics
summary: We propose a unified perspective on classical and quantum chaos based on the sensitivity of a system's stationary states to slow driving. We probe this sensitivity via the system's susceptibility to the average protocol speed, which we call the ``speed-Fisher information," and relate it to irreversible entropy production in the system. We show that chaotic dynamics manifests as a divergence of the speed-Fisher information with the protocol time, and that this response is controlled by the perturbation's low-frequency spectral weight. This approach to chaos applies to both classical and quantum Hamiltonian systems, and naturally extends to non-Hamiltonian classical flows. Additionally, we identify a quantum regime at times shorter than the Planckian timescale, in which the speed-Fisher information exhibits a uniquely quantum scaling. We illustrate this framework with simple classical and quantum examples

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于系统定态对慢驱动敏感性的混沌统一视角，定义"速度-费舍尔信息"并关联不可逆熵产生，证明混沌表现为该信息随协议时间发散，且由扰动低频谱权重控制；框架适用于经典与量子哈密顿系统并推广至非哈密顿经典流，还发现短于普朗克时间的独特量子标度区。
AI.motivation: 经典混沌与量子混沌长期以来缺乏统一的刻画框架。作者希望找到一个同时适用于经典与量子系统的普适判据，从系统定态对慢驱动的敏感性角度统一描述混沌现象。
AI.method: 引入系统对平均协议速度的敏感性度量，称为"速度-费舍尔信息"（speed-Fisher information），并将其与系统不可逆熵产生相联系。通过分析该信息随协议时间的标度行为，结合扰动的低频谱权重来刻画混沌动力学，并推广到非哈密顿经典流。
AI.result: 混沌动力学表现为速度-费舍尔信息随协议时间发散，该响应由扰动低频谱权重控制。该判据同时适用于经典和量子哈密顿系统，并自然扩展至非哈密顿经典流。此外，在短于普朗克时间尺度上识别出一个独特的量子标度区域，其速度-费舍尔信息呈现纯量子标度行为。以简单经典和量子例子进行了演示。
AI.conclusion: 速度-费舍尔信息为经典与量子混沌提供了统一刻画，揭示混沌与不可逆熵产生及低频谱权重之间的内在联系，并预言了普朗克时间以下的独特量子标度区，为混沌研究提供了跨经典-量子边界的新工具。

title: Experimental assessment of a scalar-dissipation-rate sub-grid-scale closure for Large Eddy Simulation of turbulent premixed flames
summary: A sub-grid closure of the scalar-dissipation rate for the Large Eddy Simulation (LES) of turbulent premixed flames is assessed experimentally. Hotwire anemometry is performed to characterize the background turbulent flow, and the Rayleigh scattering measurements are conducted to acquire instantaneous temperature fields, which are used to obtain the scalar dissipation rate. Either methane or hydrogen-enriched (40% by volume) methane is used as the fuel. The Karlovitz number varies between 1.7 and 34.5. The LES filter size is changed from 0.1 to 3.0 times the thermal thickness of the corresponding laminar flames. Both Gaussian and top-hat filtering methods are used. Statistical analyses are performed to investigate the characteristics of the measured, resolved, and unresolved scalar dissipation rate as well as how these are influenced by the normalized filter size, filter type, and the Karlovitz number. It is shown that the algebraic model allows for acceptable prediction of the Favre-filtered, temporally and spatially averaged scalar dissipation rate across the examined test conditions. The experimental measurements are used to gain insight into a key parameter used in the algebraic model. While differences between the previously proposed and our measured value of the model parameter for small Karlovitz number flames are reported, good agreement between our measured values and previously suggested values is obtained for relatively larger Karlovitz number flames. This finding is shown to be consistent across the examined filter sizes and filtering methods, despite the differences in the examined flame configuration of the present experimental study and those of past numerical investigations. This motivates future investigations to assess use of the algebraic model for simulating turbulent premixed flames with an extended range of operation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验评估了湍流预混火焰大涡模拟中亚网格标量耗散率的代数模型，考察了滤波尺寸、滤波类型和Karlovitz数的影响，并验证了模型参数的适用性。
AI.motivation: 湍流预混火焰的大涡模拟需要准确的亚网格标量耗散率闭包模型，而现有代数模型的适用性和参数取值尚需实验验证，尤其在不同燃料、Karlovitz数和滤波条件下。
AI.method: 采用热丝风速仪表征背景湍流，瑞利散射测量获取瞬态温度场进而得到标量耗散率；燃料为甲烷或掺氢（体积40%）甲烷，Karlovitz数在1.7至34.5之间；LES滤波尺寸为层流火焰热厚度的0.1至3.0倍，采用高斯和顶帽两种滤波方法，并进行统计分析。
AI.result: 代数模型能在所考察工况下合理预测Favre滤波、时空平均的标量耗散率；小Karlovitz数火焰的实测模型参数与以往建议值存在差异，而较大Karlovitz数火焰的实测值与以往建议值吻合良好，且该结论在不同滤波尺寸和方法下一致。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持代数模型在更宽运行范围内模拟湍流预混火焰的潜力，尽管本实验火焰构型与以往数值研究不同，仍激发未来进一步评估该模型的应用。

title: Fitness is asymptotically irrelevant under uniform competition in phenotype-structured populations
summary: We prove that, in phenotype-structured populations under uniform competition, the long-term phenotypic distribution does not depend on the proliferation rates: it is the stationary distribution of the switching dynamics alone. The density u(x,t) of cells with phenotype x evolves by advection and diffusion in phenotype space (switching) and by proliferation at a phenotype-dependent rate r(x,t), modulated by a factor g(U) common to all phenotypes, where U is the total population. This extends to continuous phenotypes a recent result for compartmental models. On a bounded interval with no-flux boundary conditions, the total population converges monotonically to the carrying capacity U*, the density converges in L1 to U*psi, where psi is the stationary density of the switching dynamics, and the nonlinear model is asymptotically equivalent to the linear one; by an explicit estimate, the imprint of fitness decays at the spectral gap of the switching dynamics. On the whole real line we prove the same convergence under two natural conditions, confinement and no escape to infinity, covering Ornstein-Uhlenbeck dynamics, multi-well landscapes, and heavy-tailed densities. If g'(U*) < 0 and psi satisfies a Poincare inequality, convergence is exponential in a weighted L2 norm, while no uniform L1 rate holds for Ornstein-Uhlenbeck dynamics. The proof follows the compartmental one: under uniform competition the reaction term has one sign, so its size is the growth rate of the total population, integrable in time, and the switching dynamics contracts the zero-mass perturbations it produces. Since it uses only the Markov semigroup generated by switching, the proof extends to general mechanisms; we apply it to nonlocal switching by jumps and to diffusions with non-gradient drift in bounded domains of R^d, whose stationary density is not of Boltzmann form and carries a circulating flux.

AI.tldr: 在均匀竞争的表型结构种群中，长期表型分布不依赖增殖率，仅由切换动力学的平稳分布决定。该结论在一维有界区间和实直线上成立，并推广至跳跃型非局部切换及 R^d 有界域中非梯度漂移扩散。
AI.motivation: 将 compartmental 模型的近期结果推广到连续表型的情形，澄清表型分布长期行为是否依赖增殖（适应度）率，并建立非线性模型与线性切换模型之间的渐近等价性。
AI.method: 研究表型密度 u(x,t) 在表型空间中的 advection-diffusion（切换）与表型依赖增殖率 r(x,t) 及公共调节因子 g(U) 下的演化方程。核心论证：均匀竞争下反应项只有一种符号，其大小等于总种群的增长率，因而在时间上可积；切换动力学对所产生零质量扰动具有收缩性。证明仅依赖切换生成的 Markov 半群，故可推广至一般机制。
AI.result: 有界区间无通量边界下，总种群单调收敛到承载容量 U*，密度在 L1 中收敛到 U*psi（psi 为切换动力学的平稳密度），非线性模型渐近等价于线性模型，适应度印记以切换动力学的谱隙速率衰减。实直线上在 confinement 与 no escape to infinity 两条件下同样收敛，涵盖 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 动力学、多井景观与重尾密度。若 g'(U*)<0 且 psi 满足 Poincare 不等式，则在加权 L2 范数下指数收敛；但 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 动力学不存在一致的 L1 收敛速率。
AI.conclusion: 长期表型分布由切换动力学单独决定，增殖率的影响仅以谱隙速率衰减的印记形式出现；证明框架基于 Markov 半群，可应用于跳跃型非局部切换及 R^d 有界域中平稳密度非 Boltzmann 型、带有循环通量的非梯度漂移扩散。

title: Obtaining Game-Stationary Points for Smooth Nonconvex-Nonconcave Minimax Problems via First-Order Methods
summary: Minimax optimization is a fundamental framework in machine learning, robust optimization, and game theory, yet finding first-order stationary points of general nonconvex-nonconcave minimax problems remains challenging without additional structural assumptions. Existing guarantees often rely on global PL- or KL-type conditions that connect max-player stationarity to global inner optimality, or on Minty-type conditions that impose a global relation on the game gradient field relative to a reference solution; local KL variants relax the former requirement but typically require initialization and tracking within a near-optimal region. Such conditions may be difficult to satisfy in many applications.
