Distribution steering is a problem in which a control policy is designed over a distribution of trajectories rather than optimizing a single trajectory. The challenge with nonlinear systems is that even initially Gaussian distributions evolve into non-Gaussian distributions, often precluding a closed-form representation of the probability density. A method called statistical moment steering applies a cubature-based method to approximate non-Gaussian distributions for an approximate solution to this problem. This paper provides theoretical support and details how it can be solved with sequential convex optimization. A coupled, nonlinear, second-order ordinary differential equation describing a two-dimensional oscillator is provided as a numerical example.

AI.tldr: 本文研究确定性非线性系统的离散时间非高斯分布操纵问题，提出基于统计矩操纵与cubature近似并结合序列凸优化的求解框架，并以二维耦合非线性振子ODE为数值算例。
AI.motivation: 分布操纵要求在轨迹分布层面设计控制策略，而非优化单条轨迹。非线性系统的难点在于初始高斯分布会演化为非高斯分布，导致概率密度通常不存在闭式表达，难以直接求解。
AI.method: 采用统计矩操纵（statistical moment steering）方法，利用基于cubature的方法近似非高斯分布以获得该问题的近似解；同时给出理论支撑，并说明如何通过序列凸优化（sequential convex optimization）进行求解。
AI.result: 为该近似求解提供了理论支持，并给出了序列凸优化的实现细节；通过一个描述二维振子的耦合非线性二阶常微分方程作为数值算例验证。
AI.conclusion: 统计矩操纵结合cubature近似与序列凸优化，可为确定性非线性系统中的离散时间非高斯分布操纵提供可行的近似求解途径，并在二维非线性振子算例中得到展示。

title: Sharp training-conditional coverage for conformal prediction under covariate shift
summary: Weighted split conformal prediction reweights calibration scores by the likelihood ratio between the test and training covariate distributions and guarantees marginal coverage under covariate shift. We study its coverage conditional on the calibration data. An elementary argument, based on a single concentration inequality at a fixed population quantile, gives explicit training-conditional bounds without unspecified constants, and shows that the relevant scale is not the supremum of the likelihood ratio but a variance proxy built from the chi-squared divergence of the shift and from the average of the ratio over the part of the test population, of probability equal to the miscoverage level, where it is largest. A two-point lower bound shows that the root-m rate and the chi-squared contribution are intrinsic to the shift. Run at an explicitly inflated level, the weighted quantile becomes a deterministic PAC prediction set. We compare it with randomized rejection sampling and with importance-weighted learn-then-test and, through a certified choice of a clipping level for the likelihood ratio, map the regime in which each gives the narrower valid set. The analysis extends to estimated likelihood ratios and to tail functionals estimated from an unlabeled source sample, which yields a fully finite-sample certificate.

AI.tldr: 本文研究加权分裂共形预测在校准数据条件下的覆盖率，给出显式的训练条件界，并刻画协变量偏移下有效预测集的宽度比较。
AI.motivation: 加权分裂共形预测通过测试与训练协变量分布之间的似然比重加权校准分数，保证协变量偏移下的边际覆盖率。然而其在校准数据条件下的覆盖行为尚缺乏显式、无未定常数的刻画，且不同方法在何种偏移情形下给出更窄有效集尚不清晰。
AI.method: 基于固定总体分位数处的单一集中不等式给出显式训练条件界；用偏移的卡方散度构造方差代理量，并取测试总体中概率等于误覆盖水平、似然比最大的那部分上的比率均值；给出两点下界；在显式膨胀水平上运行使加权分位数成为确定性的PAC预测集；通过认证的似然比截断水平，与随机拒绝采样及重要性加权learn-then-test比较；并推广至估计的似然比与由无标签源样本估计的尾泛函。
AI.result: 相关尺度并非似然比的上确界，而是由偏移的卡方散度与上述最大比率均值构成的方差代理量；两点下界表明根号m速率与卡方贡献是偏移的内在属性；在显式膨胀水平下加权分位数成为确定性PAC预测集；通过认证的截断水平刻画了各方法给出更窄有效集的区间；对估计似然比与无标签源样本尾泛函的分析给出完全有限样本的证明。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为加权分裂共形预测提供了校准条件覆盖的显式有限样本刻画，证明根号m速率与卡方项不可去除，并通过认证截断水平明确不同方法的优劣区间，且扩展至似然比估计与尾泛函估计情形。

title: Neural Network-Assisted Refinement of Traditional Schemes for One-Dimensional Scalar Conservation Laws
summary: A clear link is established between conventional numerical methods and neural network approximations for solving one-dimensional scalar conservation laws. The focus is on the construction of an appropriate flux term in the case of convex flux functions for improving the classical schemes. The first neural network developed here is able to rediscover Godunov's method, while the second one emulates the behavior of a second-order slope-limiter function. In this way, by merging them, second-order reconstruction-based schemes can be developed. The networks presented here employ a minimal number of parameters, significantly reducing the complexity compared to previous approaches. These networks can also be linked consecutively to get a deep one corresponding to multiple time steps. Training them with an appropriate loss leads to stable schemes, improving even the classical methods without increasing their complexity.

AI.tldr: 该文在数值方法与神经网络近似之间建立联系，用极简参数网络重构求解一维标量守恒律的通量项，可再发现Godunov方法并模拟二阶斜率限制器，合并后得到稳定的二阶重构型格式。
AI.motivation: 在求解一维标量守恒律时，经典数值格式（如Godunov法与二阶重构格式）已有成熟理论，但如何在保持一致精度与稳定性的同时降低复杂度、并借助神经网络改进经典格式，仍值得探索。作者希望显式地在传统数值方法与神经网络近似之间建立对应关系。
AI.method: 针对凸通量函数，构造合适的通量项以改进经典格式：第一个神经网络用于再发现Godunov方法，第二个神经网络模拟二阶斜率限制器函数的行为；将二者合并可构造二阶重构型格式。所提网络参数极少，且可串联成对应多时间步的深度网络，并以合适损失函数进行训练。
AI.result: 参数极少的网络成功再发现Godunov方法并再现二阶斜率限制器行为；合并后形成稳定的二阶重构型格式，其复杂度较以往方法显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络近似与传统数值方法之间存在清晰联系；在合适损失训练下可得稳定格式，甚至在不增加复杂度的前提下改进经典方法。

title: Beyond the Graph: An Adaptive Meta-Learner Fuses Explainability, Weather, and Dynamics for Robust Bus ETA Prediction
summary: Accurate bus Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) prediction is vital for urban mobility, passenger satisfaction, and transit efficiency, yet existing models falter against nonlinear spatiotemporal dynamics, data sparsity, and factors such as weather. This paper proposes HYB(nm), an adaptive hybrid ensemble framework that dynamically fuses five complementary models - a historical baseline (MST-AV), periodical temporal pattern analysis (GDRN-DFT), Koopman Neural Operators for nonlinear dynamics (KOOP-NET), weather-integrated feature-engineered neural networks (FENN), and real-time graph convolutional networks (MGCN) - via a meta-learner attuned to real-time context. Evaluated on GPS and weather data from three Kolkata bus routes comprising more than 4,000 trips, the framework leverages the individual strengths of its components (for example, the low-latency explainability of MST-AV, the weather resilience of FENN, and the network-dynamics capture of MGCN) to deliver the superior robustness of HYB(2), state-of-the-art accuracy rivalling leading graph neural networks, and balanced trade-offs in stability and efficiency across prediction horizons and operating conditions. The extensible HYB(k) architecture equips transit agencies with flexible tools, ranging from economical single models to tailored high-fidelity hybrids, advancing predictive, equitable urban transport.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应混合集成框架HYB(nm)，动态融合五种互补模型，基于Kolkata三条公交线逾4000次行程数据，实现高鲁棒、高精度的公交到站时间预测。
AI.motivation: 准确的公交到站时间（ETA）预测对城市出行、乘客满意度与公交运营效率至关重要，但现有模型难以应对非线性时空动态、数据稀疏及天气等因素的干扰。
AI.method: 提出HYB(nm)自适应混合集成框架，通过元学习器依据实时情境动态融合五个互补模型：历史基线MST-AV、周期性时间模式分析GDRN-DFT、刻画非线性动态的Koopman神经算子KOOP-NET、融合天气的特征工程神经网络FENN，以及实时图卷积网络MGCN。
AI.result: 在Kolkata三条公交线路（超4000次行程）的GPS与天气数据上评估：HYB(2)鲁棒性最优，精度可与领先图神经网络媲美，并在不同预测时域与运行条件下于稳定性与效率间取得平衡。
AI.conclusion: 可扩展的HYB(k)架构为公交机构提供从经济型单模型到定制化高保真混合模型的灵活工具，推动预测性与公平性的城市交通发展。

title: Connectivity of the slice filtration
summary: Using methods similar to Morel's stable connectivity theorem, we prove that, over an arbitrary field, the Tate truncation functors $f_{0/n}$ preserve motivic connectivity of $ S^1$-spectra. An analogous result for complexes yields a Hurewicz theorem for the $L^{p,n}$- and $L_{bir}^n$-localizations over perfect fields. Over such fields, we establish a stronger connectivity property for categories of correspondences, showing that $f_n^\mathcal{C}$ preserves connectivity of motivic spectra with $\mathcal{C}$-transfers, whenever $\mathcal{C}$ satisfies cancellation. We then use the motivic reconstruction theorem to deduce that $f_n$, and consequently $s_n$ and $f_{0/n}$, also preserve connectivity for effective (and thereby, $\mathbb{P}^1$-) motivic spectra. Along the way, we also establish the slice analog of the motivic (effective) reconstruction theorem, as well as the slice analog of motivic $S^1$- and $\mathbb{P}^1$-recognition theorems.

AI.tldr: 本文利用类 Morel 稳定连通性定理的方法，证明 Tate 截断函子 $f_{0/n}$ 在任意域上保持 $S^1$-谱的母题连通性，并由此导出若干 Hurewicz 定理、对应范畴及有效（$\mathbb{P}^1$-）母题谱的连通性保持结果，以及切片版本的母题重构与识别定理。
AI.motivation: Tate 截断函子 $f_{0/n}$、$f_n$、$s_n$ 是否保持母题连通性，是母题同伦论中的基础问题；此前结果多依赖 Morel 稳定连通性定理的框架且限于特定域，本文旨在将其推广至任意域并给出更广泛的连通性保持性质。
AI.method: 采用与 Morel 稳定连通性定理类似的方法，证明任意域上 $f_{0/n}$ 保持 $S^1$-谱的母题连通性；对复形给出类似结果，从而得到完美域上 $L^{p,n}$-与 $L_{bir}^n$-局部化的 Hurewicz 定理；利用带 $\mathcal{C}$-转移的母题谱及满足 cancellation 的 $\mathcal{C}$，建立对应范畴的更强连通性；再借助母题重构定理推广至 $f_n$、$s_n$、$f_{0/n}$ 对有效及 $\mathbb{P}^1$-母题谱的连通性保持。
AI.result: 在任意域上证明 $f_{0/n}$ 保持 $S^1$-谱的母题连通性；在完美域上得到 $L^{p,n}$-与 $L_{bir}^n$-局部化的 Hurewicz 定理，并证明 $f_n^\mathcal{C}$ 在 $\mathcal{C}$ 满足 cancellation 时保持带 $\mathcal{C}$-转移母题谱的连通性；进一步证明 $f_n$（从而 $s_n$、$f_{0/n}$）保持有效及 $\mathbb{P}^1$-母题谱的连通性。
AI.conclusion: Tate 截断函子在广泛情形下保持母题连通性；同时建立了切片版本的母题（有效）重构定理与母题 $S^1$-、$\mathbb{P}^1$-识别定理，为母题同伦论中连通性与切片理论提供了统一框架。

title: A Conservative Multi-Level Adaptive Velocity-Space Method for the Discrete Unified Gas-Kinetic Scheme
summary: Multiscale gas flows often span a wide range of Knudsen numbers, within which the flow varies from near-continuum to highly rarefied and strongly nonequilibrium states. Such flows require kinetic solvers that remain accurate across the entire range. The discrete unified gas-kinetic scheme (DUGKS) provides such a unified description, but its computational cost and memory consumption are dominated by the size of the discrete velocity space. To alleviate this bottleneck, this work improves the DUGKS with multi-level adaptive velocity-space discretization (MLVS-DUGKS), reducing velocity-space redundancy while preserving accuracy and conservation. This method identify the velocity-space requirements of each physical cell from its distribution function, and then groups these requirements into a small number of representative velocity spaces. This organization retains sensitivity to different local flow states without constructing an independent velocity space for every physical cell. A linear moment-constrained correction is incorporated to maintain discrete compatibility and conservative data transfer between representative velocity spaces. Benchmark simulations spanning near-continuum to highly rarefied regimes show close agreement with the uniform-velocity-space DUGKS (UVS-DUGKS). For the computationally demanding cases, the average number of discrete velocity points is reduced by approximately one order of magnitude, yielding speedups of 6.67--7.51 and GPU-memory reductions by factors of 6.15--6.88. A threshold study further shows that the actual computational performance is governed by a balance between velocity-space compression and cross-level coupling overhead. The MLVS-DUGKS thus provides an accurate, conservative, and computationally efficient framework for multiscale nonequilibrium-flow simulations.

AI.tldr: 提出多级自适应速度空间离散的DUGKS（MLVS-DUGKS），显著降低离散速度点数、计算时间与GPU显存占用，同时保持精度与守恒性。
AI.motivation: 多尺度气体流动跨越宽Knudsen数范围，从近连续到高度稀薄及强非平衡状态，需要在整个范围内保持精度的动理学求解器。DUGKS虽提供统一描述，但其计算成本与内存消耗主要由离散速度空间规模决定，成为核心瓶颈。
AI.method: 为缓解该瓶颈，对DUGKS引入多级自适应速度空间离散（MLVS-DUGKS）：根据每个物理网格的分布函数识别其速度空间需求，并将这些需求归并为少量代表性速度空间，从而在保留对不同局部流动状态敏感性的同时，避免为每个物理网格单独构建速度空间。此外引入线性矩约束修正，以维持代表性速度空间之间的离散相容性与守恒数据传输。
AI.result: 跨近连续到高度稀薄区域的基准模拟与均匀速度空间DUGKS（UVS-DUGKS）结果高度一致。对计算量较大的算例，平均离散速度点数减少约一个数量级，获得6.67–7.51倍加速，GPU显存降低6.15–6.88倍。阈值研究表明，实际计算性能由速度空间压缩与跨层级耦合开销之间的平衡决定。
AI.conclusion: MLVS-DUGKS为多尺度非平衡流动模拟提供了一个精确、守恒且计算高效的框架。

title: Blow-Up of Modified Navier--Stokes Equations in Nonhomogeneous Fourier Spaces
summary: We study the three-dimensional incompressible Navier--Stokes equations with a componentwise nonlinear damping term of the form $α\sum_{k=1}^3 u_k^{2m+1}e_k$ in Fourier and Fourier-- Gevrey spaces based on $\mathcal{X}^0(\mathbb{R}^3)$. We first establish local-in-time existence and uniqueness of solutions and obtain the corresponding unique maximal solutions. We then derive blow-up criteria in the Fourier--Gevrey framework, including an integral blow-up criterion in a weaker exponential weight. Moreover, we establish a quantitative lower bound for the solution near a possible finite maximal existence time. By iterating the loss of exponential weight, we finally obtain a corresponding lower bound in the unweighted Fourier space $\mathcal{X}^0(\mathbb{R}^3)$.

AI.tldr: 研究带分量非线性阻尼项的三维不可压Navier-Stokes方程在Fourier及Fourier-Gevrey空间中的适定性与爆破行为。
AI.motivation: 针对带分量非线性阻尼的三维不可压Navier-Stokes方程，在Fourier与Fourier-Gevrey框架下刻画解的局部适定性及有限时刻爆破行为，弥补较弱指数权空间中爆破判据与解的定量下界的不足。
AI.method: 在基于X^0(R^3)的Fourier与Fourier-Gevrey空间中，先证明局部存在唯一性与最大解；再导出Fourier-Gevrey框架下的爆破判据（含较弱指数权下的积分型判据）；对可能有限最大存在时刻附近的解建立定量下界，并通过迭代指数权损失，将下界推广到无权Fourier空间X^0(R^3)。
AI.result: 获得局部适定性及唯一最大解；得到Fourier-Gevrey框架下的爆破判据，包括较弱指数权下的积分型爆破判据；建立有限最大存在时刻附近解的定量下界，并经由指数权损失的迭代得到无权Fourier空间X^0(R^3)中的相应下界。
AI.conclusion: 带分量非线性阻尼的三维不可压Navier-Stokes方程在Fourier与Fourier-Gevrey空间中具有局部适定性，其爆破行为可由Fourier-Gevrey框架下的判据刻画，且解的下界可定量估计并移植到无权Fourier空间。

title: Plug-and-Play Methods Provably Converge Even with Improperly Trained Denoisers: Convergence by Architectural Design
summary: Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods replace proximal operators with learned denoisers, which produce state-of-the-art reconstruction quality, but sacrifice the variational interpretation and convergence guarantees of proximal methods. Learned Proximal Networks (LPNs) address this problem by designing the denoiser architecture so that it is exactly the proximal operator of a regularizer. In this work, we clarify the theoretical foundations of LPNs and extend the framework to a broader class of activation functions. We then study two practical mechanisms for controlling the learned prior: (i) averaging the LPN with the identity, a common heuristic in PnP methods, and (ii) directly scaling the implicit regularizer induced by the proximal operator. In particular, we characterize the regularizer induced by averaging and develop a convergent method for evaluating the scaled proximal operator.

AI.tldr: 本文完善了学习近端网络（LPNs）的理论基础，将框架扩展至更广泛的激活函数，并研究了两种控制学习先验的实用机制：LPN与恒等映射的平均、以及直接缩放隐式正则化器。
AI.motivation: PnP方法用学习到的去噪器替代近端算子，重建质量优越，但丧失了近端方法的变分解释与收敛保证；LPNs通过设计去噪器架构使其恰为正则化器的近端算子来解决该问题，但其理论基础尚需澄清，且先验控制机制缺乏分析。
AI.method: 澄清LPNs的理论基础，并将框架扩展到更广泛的激活函数类别；研究两种控制学习先验的机制：(i)将LPN与恒等映射平均（PnP中的常见启发式），(ii)直接缩放由近端算子诱导的隐式正则化器。
AI.result: 刻画了平均操作所诱导的正则化器，并针对缩放后的近端算子提出了一种具有收敛性的计算方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为LPNs提供了更坚实的理论支撑，扩展了其适用激活函数范围，并为控制学习先验提供了两种有理论保证的机制。

title: Domain-Adapted Diffusion Models for Conditional Independence Testing
summary: Conditional independence (CI) is a fundamental concept in statistics and machine learning. Recent advances in conditional generative modeling provide flexible tools for generative-model-based CI tests, which rely on an estimated conditional distribution to generate randomized samples. However, errors in estimating this distribution accumulate in existing Type I error bounds, and consistency of the generative estimator alone does not guarantee asymptotic Type I error control. To address this limitation, we formulate conditional generative modeling as a domain adaptation problem and leverage auxiliary data from multiple source domains to improve estimation in the target CI testing domain. We propose Domain-Adapted Diffusion (DA-Diff), a multi-source domain adaptation framework for conditional diffusion models based on weighted empirical risk minimization over both target and source domains. We establish the convergence rate of DA-Diff and show how transferable source data can improve target-domain estimation through an increased effective sample size while controlling transfer bias. Building on DA-Diff, we further propose Domain-Adapted Conditional Independence Testing (DA-CIT) and show that its Type I error satisfies $P(p \leq α) \leq α+ o(1)$. Experiments demonstrate that DA-Diff improved conditional generation quality compared with transfer-learning diffusion baselines, while DA-CIT provides strong Type I error control and competitive power.

AI.tldr: 该论文将条件生成建模重构为域自适应问题，提出多源域自适应扩散模型DA-Diff及其在条件独立性检验中的应用DA-CIT，实现了渐近Type I错误控制并提升了条件生成质量。
AI.motivation: 基于生成模型的条件独立性（CI）检验依赖估计的条件分布生成随机样本，但条件分布估计误差会在现有Type I错误界中累积，且生成估计量的一致性并不能保证渐近Type I错误控制。因此需要降低目标域条件分布估计误差以改进检验可靠性。
AI.method: 将条件生成建模表述为域自适应问题，利用多个源域的辅助数据改进目标CI检验域的估计。提出Domain-Adapted Diffusion（DA-Diff），一种基于目标域与源域加权经验风险最小化的多源域自适应条件扩散模型框架；在此基础上提出Domain-Adapted Conditional Independence Testing（DA-CIT）。
AI.result: 建立了DA-Diff的收敛速率，证明可迁移源数据可通过增大有效样本量改善目标域估计，同时控制迁移偏差。理论上证明DA-CIT的Type I错误满足P(p ≤ α) ≤ α + o(1)。实验表明DA-Diff相较迁移学习扩散基线提升了条件生成质量，DA-CIT在Type I错误控制上表现良好且具有竞争性检验效力。
AI.conclusion: 通过多源域自适应扩散建模可有效降低目标域条件分布估计误差，从而在理论上保证渐近Type I错误控制，并在实践中提升条件生成质量与检验性能，为基于生成模型的CI检验提供了更可靠的框架。

title: Amortized Generative Modeling of Invariant Measures across A Family of Kuramoto-Sivashinsky PDEs
summary: The long-run statistics of chaotic dissipative partial differential equations are described by invariant measures, and when the equation carries a parameter these measures form a family whose members can differ in kind, from steady states to sustained spatiotemporal chaos. We ask whether a single generative model can cover such a family. We train a single conditional diffusion model once, on states of the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation at 160 values of its hyperviscosity, and evaluate it against held-out data at interleaved parameter values not seen in training, using a classifier two-sample test supported by spectral, geometric and tail statistics. Over most of the family, agreement improves as the dynamics become more chaotic. We identify a structural cause: the weakly chaotic members have invariant measures concentrated on low-dimensional sets, which a model with full support output cannot represent, and the target approaches full dimensionality as chaos increases. Restricting training to the strongly chaotic members reduces the classifier's excess over chance on those members by roughly 40%, and this restricted conditional model matches or exceeds models trained at single parameter values. On those members, generated samples reproduce energy spectra to within a resampling floor, with a small systematic deficit at the largest scales, and match the energy balance of held-out data.

AI.tldr: 训练单个条件扩散模型覆盖Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程160个超粘性参数下的不变测度族，在插值参数上评估；发现弱混沌区测度低维、全支撑生成模型无法表示，剔除弱混沌样本后分类器超随机水平降低约40%，强混沌区生成样本能复现能谱与能量平衡。
AI.motivation: 耗散混沌偏微分方程的不变测度随参数变化呈现从稳态到持续时空混沌的不同类型，作者追问单个生成模型能否覆盖这样一个测度族，并检验其失效模式与成因。
AI.method: 在Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程的160个超粘性值上一次性训练单个条件扩散模型；在训练未见过的插值参数上用分类器双样本检验评估，辅以谱、几何与尾部统计；再仅用强混沌样本重训以定位结构性原因。
AI.result: 大部分参数区间内一致性随混沌增强而提高；弱混沌成员测度集中于低维集合而全支撑输出无法表示，目标维数随混沌增强趋近全维；仅用强混沌成员训练使分类器超随机水平下降约40%，该受限条件模型达到或超过单参数模型；强混沌成员上生成样本能谱复现至重采样下限，最大尺度存在小幅系统亏缺，能量平衡与留出数据一致。
AI.conclusion: 单个条件生成模型可在强混沌参数区间有效覆盖不变测度族，但其能力受目标测度内在维度限制，弱混沌区的失败源于支撑集不匹配这一结构性原因。

title: NanoForecast v0.5: Competitive Time Series Forecasting Through Training Pipeline Optimization
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code and checkpoints: https://github.com/eulogik/NanoForecast
summary: We present NanoForecast v0.5, a 6.5M-parameter forecaster that competes with models 31x its size (TimesFM, 200M parameters) after training pipeline fixes and no architecture change. Retraining the v0.3 architecture with corrected loss-scope handling, tensor shape alignment, and wider augmentation coverage cuts overall Mean Absolute Scaled Error by 43.8% under one fixed protocol (MASE 3.030 to 1.704) on the same data and compute budget. NanoForecast v0.5 beats TimesFM on all three ETT datasets (MASE 0.676/1.110/0.287 vs. 0.705/1.360/0.545) and on exchange rate (4.317 vs. 4.383); TimesFM keeps a clear lead on the high-cardinality electricity and traffic sets. Against PatchTST (15M+ parameters, official configuration), v0.5 wins all three ETT sets. Training takes about 12 hours on a single cloud GPU (NVIDIA T4, Google Colab) and inference needs no GPU (measurements in this paper are on an Apple M4 CPU). We release all code, pretrained checkpoints, and evaluation framework under Apache 2.0 at https://github.com/eulogik/NanoForecast

AI.tldr: NanoForecast v0.5 仅 6.5M 参数，在修正训练流程（不改架构）后，整体 MASE 从 3.030 降至 1.704（降幅 43.8%），在三个 ETT 数据集与汇率上超越 200M 的 TimesFM，并能与 15M+ 的 PatchTST 竞争；单张 T4 云 GPU 约 12 小时完成训练，CPU 可推理，代码与权重以 Apache 2.0 开源。
AI.motivation: 论文动机在于挑战"模型规模决定性能"的常见假设：一个小型预测模型（6.5M 参数）此前表现不佳，作者认为瓶颈来自训练流程的实现缺陷而非架构容量，因此希望通过修复工程问题，让轻量模型在相同数据和算力预算下达到与数十倍规模模型相当甚至更优的效果，同时降低训练与推理的硬件门槛（单卡 T4 训练、CPU 推理）。
AI.method: 方法上不改变 v0.3 的架构，仅修正训练流程：一是修正 loss-scope 处理（损失作用范围），二是张量形状对齐（tensor shape alignment），三是扩大数据增强覆盖范围（wider augmentation coverage）。在固定的统一评测协议、相同数据与算力预算下重新训练。模型规模为 6.5M 参数，训练约 12 小时（NVIDIA T4，Google Colab），推理在 Apple M4 CPU 上完成。
AI.result: 结果：重训后整体 MASE 由 3.030 降至 1.704（降低 43.8%）。NanoForecast v0.5 在三个 ETT 数据集上均优于 TimesFM（MASE 0.676/1.110/0.287 对比 0.705/1.360/0.545），在汇率数据上也领先（4.317 对比 4.383）；但在高基数的 electricity 与 traffic 数据集上 TimesFM 仍明显领先。对 PatchTST（15M+ 参数，官方配置），v0.5 在三个 ETT 数据集上全部胜出。
AI.conclusion: 结论：训练流程的正确性（loss-scope、形状对齐、数据增强）对小型预测模型的性能影响巨大，仅靠工程修复即可让 6.5M 参数模型在部分任务上比肩甚至超越 31 倍规模的模型。v0.5 在 ETT 与汇率上具竞争力，但在高基数数据集上仍不及 TimesFM。所有代码、预训练权重与评测框架以 Apache 2.0 协议在 GitHub 开源。

title: Large cyclic automorphism groups and cyclic subgroups of index two in characteristic two
summary: Let $\mathcal{X}$ be a projective, geometrically irreducible, nonsingular algebraic curve of genus $g\ge2$ over an algebraically closed field of characteristic two. We classify cyclic subgroups of $\Aut(\mathcal{X})$ of order $N\ge2g+1$. Besides Kummer extensions of odd degree ramified over three points, precisely two cases occur: $y^2+y=x^m$, with $N=2m=4g+2$, and $y^2+y=c/(x^m+1)$, with $m$ odd, $c\ne0$, and $N=2m=2g+2$. In particular, $4\nmid N$. We then classify groups $H$ with a cyclic subgroup of index two and $|H|>4g+4$. They are precisely the groups $C_k\times D_{2M}$ on the curves $y^k=x^M+x^{-M}$, where $k,M\ge3$ are odd and coprime, and $2g=M(k-1)$. Their possible orders are $4g+2M$, where $M$ runs over certain odd divisors of $g$, and $|H|\le6g$. No curve in this family is ordinary. Hermitian curves occur in the family, and we give two sufficient conditions for maximality over finite fields. For dihedral groups the sharp bound is $4g+4$ in even genus and $4g$ in odd genus. The equality cases are given by explicit Artin--Schreier equations, and in each case the dihedral group is the full automorphism group.

AI.tldr: 本文在特征2的代数闭域上分类了亏格g≥2的射影不可约非奇异代数曲线Aut(X)中大阶循环子群及指标为2的有限群，并给出Hermitian曲线的极大性条件与二面体群的最优界。
AI.motivation: 研究正特征（尤其特征2）代数曲线的自同构群结构，特别是大阶循环子群与二面体型子群的分类，是曲线自同构理论中的核心问题。已有工作多集中于特征0或奇数特征，特征2情形由于Artin–Schreier扩张的特殊性需要单独处理。
AI.method: 设X为特征2代数闭域上亏格g≥2的射影几何不可约非奇异曲线，分类Aut(X)中阶N≥2g+1的循环子群：除奇次Kummer扩张（在三点分歧）外，仅有y²+y=x^m（N=2m=4g+2）与y²+y=c/(x^m+1)（m奇，c≠0，N=2m=2g+2）两种情形，从而4∤N。进而分类含指标2循环子群且|H|>4g+4的群H，得到C_k×D_{2M}作用于y^k=x^M+x^{-M}（k,M≥3奇且互素，2g=M(k-1)）。对二面体群用显式Artin–Schreier方程确定等号情形。
AI.result: 大阶循环子群仅有上述三类；4∤N。含指标2循环子群且|H|>4g+4的群恰为C_k×D_{2M}，其阶为4g+2M（M遍历g的某些奇因子），且|H|≤6g；该族曲线均非普通（non-ordinary）。Hermitian曲线属于该族，并给出有限域上极大性的两个充分条件。二面体群的尖锐界为偶亏格4g+4、奇亏格4g，等号情形由显式Artin–Schreier方程给出，此时二面体群即为全自同构群。
AI.conclusion: 本文完整刻画了特征2曲线Aut(X)中大阶循环子群与指标2大阶子群的结构，明确了4∤N的限制及|H|≤6g的界，揭示了Hermitian曲线在该族中的地位并给出极大性判据，同时确定了二面体群的最优界与等号实现。

title: Conservative local grid refinement for the vectorial lattice Boltzmann method
summary: We present a conservative local grid-refinement coupling for the vectorial lattice Boltzmann method (VLBM), a kinetic-type scheme for hyperbolic conservation laws in which each conserved field is carried by its own population rather than by moment truncation of a Maxwellian. Coarse and fine regions share a common link speed and are advanced with different time steps, sub-cycled at a fixed ratio; a mean-preserving reconstruction in time supplies the missing coarse-to-fine boundary data, and a matched, Berger--Colella-style reflux returns the fine-to-coarse data, together conserving mass, momentum, and energy exactly, independent of the equation of state, the local relaxation parameter, or the time step. In addition, we propose an adaptive mesh refinement extension through a conservative pair of splitting and merging operators that require no modification to the underlying coupling. The approach is validated on a sequence of increasingly demanding two-dimensional cases, in every case recovering exact conservation and the expected accuracy gains over an equivalent uniform grid.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于矢量格子Boltzmann方法（VLBM）的守恒型局部网格加密耦合格式，通过时间子循环、均值保持重构和Berger–Colella型回流实现精确守恒，并扩展至自适应网格加密。
AI.motivation: VLBM作为双曲守恒律的动理学格式，各守恒场由各自分布函数输运，需要在粗细网格并存时实现局部加密，同时严格保持质量、动量与能量的守恒，且不依赖状态方程、松弛参数或时间步长。
AI.method: 粗细区域采用相同link速度但不同时间步长，以固定比例子循环推进；时间方向采用均值保持重构提供缺失的粗到细边界数据，采用匹配的Berger–Colella型回流处理细到粗数据；并提出一对守恒的分裂与合并算子以实现自适应网格加密，无需改动底层耦合。
AI.result: 在一系列难度递增的二维算例上验证，均实现精确守恒，并获得相对于等效均匀网格的预期精度提升。
AI.conclusion: 该耦合与自适应加密框架可在VLBM中实现严格守恒的局部网格加密，且通用性强、不依赖具体状态方程与参数设置。

title: Synchronized Solutions for Liouville Systems with Sign-Changing Coefficients
summary: We consider singular Liouville systems on closed Riemann surfaces with a common sign-changing coefficient. Direct continuation from a positive coefficient is obstructed by the unavoidable appearance of degenerate zeroes along such a homotopy. We instead identify an intrinsic ray in the parameter space on which the system admits synchronized solutions and reduces exactly to a scalar sign-changing mean-field equation. Combining this reduction with the variational existence theory of De Marchis--López-Soriano--Ruiz and the nodal singularity compactness theorem of Wu, we obtain existence for every noncritical parameter on this ray. Positive singular sources are allowed on the nodal curve. In particular, when the surface has nonpositive Euler characteristic and every negative component of the coefficient is a disk, the topological hypothesis required by the scalar min--max construction is automatic.

AI.tldr: 本文研究闭黎曼曲面上具有公共变号系数的奇异Liouville系统，通过识别参数空间中的一条内在射线，将系统约化为标量变号平均场方程，并结合变分存在性理论与节点奇异性紧性定理，得到该射线上每个非临界参数的存在性结果。
AI.motivation: 直接从正系数出发做连续延拓会遇到沿同伦不可避免出现的退化零点障碍，因此需要寻找新的路径来建立变号系数下奇异Liouville系统的存在性理论。
AI.method: 识别参数空间中一条内在射线，在该射线上系统允许同步解并精确约化为标量变号平均场方程；再结合De Marchis–López-Soriano–Ruiz的变分存在理论与Wu的节点奇异性紧性定理。
AI.result: 在该射线上对每个非临界参数均获得存在性；节点曲线上允许正奇异源；当曲面欧拉示性数非正且系数每个负连通分支为圆盘时，标量min–max构造所需的拓扑假设自动满足。
AI.conclusion: 通过内在射线上的约化与同步解构造，绕开了正系数延拓的退化障碍，为变号系数奇异Liouville系统的存在性提供了新的分析框架与拓扑条件自动成立的情形。

title: Sharp Critical Minimax Laws and No-Learning Thresholds in Continuous-Time Adaptive Control
summary:
We study episodic continuous-time control with an unknown vector control gain, scalar state, quadratic action cost, and smooth convex terminal cost. In the scalar Gaussian experiment, let $Δ(H)$ denote the minimax improvement over zero control and set $δ=\sqrt2H^2-1$. We prove the critical law
  $$ Δ(H)\asymp δ^4\sqrt{\log(1/δ)} \qquad (δ\downarrow0), $$
  with a matching lower and upper bound. The lower bound follows from a uniform deficit--energy inequality valid for fully adaptive controls with unbounded amplitudes, while a moving soft-threshold feedback attains the rate.
  For local parameters $θ=N^{-1/4}h$, $|h|\le H$, we show that the normalized minimax regret over $N$ episodes is within $O(N^{-1/2})$ of a fixed-horizon Gaussian sequential control problem, without an additional dimension factor. The terminal task enters the limit only through $c_g=\operatorname{Var}(g(Z))$. The Gaussian problem exhibits an exact no-learning phase transition:
  $$ C_d^T(H)=TH^2/2 \iff H^4T\le d^2/2, $$
  yielding the asymptotic task boundary $c_gH^4=d^2/2$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究标量连续时间情景式控制问题，在未知向量控制增益、二次动作代价与光滑凸终端代价设定下，证明了关于零控制的极小极大改进临界律 Δ(H)≍δ⁴√log(1/δ)，并刻画了高斯序贯控制问题的精确无学习相变与渐近任务边界。
AI.motivation: 连续时间情景式控制中，控制增益未知且动作带二次代价，终端代价光滑凸；此前缺乏对最优改进量随信噪参数衰减的精确速率刻画，也缺少对归一化极小极大遗憾与固定视界高斯序贯控制问题之间等价性的清晰理解，以及对是否存在可学习阶段的相变判别。
AI.method: 1) 在标量高斯实验中定义 Δ(H) 为相对零控制的极小极大改进，令 δ=√2 H²−1，刻画其渐近临界律；2) 下界通过适用于完全自适应、无界幅度控制的均匀亏缺–能量不等式建立；3) 上界由移动软阈值反馈策略达到匹配速率；4) 对局部参数 θ=N^{−1/4}h，|h|≤H，将 N 个回合的归一化极小极大遗憾与固定视界高斯序贯控制问题比较，证明误差为 O(N^{−1/2})，且终端任务仅通过 c_g=Var(g(Z)) 进入极限；5) 对该高斯问题导出精确无学习相变条件 C_d^T(H)=TH²/2 ⇔ H⁴T≤d²/2，并给出渐近任务边界 c_gH⁴=d²/2。
AI.result: 证明了临界律 Δ(H)≍δ⁴√log(1/δ)（δ↓0），下界与上界匹配；上界由移动软阈值反馈实现。归一化极小极大遗憾与固定视界高斯序贯控制问题之差为 O(N^{−1/2})，且不引入额外维数因子，终端任务仅依赖 c_g=Var(g(Z))。得到高斯问题的精确无学习相变：C_d^T(H)=TH²/2 当且仅当 H⁴T≤d²/2，对应的渐近任务边界为 c_gH⁴=d²/2。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了未知增益连续时间情景式控制的极小极大最优改进速率，并通过均匀亏缺–能量不等式与软阈值反馈策略实现上下界匹配；同时建立了多回合遗憾与固定视界高斯序贯控制问题的O(N^{−1/2})等价，揭示仅由c_g决定终端效应，并精确刻画了无学习相变与任务边界，为连续时间控制中的可学习性提供了清晰阈值判据。

title: Neural Scaling Laws of Transformer Operator Network
summary: Transformers have emerged as powerful architectures for learning solution operators of physical systems. Empirically the prediction error has been observed to decrease when the data size and model size increase, suggesting neural scaling behavior. Yet a theoretical understanding of such scaling laws for transformer-based operator learning remains limited. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework for characterizing the approximation and generalization errors of transformer-based operator learning. Our analysis builds on a local-to-global approximation principle that is naturally aligned with the softmax attention mechanism and yields discretization-invariant output functions. On approximation theory, we derive a universal approximation error of transformer-based operator learning for Hölder-regular operators. On generalization theory, we establish a power scaling law between the prediction error and the training data size. The rate of convergence represented by the scaling exponent explicitly reflects the dimensions of the input and output domains, the regularity of the underlying functions and operators, and crucially, the intrinsic dimension of the input function class. By exploiting this intrinsic low-dimensional structure, our analysis yields a power-law generalization rate for operator learning, in contrast to the logarithmic-type power-law rates appearing in existing analyses of operator learning with feedforward neural networks. Numerical experiments validate the predicted power-law scaling and confirm that the convergence rate varies systematically with the intrinsic dimension of the input function class.

AI.tldr: 本文为基于Transformer的算子学习建立理论框架，刻画其逼近与泛化误差，并推导出幂律标度律。
AI.motivation: Transformer在物理系统解算子学习中表现优异，经验上随数据与模型规模增大误差下降，呈现神经标度行为；但针对Transformer算子学习的标度律理论理解仍然有限，缺乏严格的理论刻画。
AI.method: 提出理论框架分析Transformer算子学习的逼近误差与泛化误差。基于"局部到全局"逼近原理，与softmax注意力机制自然契合，并产生离散化不变的输出函数。逼近理论上，推导了对Hölder正则算子的通用逼近误差；泛化理论上，建立了预测误差与训练数据量之间的幂律标度关系，其标度指数显式反映输入/输出域维度、函数与算子的正则性，以及关键地，输入函数类的内在维度。
AI.result: 推导出Transformer算子学习的Hölder正则算子通用逼近误差；建立了预测误差随数据规模的幂律标度律，收敛速率显式依赖于域维度、正则性与输入函数类的内在维度。利用内在低维结构，得到算子学习的幂律泛化率，区别于现有前馈神经网络算子分析中的对数型幂律率。数值实验验证了预测的幂律标度，并确认收敛速率系统地随输入函数类的内在维度变化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为Transformer算子学习提供了逼近与泛化的理论刻画，揭示了内在维度驱动的幂律标度律，优于现有前馈网络的算子学习分析，并获得数值验证。

title: Finite Element Analysis of Maxwell's Equations with Time-Varying Coefficients and Nonlinear E-H Coupling: Convergence and Exponential Decay
summary: This paper analyzes finite element approximations for Maxwell's equations with time-dependent coefficients and nonlinear E-H coupling in both the total current density and the Silver-Müller-type boundary condition. The nonlinear coupling and the time-varying material parameters prevent the use of standard analytical tools, including the discrete compactness property and the Minty-Browder argument, making the numerical analysis particularly challenging. As the main novelty, we establish two primary contributions: Uniform convergence on every finite time interval $[0,T]$ and exponential stability on the infinite time horizon $[0,\infty)$. The uniform convergence is established via a Cauchy-type argument within a time-dependent Hilbert space framework that entirely bypasses Minty's trick and the discrete compactness argument. Furthermore, under a positive homogeneity assumption on the nonlinearities, the exponential stability is analyzed by means of a nonlinear sup-max problem arising from ratios of consecutive discrete energies. With this strategy, we ultimately prove a fully discrete unconditional exponential decay result under a specific sufficient condition. In the absence of this condition, a concrete counterexample shows that the energy decay fails to hold. Numerical experiments are provided to validate the theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究含时变系数与非线性E-H耦合的Maxwell方程的有限元逼近，证明有限时间区间上的一致收敛与无限时间上的指数稳定性，并提出无条件下指数衰减的充分条件及反例。
AI.motivation: 非线性E-H耦合与时变材料参数使得离散紧性性质、Minty-Browder论证等标准分析工具失效，数值分析面临困难。
AI.method: 在时变Hilbert空间框架下用Cauchy型论证建立一致收敛，规避Minty技巧与离散紧性；在非线性正齐次假设下，通过由相邻离散能量之比导出的非线性sup-max问题分析指数稳定性，并给出全离散无条件指数衰减的充分条件。
AI.result: 在任意有限时间区间[0,T]上获得一致收敛，在无限时间[0,∞)上获得指数稳定性，并在特定充分条件下证明全离散无条件指数衰减；无此条件时给出能量衰减失效的具体反例，数值实验验证理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为含非线性和时变系数的Maxwell方程有限元分析提供了不依赖离散紧性与Minty论证的新框架，并明确了指数稳定性的充分条件及其必要性边界。

title: Active Causal Discovery Benchmark: Evaluating LLM Agents Under Budgeted Interventions
summary: We introduce the Active Causal Discovery Benchmark (ACDB), an SCM-grounded environment for evaluating whether LLM agents recover causal graph structure from observations and budget-constrained hard interventions. ACDB pairs a linear-Gaussian world generator with a fixed observe-intervene-submit API and a three-layer scoring contract that separates skeleton recovery, DAG recovery, and intervention efficiency. On the current six-level ladder, PC with a greedy active orientation heuristic is the strongest non-oracle method (directed F1 42.7%, SHD 4.79), ahead of Claude Sonnet 4.6 raw active (31.7%, 7.25) and GPT-5.4 raw active (22.9%, 9.27). The most informative diagnostic is the precision-recall decomposition: PC under-commits with high precision, LLMs over-commit with lower precision, and statistical-tool access often increases abstention rather than useful intervention. A structure-blind random DAG baseline reaches 23.6% directed F1 on this dense v0 ladder; a density probe lowers this floor to 16.9%, motivating the v1 calibration pass. The current results should therefore be read as a benchmark audit and calibration report, not as evidence that current LLMs solve active causal discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 ACDB——一个基于结构因果模型（SCM）的基准环境，用于评估 LLM 智能体在预算受限的观测与硬干预下恢复因果图结构的能力，并给出当前六难度层级的评测与校准结果。
AI.motivation: 现有因果发现评测多聚焦被动观测数据，缺乏对"主动干预选择"这一核心能力的统一、可复现评测；同时 LLM 智能体在主动因果发现上的真实能力尚不明确，需要区分结构恢复质量与干预效率的诊断性基准，以避免高估其能力。
AI.method: ACDB 将线性-高斯世界生成器与固定的“观测-干预-提交”（observe-intervene-submit）API 配对，并设计三层评分契约：骨架恢复、DAG 恢复、干预效率。在六层难度阶梯上与多个基线对比，包括带贪心主动定向启发式的 PC 算法、Claude Sonnet 4.6 与 GPT-5.4 的原始主动模式，以及结构盲的随机 DAG 基线，并引入密度探针以校准难度下限。
AI.result: 在当前六层阶梯上，PC+贪心主动定向启发式（directed F1 42.7%，SHD 4.79）显著优于 Claude Sonnet 4.6（31.7%，7.25）与 GPT-5.4（22.9%，9.27）。精确率-召回率分解显示：PC 高精度但欠输出，LLM 则过度输出且精度较低，统计工具接入更多导致弃权而非有效干预。结构盲随机 DAG 基线在稠密 v0 阶梯上达到 23.6% directed F1，密度探针将其下限降至 16.9%，据此推动 v1 校准。
AI.conclusion: 当前结果应被视为基准审计与校准报告，而非 LLM 已解决主动因果发现的证据；基准本身仍需通过 v1 校准提升区分度，以避免结构盲基线造成的虚假高分。

title: On the De Rham Cohomology of Zero-Dimensional Schemes
summary: The (naive) de Rham cohomology of a zero-dimensional scheme is the homology of the Kähler differential algebra of its coordinate ring, viewed as a complex. Since it is well-known to vanish in higher degrees if the ring is quasi-homogeneous, we concentrate on the affine case. For a general affine $K$-algebra $R=P/I$, where ${\rm char}(K)=0$ and $P=K[x_1,\dots,x_n]$, we prove a vanishing theorem for $H_{\rm dR}^m(R)$ based on the shape of a Macaulay basis of $dI\wedge Ω^m_{P/K}$. For an Artinian local algebra $A=P/\langle f_1,\dots,f_n\rangle$, where $\{f_1,\dots,f_n\}$ is a super regular sequence, we show that $H_{\rm dR}^{\bullet}(A)$ is non-trivial in general, but trivial when the natural system of generators of the relation module of $Ω^m_{A/K}$ is a standard basis. Moreover, we provide a detailed study of the dimension of $H_{\rm dR}^0(A)=\ker(d_A)$ for Artinian local rings $A=P/I$. The case of arbitrary affine zero-dimensional schemes is reduced to this case using a Galois splitting, and as a result we obtain the de Rham cohomology of a fat point scheme. Many explicitly computed examples and counterexamples support the results and indicate how subtle the de Rham cohomology of a zero-dimensional scheme is in general.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了零维概型的朴素 de Rham 上同调，重点在仿射情形，给出了基于 Macaulay 基、超正则序列与标准基的消没定理，并刻画了 Artinian 局部环的 H^0_dR 维数，最终借助 Galois 分裂得到胖点概型的 de Rham 上同调。
AI.motivation: 零维概型的朴素 de Rham 上同调在其坐标环为拟齐次时会于高次消失，因此真正的困难出现在一般（非拟齐次）仿射情形；作者希望理解这种上同调在一般情况下何时消没、如何计算，以及它本质上有多微妙。
AI.method: 设 R=P/I，P=K[x_1,…,x_n]，char(K)=0。将 Kähler 微分代数视为复形计算 H_dR^m(R)。通过 dI∧Ω^m_{P/K} 的 Macaulay 基的形状给出消没定理；对 Artinian 局部代数 A=P/⟨f_1,…,f_n⟩（f_i 为超正则序列），用 Ω^m_{A/K} 关系模的自然生成系是否为标准基来判定平凡性；详细研究 H_dR^0(A)=ker(d_A) 的维数；对任意仿射零维概型用 Galois 分裂归约到该情形。
AI.result: 证明了基于 dI∧Ω^m_{P/K} 的 Macaulay 基形状的 H_dR^m(R) 消没定理；对超正则序列定义的 Artinian 局部代数，H_dR^•(A) 一般不平凡，但当关系模的自然生成系为标准基时平凡；给出了 H_dR^0(A)=ker(d_A) 维数的细致刻画；通过 Galois 分裂将一般仿射零维概型归约到 Artinian 局部情形，并由此得到胖点概型的 de Rham 上同调；大量显式计算例子与反例说明了一般情形下该上同调的微妙性。
AI.conclusion: 零维概型的朴素 de Rham 上同调在仿射情形可由 Macaulay 基、超正则序列和标准基等代数工具系统刻画；Artinian 局部环情形是核心，一般仿射零维概型可经 Galois 分裂归约至此，胖点概型的结果作为应用给出。

title: Second order estimates on transition layers for the Allen-Cahn equation with homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions: Part I - Boundary-orthogonal transition layers
summary: We study stable solutions of the Allen-Cahn equation with homogeneous Neumann boundary condition on Riemannian manifolds with boundary in the regime where the transition layers meet the boundary orthogonally. Under an a priori bound for the enhanced second fundamental form in the transition region, we establish uniform second-order Hölder estimates and quantitative mean curvature decay for the nodal hypersurfaces up to the boundary in ambient dimensions at most 10. The proof adapts the technique pioneered by Wang-Wei, adding a further correction determined by the geometry of the ambient boundary. Its leading contribution to mean curvature cancels on the nodal set but survives on non-zero level sets in the transition region, whose mean curvature need not decay uniformly. This phenomenon has no interior analogue and is exhibited by stable solutions constructed by Kowalczyk.

AI.tldr: 研究带边界黎曼流形上齐次Neumann边界条件的Allen-Cahn方程稳定解，在过渡层与边界正交的范围内，于环境维数不超过10时建立一致二阶Hölder估计与节点超曲面的定量平均曲率衰减。
AI.motivation: 过渡层触及边界且正交的情形缺乏边界附近的精细正则性理论，内点方法无法直接处理由环境边界几何引入的额外修正项，因此需要发展带边界版本的分析框架。
AI.method: 在过渡区域对增强第二基本形式施加先验界，改进Wang-Wei的技术，并加入一个由环境边界几何决定的修正项，该修正项对平均曲率的主导贡献在节点集上相互抵消。
AI.result: 在维数不超过10时得到直至边界的一致二阶Hölder估计以及节点超曲面的定量平均曲率衰减；修正项在非零水平集上不会抵消，其平均曲率不一定均匀衰减。
AI.conclusion: 该边界效应没有内点对应物，并由Kowalczyk构造的稳定解所体现，说明边界几何会在过渡区域产生本质性的新现象。

title: Notes on Generative Modeling for Feedback Control and Planning
summary: In these notes, we view control as a dynamically constrained sampling problem on the state-space of a control system. With this viewpoint, we extend methods from generative modeling, such as flow matching, normalizing flows and denoising diffusions to control problems. Concepts such as controllability, optimal control and trajectory planning play an important role in guiding the extension and understanding well-posedeness of the corresponding algorithms, with application to steering systems to target states or distributions and sampling from reachable sets. The notes are intended as an accessible introduction for readers with a background in control theory and robotics.

AI.tldr: 将控制问题重新表述为状态空间上的动态约束采样问题，并把流匹配、归一化流、去噪扩散等生成建模方法推广至控制领域。
AI.motivation: 该文旨在为控制理论与机器人学背景的读者提供一份易于理解的入门材料，通过采样视角统一生成建模与控制问题。
AI.method: 以控制作为状态空间上的动态约束采样问题为核心视角，将生成建模方法（流匹配、归一化流、去噪扩散）扩展到控制问题中，并借助可控性、最优控制与轨迹规划等概念来指导算法扩展与分析其适定性。
AI.result: 所提方法可应用于将系统引导至目标状态或目标分布，以及从可达集中采样。
AI.conclusion: 这些讲义面向控制与机器人背景的读者，提供了该统一视角的通俗入门介绍。

title: Calibrated Derivative-Process Sensitivity for Gaussian-Process Variable Selection
summary: Automatic relevance determination (ARD), the default tool for variable selection in Gaussian-process (GP) regression, ranks inputs by inverse lengthscales -- which measure how fast a function varies, not how much an input contributes to prediction -- and offers no calibrated rule for deciding which inputs to keep. The prediction-centred alternative, the derivative sensitivity $ν_j = \mathbb{E}[(\partial f/\partial x_j)^2]$, is available in closed form from a fitted GP, but turning it into a selection rule is harder than it looks: at a null input the estimator is a degenerate quadratic form, so Wald and Bernstein-von Mises cutoffs are anti-conservative, and the natural residual bootstrap is mis-scaled. We show that a studentized multiplier bootstrap of the GP derivative process repairs both, prove its validity through an invariance principle for quadratic forms, and obtain asymptotic family-wise and false-discovery-rate control across inputs. Over 100 replications the rule controls FDR wherever inputs are truly null, while uncalibrated derivative rankings breach the target by up to 2x and a Bernstein-von Mises cutoff by 2.2x; at matched FDR it loses no power; it holds under a Matérn kernel and input correlation up to 0.99; on real data with planted and authentic null inputs it admits 5-12x fewer spurious inputs; it costs 5-18% of the GP fit; and a block-averaged variant retains validity at cost linear in $n$.

AI.tldr: 提出学生化乘子自助法校准GP导数敏感性，实现变量选择的FDR/FWER控制，优于ARD与非校准导数排序。
AI.motivation: 高斯过程回归中默认的变量选择工具ARD用逆长度尺度排序输入，度量的是函数变化快慢而非输入对预测的贡献，且缺乏校准的保留规则。以预测为中心的导数敏感性ν_j虽有闭式解，但在零输入处估计量为退化二次型，Wald与Bernstein-von Mises阈值过于激进，残差自助法尺度错误，导致选择规则难以建立。
AI.method: 对GP导数过程采用学生化乘子自助法（studentized multiplier bootstrap），通过二次型的不变性原理证明其有效性，从而得到跨输入的渐近族错误率（FWER）与错误发现率（FDR）控制。
AI.result: 100次重复实验中，该规则在真正为零的输入处控制了FDR；未校准的导数排序超出目标达2倍，Bernstein-von Mises阈值超2.2倍；在匹配FDR下不损失功效；在Matérn核与输入相关性高达0.99时仍成立；真实数据中植入与真实零输入场景下伪输入减少5–12倍；计算开销为GP拟合的5–18%；块平均变体保持有效性且代价与n线性相关。
AI.conclusion: 学生化乘子自助法为基于GP导数敏感性的变量选择提供了具有FWER/FDR保证的校准规则，弥补了ARD与未校准导数排序的不足。

title: A Spectral Model-Informed Neural Network for Inverse Source Problems
summary: In this paper, we propose an unsupervised, two-step model-informed deep learning framework for solving the inverse source problem. In the first step, boundary measurement data are transformed into an imaging function that encodes information about the shape and location of the unknown source. Leveraging this information, we derive a Fourier-based model equation in the spectral domain that relates the imaging function to the Fourier coefficients of the source function. In the second step, this model equation is incorporated into the training of a model-informed neural network to recover the parameters of interest. The proposed approach enables fast and accurate reconstruction of the source function while maintaining robustness to noise. The effectiveness of the method is demonstrated through numerical experiments in both two- and three-dimensional settings. For the two-dimensional case, we further compare our approach with the traditional least-squares method to validate its computational efficiency and reconstruction accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无监督、两步式、模型驱动的深度学习框架，用于求解逆源问题，实现快速、准确且抗噪的源函数重建。
AI.motivation: 逆源问题的求解通常面临计算成本高、对噪声敏感等挑战，需要兼顾重建精度与效率的方法。
AI.method: 第一步将边界测量数据变换为编码源形状与位置信息的成像函数，并据此在谱域推导出关联成像函数与源函数傅里叶系数的傅里叶模型方程；第二步将该模型方程嵌入模型驱动神经网络的训练中以恢复目标参数，整个框架为无监督、两步式结构。
AI.result: 在二维与三维数值实验中验证了方法的有效性；二维情形下与传统最小二乘法对比，验证了其在计算效率和重建精度上的优势，并表现出对噪声的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提的无监督两步式模型驱动深度学习框架能够快速、准确地重建源函数并保持抗噪性，优于传统最小二乘方法。

title: When Keywords Drop but Classifiers Hold: Soft Refusals under KV Cache Compression
summary: KV cache compression is widely used for long context LLM inference under memory constraints, while deployed systems typically score refusals after generation with keyword filters or learned classifiers. Such monitors are intended to indicate whether a model declined a harmful request under the serving regime actually used. However, it remains unclear whether matched compression that preserves task accuracy also preserves agreement between lightweight lexical monitors and stronger refusal classifiers. We study this with a paired protocol on n=200 harmful prompts with a long filler context: each prompt is answered once under full retention and once under matched eviction after a shared prefill, and the same replies are scored by keyword heuristics, the HarmBench Llama-2-13B classifier, an auxiliary LLM judge, and humans on disagreements. On Qwen2.5-3B, keyword refusal falls from 98.0% to 80.5% (McNemar p~1e-8) while classifier refusal stays near ceiling (99.0%-99.5%) and MMLU accuracy is unchanged (50.0%); human labels predominantly follow the classifier, consistent with soft refusals. The gap is not universal and weakens under short fillers and paired SnapKV, so safety auditing under compression should rely on several judges matched to the serving context rather than on keyword rates alone.

AI.tldr: 在长上下文KV缓存压缩下，关键词拒绝率显著下降，而分类器拒绝率与任务准确率基本不变，说明压缩部署场景的安全审计不能只依赖关键词指标。
AI.motivation: KV缓存压缩广泛用于显存受限的长上下文LLM推理，现有系统常用关键词过滤器或学习型分类器统计拒绝情况。但尚不清楚"在保持任务准确率的前提下"的配对压缩，是否也能保持轻量词汇监控器与更强拒绝分类器之间的一致性，这直接影响压缩服务情境下安全审计结论的可靠性。
AI.method: 采用配对协议，在n=200条有害提示（附长填充上下文）上测试：每条提示在共享prefill后分别按完整保留与匹配淘汰各生成一次，同一回复由关键词启发式、HarmBench Llama-2-13B分类器、辅助LLM评判器打分，并在分歧样本上由人工标注。同时以短填充与配对SnapKV作为对照条件。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-3B上，关键词拒绝率由98.0%降至80.5%（McNemar p≈1e-8），而分类器拒绝率维持在接近上限（99.0%–99.5%），MMLU准确率无变化（50.0%）；人工标签主要与分类器一致，符合"软拒绝"特征。该差距并非普遍存在，在短填充与配对SnapKV下减弱。
AI.conclusion: 压缩部署下的安全审计应使用多个与真实服务情境相匹配的评判器，而不能仅依据关键词拒绝率。

title: On deformations of foliated complex analytic structures I: Theorems of existence and completeness
summary: We study deformations of foliated complex analytic structures defined by locally free subsheaves of tangent sheaves and locally free subsheaves of cotangent sheaves on the basis of Kodaira-Spencer's deformation theory. We prove theorems of existence and completeness for deformations of foliated complex analytic structures defined by locally free subsheaves of tangent sheaves as analogues of theorems of existence and completeness for deformations of complex analytic structures by Kodaira-Spencer. We prove theorems of existence and completeness for deformations of foliated complex analytic structures defined by locally free subsheaves of cotangent sheaves. We also prove theorems of existence and completeness for simultaneous deformations when singular holomorphic foliations on compact complex manifolds are defined by locally free subsheaves of tangent and cotangent sheaves at the same time.

AI.tldr: 本文在Kodaira-Spencer形变理论基础上研究由切层与余切层的局部自由子层所定义的叶状复解析结构的形变问题。
AI.motivation: 将Kodaira-Spencer关于复解析结构形变的经典存在性与完备性定理推广到叶状复解析结构，并覆盖切层、余切层及二者联合定义的奇异全纯叶状结构。
AI.method: 以Kodaira-Spencer形变理论为框架，针对由切层局部自由子层、余切层局部自由子层分别定义的叶状复解析结构，建立相应的存在性与完备性定理；并对紧复流形上同时由切层与余切层局部自由子层定义的奇异全纯叶状结构，证明同时形变的存在性与完备性定理。
AI.result: 得到三类存在性与完备性定理：切层情形、余切层情形，以及二者同时定义的奇异全纯叶状结构的联合形变情形。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把Kodaira-Spencer形变理论系统推广至叶状复解析结构与奇异全纯叶状结构，为其形变的存在性与完备性提供了统一的理论框架。

title: Global solutions for non-isothermal magnetoviscoelastic fluids in the absence of deformation diffusion
summary: We study a non-isothermal model for incompressible magnetoviscoelastic fluids in $\mathbb{R}^N$, $N=2,3$, coupling the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations with the evolution equations for the deformation tensor, temperature, and magnetization. The material coefficients are allowed to depend on the temperature, and no artificial diffusion is imposed on the deformation tensor, leading to a coupled hyperbolic-parabolic system. We establish local well-posedness of strong solutions for sufficiently regular initial data and prove global existence for small perturbations of a constant equilibrium. The global analysis relies on a suitable auxiliary variable combining the velocity and the inverse deformation tensor, which reveals a hidden dissipative structure and allows us to derive uniform higher-order energy estimates for the coupled system.

AI.tldr: 研究了 $\mathbb{R}^N\ (N=2,3)$ 中不可压缩磁粘弹性流体的非等温模型，建立了强解的局部适定性及小扰动下的全局存在性。
AI.motivation: 该模型将不可压缩 Navier-Stokes 方程与形变张量、温度、磁化强度演化方程耦合，材料系数依赖温度且形变张量无人工耗散，形成双曲-抛物耦合系统，此类问题的适定性与长时间行为分析具有挑战性。
AI.method: 引入一个结合速度与逆形变张量的辅助变量，揭示系统隐藏的耗散结构，并据此导出耦合系统的一致高阶能量估计。
AI.result: 对充分正则的初值证明了强解的局部适定性；对常数平衡态的小扰动证明了全局存在性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，借助合适的辅助变量可刻画磁粘弹性系统的隐式耗散机制，从而在无人工扩散条件下获得强解的局部与全局（小扰动）适定性。

title: An Adaptive, Parallel, and Inexact Newton Method for Large-scale Nonlinear Optimal Control
summary: We design adaptive overlapping temporal decomposition (AOTD), a parallel sequential quadratic programming (SQP) method for long-horizon nonlinear optimal control problems (OCPs). As designed, AOTD is the first overlapping temporal decomposition (OTD) algorithm that adapts the overlap size online, eliminating the need to fix a suitable overlap a priori. Specifically, at each iteration, it partitions the long horizon into overlapping nonlinear subproblems, performs one SQP step on each in parallel, and adaptively selects both the overlap size and the accuracy to which the resulting local KKT systems are solved. Two conditions govern the accepted step: an adaptive residual condition bounding the distance from the concatenated inexact direction to the exact Newton direction of the full problem, and a descent condition on the adaptive penalty parameters that certifies descent for a carefully chosen exact augmented Lagrangian. The residual condition is solver independent and accommodates both deterministic iterative solvers and randomized sketching solvers. Under standard regularity assumptions, we prove that the KKT residual converges to zero from any initialization and establish a local linear rate for sequences converging to a strict local minimizer. We validate AOTD on a power-system frequency regulation OCP and a Burgers PDE OCP, attaining a reduction in estimated FLOPs of approximately $2.5\times$ to the best fixed-overlap variant while converging across multiple horizon lengths with a single parameter setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应重叠时间分解（AOTD），一种用于长时域非线性最优控制问题的并行SQP方法，可在线自适应选择重叠尺寸与子问题求解精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的重叠时间分解（OTD）算法需要先验固定合适的重叠尺寸，而合适重叠难以预先确定；长时域非线性OCP又需要高效并行求解。因此作者希望消除对固定重叠的先验依赖。
AI.method: AOTD在每个迭代中将长时域划分为重叠的非线性子问题，并行地对每个子问题执行一步SQP，并自适应地选择重叠尺寸以及局部KKT系统的求解精度。接受的步由两个条件控制：一是自适应残差条件，限定拼接后的非精确方向与全问题精确牛顿方向的距离；二是自适应惩罚参数上的下降条件，为精心选取的精确增广拉格朗日函数提供下降保证。该残差条件与求解器无关，兼容确定性迭代求解器与随机草图（sketching）求解器。
AI.result: 在标准正则性假设下，作者证明KKT残差可从任意初始点收敛到零，并在收敛到严格局部极小点的序列上建立局部线性收敛率。在电力系统频率调节OCP和Burgers PDE OCP上的实验表明：相比最佳固定重叠变体，估计FLOPs减少约2.5倍，且用单一参数设置即可在多个时域长度上收敛。
AI.conclusion: AOTD是首个在线自适应重叠尺寸的OTD算法，兼具理论收敛保证与实际效率提升，消除了对先验固定重叠的需求。

title: Sparsity by Default: The Theory and Practice of ARD in Gaussian Process Regression for Variable Selection
summary: Automatic relevance determination (ARD) is the standard device for input selection in Gaussian process (GP) regression. By giving the covariance kernel a separate lengthscale for every input and learning those lengthscales by maximizing the marginal likelihood, ARD lets the data decide which coordinates matter: irrelevant inputs receive very large lengthscales and are effectively switched off. We trace this mechanism to the Bayesian Occam's razor embodied in the marginal likelihood, derive the gradient through which it prunes inputs, and emphasize that ARD delivers effective rather than exact sparsity. We review the algorithms used in practice and the rules that turn lengthscales into selections, and we survey the asymptotic theory, distinguishing the fixed-domain identifiability obstruction on the lengthscales from the high-dimensional selection-consistency guarantees recently established for hierarchical GP priors, and noting what remains open for plain ARD. We compare ARD with spike-and-slab priors, sparse axis-aligned and global-local shrinkage priors including the Bayesian lasso and horseshoe, penalized likelihood kriging, sensitivity and projection criteria, and additive kernels. We argue that ARD endures because of its seamless integration with kernel learning, universal software support, and low cost, and we close with its limitations and remedies.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了高斯过程回归中自动相关性确定（ARD）的输入选择机制，阐明其源于边缘似然的贝叶斯奥卡姆剃刀、给出剪枝梯度、强调其"有效稀疏"而非精确稀疏的本质，并梳理了实用算法、选择规则、渐近理论（固定域可识别性障碍与高维选择相合性），最后将ARD与尖峰-平板、稀疏收缩先验、惩罚似然克里金、敏感性/投影准则及加性核等替代方法进行比较。
AI.motivation: ARD是高斯过程回归中输入选择的标准手段，但学界对其机制的理论理解分散：既有实践算法与选择规则的经验总结，又有渐近理论上固定域可识别性与高维选择相合性之间的张力，且各类替代稀疏先验方法层出不穷。本文旨在统一梳理ARD的工作机理、理论边界与替代方案，厘清其持久流行的原因及局限。
AI.method: 综述性方法：1）从边缘似然的贝叶斯奥卡姆剃刀视角追溯ARD机制，为每个输入赋予独立长度尺度并通过最大化边缘似然学习；2）推导用于剪枝输入的梯度，指出ARD产生"有效"而非精确稀疏（无关输入获得极大长度尺度而被关闭）；3）回顾实用算法及将长度尺度转化为选择的规则；4）梳理渐近理论，区分固定域长度尺度可识别性障碍与分层GP先验的高维选择相合性保证；5）将ARD与尖峰-平板先验、稀疏轴对齐及全局-局部收缩先验（Bayesian lasso、horseshoe）、惩罚似然克里金、敏感性与投影准则、加性核进行对比。
AI.result: ARD通过为每个输入设置独立长度尺度并最大化边缘似然学习，使无关输入获得极大长度尺度而被有效关闭，从而实现输入选择；其梯度反映了基于边缘似然的剪枝过程，产生的是有效稀疏而非精确稀疏。理论上，固定域下长度尺度存在可识别性障碍，而分层GP先验已在近期获得高维选择相合性保证，但普通ARD的相应结论仍属未决问题。
AI.conclusion: ARD因其与核学习的无缝集成、广泛的软件支持和低计算成本而长期存续；本文同时指出其局限性并给出补救措施，为未来在普通ARD选择相合性理论上留下开放问题。

title: A Model-Informed Deep Learning Algorithm for Solving the Phaseless Inverse Scattering Problem
summary: We study in this paper an unsupervised, two-step, model-informed deep learning framework for solving the phaseless inverse scattering problem. The objective is to reconstruct a compactly supported function that characterizes a scatterer from boundary measurements of the modulus of the total wave corresponding to multiple incident waves. In the first step, the phaseless data are transformed into an imaging function that is directly related to the underlying scatterer. Motivated by the contrast source method, we derive a coupled system of model equations using the Lippmann-Schwinger integral equation and a spectral-based equation involving the imaging function. In the second step, the unknown scatterer and contrast source function are each parameterized as independent feedforward neural networks, which are trained simultaneously at each iteration using the derived system of model equations. The Lippmann-Schwinger integral equation enforces the underlying physics as a model constraint, while the spectral-based equation incorporating the imaging function supplies geometric information on the shape and location of the unknown scatterer. The resulting framework achieves accurate and efficient reconstructions while maintaining robustness to measurement noise. Furthermore, transforming some aspects of the problem to the spectral domain enables an effective reduction in the computational cost, allowing us to recover the unknown scatterer quickly. Numerical experiments in both two- and three-dimensional settings demonstrate the effectiveness, stability, and practical potential of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无监督、两步、模型驱动的深度学习框架求解无相位逆散射问题：先将无相位数据转换为成像函数并推导耦合模型方程组，再以两个独立前馈神经网络分别参数化散射体与对比源并联合训练，实现准确、快速且抗噪的重建，并通过谱域变换降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 无相位逆散射问题仅能获得总波模值的边界测量，缺失相位信息使问题高度非线性且病态，传统方法重建困难。作者希望结合物理模型约束与深度学习的表达能力，在无标注数据条件下实现准确、稳定且高效的重建。
AI.method: 采用两步无监督、模型驱动框架。第一步基于对比源方法，利用Lippmann-Schwinger积分方程与包含成像函数的谱域方程，推导出耦合模型方程组，将无相位数据转换为与散射体直接相关的成像函数。第二步将未知散射体与对比源分别参数化为独立的前馈神经网络，在每个迭代中依据该方程组联合训练：积分方程施加物理模型约束，谱域方程提供形状与位置等几何信息。部分问题变换至谱域以降低计算成本。
AI.result: 该框架实现了准确且高效的重建，对测量噪声具有鲁棒性；谱域变换有效降低了计算开销，能够快速恢复未知散射体。二维与三维数值实验均验证了方法的有效性、稳定性与实用潜力。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的无监督两步模型驱动深度学习框架能够有效求解无相位逆散射问题，兼具物理一致性与几何先验，在保证重建精度与抗噪性的同时显著提升计算效率，具备实际应用前景。

title: Does Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture Pretraining Help Time Series Forecasting?
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPA) have emerged as a promising self-supervised pretraining paradigm for time series, learning representations by predicting target embeddings in latent space rather than reconstructing raw signals. Yet evidence on their benefits remains mixed, and most studies test only a single backbone or a narrow set of architectures, leaving unclear whether JEPA pretraining is a reliable improvement or one that depends heavily on the downstream model. We address this gap through a large scale evaluation of one JEPA instantiation across nine backbones and eleven benchmarks spanning temporal and spatio-temporal forecasting, the most extensive cross architecture assessment of JEPA for time series to date. We find that the benefit of this instantiation varies sharply across backbones, producing consistent gains for some architectures and consistent degradation for others, even on the same dataset. This pattern holds across both task families, indicating the variability is a general property of this instantiation rather than a dataset specific artifact worth accounting for when choosing a backbone in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文对一种JEPA实例进行了跨9种骨干网络、11个基准的大规模评估，发现其预训练收益高度依赖下游骨干架构：部分骨干稳定提升，部分稳定退化，且该现象在时序与时空预测任务中普遍存在。
AI.motivation: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）被视为时间序列自监督预训练的有前景范式，但其收益证据不一；既有研究多只测试单一骨干或有限架构，无法判断JEPA预训练是否为可靠改进，还是严重依赖下游模型。
AI.method: 对一种JEPA实例开展大规模评估：覆盖9种骨干网络与11个基准（涵盖时序预测与时空预测），构成迄今最广泛的JEPA跨架构时间序列评测。该范式在潜空间中预测目标嵌入，而非重建原始信号。
AI.result: 该实例的收益在不同骨干间差异显著：在同一数据集上，对某些架构产生一致增益，对另一些则一致退化。该模式跨越两类任务族均成立，说明这种变异性是该实例的普遍属性，而非数据集特异的偶然现象。
AI.conclusion: JEPA预训练并非普遍可靠的改进，其效果与下游骨干架构强相关；在实践中选择骨干网络时应将这一架构依赖性纳入考量。

title: Degeneration of Calabi-Yau threefolds with Galois action induced by modular form of weight 3
summary: We study a one-parameter family of double octic Calabi-Yau threefolds with two degenerations of type $K$. For each of these degenerations we construct a semistable model and compute the limiting mixed Hodge structure. We show that the $\ell$-adic Galois representation on the limiting cohomology is isomorphic (up to semisimplification) to the direct sum of the Galois representation attached to a weight-three modular form associated with a singular K3 surface and its Tate twist. This gives an explicit realization of the expected relation between type $K$ degenerations of Calabi-Yau threefolds and K3 surfaces.

AI.tldr: 研究含两个K型退化的双八次Calabi-Yau三维簇单参数族，构造半稳定模型并计算极限混合Hodge结构，证明极限上同调的ℓ进Galois表示（半单化后）同构于奇异K3曲面相关的权3模形式Galois表示与其Tate扭的直和。
AI.motivation: 探究Calabi-Yau三维簇的K型退化与K3曲面之间的预期联系，并给出该联系的显式实现。
AI.method: 针对单参数双八次Calabi-Yau三维簇族中的两类K型退化，构造半稳定模型；计算相应的极限混合Hodge结构；并分析极限上同调上的ℓ进Galois表示。
AI.result: 极限上同调的ℓ进Galois表示在半单化意义下，同构于与奇异K3曲面关联的权3模形式的Galois表示与其Tate扭的直和。
AI.conclusion: 显式实现了Calabi-Yau三维簇的K型退化与K3曲面之间的预期关系。

title: Formalization of the Galerkin Construction for the Two-Dimensional Navier--Stokes Equations in Lean
summary: We formalize in Lean 4 the Galerkin construction of global Leray--Hopf weak solutions for the unforced two-dimensional Navier--Stokes equations on arbitrary bounded open domains with no-slip boundary conditions. For every initial datum in the solenoidal \(L^2\) velocity space, the solution has a weakly continuous velocity path, satisfies the weak equation locally in time, and obeys the energy inequality at every time. For rectangles, we also formalize finite-horizon solutions with continuous forcing in the dual energy space. The development includes divergence-free graph spaces, compact spectral coordinates, transport cancellation, Ladyzhenskaya estimates, and simultaneous space--time compactness. The abstract Hilbert-space results apply to evolution equations with a compact energy-to-velocity embedding and a skew trilinear nonlinearity.

AI.tldr: 该文在Lean 4中形式化了二维Navier–Stokes方程全局Leray–Hopf弱解的Galerkin构造。
AI.motivation: 为二维无外力Navier–Stokes方程的Leray–Hopf弱解理论提供机器验证的严格形式化基础。
AI.method: 采用Galerkin逼近，在Lean 4中构建无散图空间、紧谱坐标、输运消去、Ladyzhenskaya估计及时空紧性等工具，并抽象出希尔伯特空间框架。
AI.result: 对任意有界开域无滑移边界与螺线管L²初值，构造出速度弱连续、局部满足弱方程且处处满足能量不等式的全局弱解；矩形域上还处理了有外力连续情形。
AI.conclusion: 抽象Hilbert空间结果适用于具有紧能量-速度嵌入与反对称三线性非线性的演化方程，验证了形式化框架的通用性。

title: Tensor nuclear norm minimization with linear constraints
summary: We study the tensor nuclear norm minimization with general linear constraints, a fundamental model for low-rank tensor optimization that includes many practical applications in computer vision, recommendation systems, revenue management, transportation research. Although the tensor nuclear norm is a convex surrogate for the tensor rank, optimizing it remains computationally challenging because evaluating the nuclear norm itself is NP-hard. We propose a semidefinite programming framework that exposes a finite structure hidden in this problem, even though it appears to possess infinitely many constraints. In particular, we show that the tensor nuclear norm admits an exact SDP representation supported by a finite number of points on the unit sphere. Based on this representation, we develop two complementary solution approaches. The first replaces the unknown support set by a finite sphere discretization which yields a solution with a provable worst-case approximation guarantee. The second selects spherical points adaptively, returns an exact optimum upon finite termination, and otherwise converges asymptotically to an optimal solution. Numerical experiments on synthetic tensor completion instances and real highway traffic data demonstrate that the adaptive method achieves competitive, and often substantially improved, recovery accuracy relative to existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带一般线性约束的张量核范数最小化问题，提出半定规划框架揭示其隐藏的有限结构，证明张量核范数可由单位球上有限个点精确SDP表示，并据此发展离散化近似与自适应精确两种求解方法，在合成张量补全与真实高速公路交通数据上验证了自适应方法的高恢复精度。
AI.motivation: 张量核范数是张量秩的凸松弛，广泛用于计算机视觉、推荐系统、收益管理与交通研究。但直接优化张量核范数在计算上极具挑战，因为其求值本身是NP难的。因此需要为带一般线性约束的张量核范数最小化寻找可行且高效的求解框架。
AI.method: 提出半定规划（SDP）框架，揭示问题虽看似含无穷多约束，实际隐藏着有限结构；证明张量核范数存在由单位球上有限个点支撑的精确SDP表示。基于该表示给出两类互补算法：一是用有限球面离散化替代未知支撑集，具有可证明的最坏情形近似保证；二是自适应选取球面点，有限步终止时返回精确最优解，否则渐近收敛到最优解。
AI.result: 在合成张量补全实例和真实高速公路交通数据上的数值实验表明，自适应方法与现有方法相比具有竞争力，且往往显著提升恢复精度。
AI.conclusion: 张量核范数最小化问题具有可利用的有限SDP结构；所提出的离散化方法与自适应方法分别提供近似保证与精确/渐近最优性，自适应方法在实验中展现出优越的恢复性能，验证了该SDP框架的有效性。

title: Reliable Replay through Spatial Coherence in Online Continual Learning
summary: Continually adapting models to new tasks requires retaining earlier knowledge under limited memory and computation. Experience replay addresses this challenge, but priorities based on individual loss increases overlook how related memories respond to the same update and can overemphasize isolated responses. We introduce SPatial coHErent risk control for REplay (SPHERE), a general replay-allocation method applicable across a broad range of learning settings. SPHERE uses a representation kernel to aggregate signed prospective loss changes, attenuating unsupported spikes while retaining coherent increases. It then formulates allocation as entropy-regularized transport, redistributing uniform source mass toward supported high-risk regions while penalizing long-distance transfers. We derive replay coefficients from the transport objective's sensitivity to the original loss changes and blend them with uniform replay to maintain baseline rehearsal. Our analysis establishes conditions under which kernel aggregation improves risk estimation and bounds transport-value inflation due to residual noise and smoothing bias. Experiments demonstrate that SPHERE improves accuracy and reduces forgetting across noisy-label vision tasks, continual language-model instruction tuning, and code-generation reinforcement learning with incomplete test rewards.

AI.tldr: 提出SPHERE，用表征核聚合有符号损失变化并结合熵正则化最优传输分配回放权重，在多类持续学习场景提升准确率并减少遗忘。
AI.motivation: 持续适应新任务需在有限内存与算力下保留旧知识。经验回放虽能缓解遗忘，但基于单样本损失增量的优先级忽略了相关记忆对同一更新的共同响应，容易过度强调孤立响应，导致回放分配不合理。
AI.method: SPHERE使用表征核聚合有符号的前瞻性损失变化，抑制无支持的尖峰、保留一致性上升；将回放分配建模为熵正则化的最优传输，把均匀源质量向有支持的高风险区域再分配并惩罚长距离传输；由传输目标对原始损失变化的敏感性推导回放系数，并与均匀回放混合以维持基线复述。理论分析给出核聚合改善风险估计的条件，并界定残差噪声与平滑偏差导致的传输价值膨胀。
AI.result: 在噪声标签视觉任务、持续语言模型指令微调以及测试奖励不完整的代码生成强化学习等实验中，SPHERE均提升了准确率并降低了遗忘。
AI.conclusion: SPHERE是一种通用的回放分配方法，通过空间相干风险控制与熵正则化传输实现更稳健的回放优先级，兼具理论保证与跨场景有效性。

title: The stability barrier of a class of Hermite-type discretizations of advection equations
summary: In this paper we fully categorize all hybrid-variable (HV) discretizations of linear advection equations according to their stability property and establish the stability barrier of these methods. In the HV discretization framework, we find numerical approximations to both cell-averaged solutions and nodal solutions and evolve them in time simultaneously. We prove that the HV methods have a similar stability barrier as the classical finite difference schemes, that the semi-discretized HV scheme is stable if and only if it uses a stencil such that the number of unknowns in the upwind direction is precisely that in the downwind direction plus one or two, with only one exception when the two numbers are three and zero, respectively. It is also proved that all central HV schemes are neutrally stable, in the sense that the L2-norm of the solution remain uniformly bounded at all times. The theoretical predictions are verify by extensive numerical tests.

AI.tldr: 本文对线性对流方程的混合变量（HV）离散格式进行了完整分类，建立了其稳定性障碍，并给出了半离散稳定性的充要条件。
AI.motivation: 混合变量离散框架同时演化单元平均解与节点解，其稳定性性质尚缺乏系统刻画，需要明确其稳定性障碍并与经典有限差分格式进行比较。
AI.method: 在线性对流方程的HV离散框架下，同时求解并演化单元平均解与节点解；通过分析迎风方向与顺风方向未知数个数的关系，对全部HV格式进行稳定性分类，并以大量数值实验验证理论预测。
AI.result: HV方法具有与经典有限差分格式类似的稳定性障碍：半离散HV格式稳定当且仅当其模板中迎风方向未知数个数恰为顺风方向未知数个数加一或加二，唯一例外是两数分别为三和零的情形；此外所有中心HV格式均为中性稳定，即解L2范数在所有时刻一致有界。
AI.conclusion: HV离散的稳定性可由模板中迎风与顺风未知数个数关系完全刻画，中心HV格式具有中性稳定性，理论预测经数值实验得到验证。

title: Autonomous Research Project Management as an Agent Skill: A Case Study in Exact Spectral Spatial Regression
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, submitted to Autonomous Machine Learning Research (AutoMLR) 2026 workshop
summary: This work presents an end-to-end demonstration of autonomous machine learning research conducted by an agent skill on consumer hardware. The demonstration evaluates an FFT-based Kernel Ridge Regression (KRR) solver for regular spatial grids using 2005 monthly NOAA Kaplan SST v2 anomaly fields on a $36 \times 72$ grid. This was autonomously executed by DeepSeek V4 Flash, orchestrated by our agent skill suite within DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Experiments were executed on CPU-only hardware (Apple M2 Pro; 78.7 s solver time, 1.57 GB peak RSS). Long-horizon state was decoupled into a file-based epic- and issue-tracking substrate. Across 74 sub-agent sessions, the agent demonstrated closed-loop scientific resilience: routing two failed hypothesis review gates back to literature retrieval, patching bootstrap indexing bugs, and executing with only four discrete human steering events. Finally, we reflect on autonomous research governance, arguing that scientific credibility requires inspectable state, falsifiable review gates, and transparent reporting of negative results, urging the machine learning community to favour agent-accessible structured formats over static PDF manuscripts.

AI.tldr: 该工作展示了一个智能体技能在消费级硬件上端到端完成自主机器学习研究：用基于FFT的KRR求解器处理36×72网格的NOAA Kaplan SST v2月异常场数据，并由DeepSeek V4 Flash在自研智能体编排套件中自主执行。
AI.motivation: 验证自主研究智能体在无GPU的消费级设备上能否独立完成从假设、实现到审查的完整科研闭环，并探讨自主科研的可治理性与可信度问题。
AI.method: 以基于FFT的核岭回归（KRR）求解器为对象，在规则空间网格上处理2005年逐月NOAA Kaplan SST v2异常场（36×72）；由DeepSeek V4 Flash在DeepSeek Harness（DSH）中通过智能体技能套件自主编排，CPU-only（Apple M2 Pro）运行，并将长程状态解耦为基于文件的epic/issue跟踪基底。
AI.result: 单次求解耗时78.7 s，峰值RSS 1.57 GB；共74个子智能体会话，两次失败假设评审门被路由回文献检索，修复了bootstrap索引缺陷，全程仅有4次人工干预。
AI.conclusion: 智能体展现出闭环科研韧性；作者主张科研可信度需依赖可审查状态、可证伪的评审门与负面结果透明报告，并呼吁机器学习社区采用智能体可访问的结构化格式，取代静态PDF论文。

title: Artin vanishing along the $\ell$-adic tower of an abelian variety
summary:
Let $A$ be an abelian variety of dimension $g$ over an algebraically closed field and let $\ell$ be a prime invertible in the field. For every constructible $\mathbb{F}_{\ell}$-sheaf $F$ on $A$ we prove that there is an integer $e$, depending on $F$, such that the pullback map $[\ell^{e}]^{*}\colon\mathrm{H}^{i}(A,[\ell^{n}]^{*}F)\to\mathrm{H}^{i}(A,[\ell^{n+e}]^{*}F)$ is zero for all $n\geq0$ and all $i>\dim\operatorname{Supp}F$. In particular $\varinjlim\limits_{n}\mathrm{H}^{i}(A,[\ell^{n}]^{*}F)=0$ for $i>\dim\operatorname{Supp}F$, which answers a question of Bhatt--Schnell--Scholze.
  Our methods also give sharp codimension estimates for the supports of the cohomology sheaves of the Fourier--Mellin transform of a perverse sheaf. With $\ell$-adic coefficients, we remove the arithmeticity hypothesis from the estimates of Esnault--Kerz. The corresponding estimates for the completed transform with $\mathbb{F}_{\ell}$-coefficients are new and hold even when Hard Lefschetz fails.

AI.tldr: 证明了阿贝尔簇上constructible sheaf的pullback映射在某整数平移后为零，从而其直极限上同调在超过support维数时消失，回答了Bhatt--Schnell--Scholze的问题，并给出Fourier--Mellin变换支撑的尖锐余维估计。
AI.motivation: 解决Bhatt--Schnell--Scholze关于阿贝尔簇上constructible sheaf经[\ell^n]^*拉回后上同调直极限消失性的问题，并改进Fourier--Mellin变换的余维估计（去掉Esnault--Kerz的算术性假设，推广到\mathbb{F}_\ell系数）。
AI.method: 研究阿贝尔簇A上constructible \mathbb{F}_\ell-sheaf F，利用multiplier map [\ell^e]^*的拉回映射并引入依赖于F的整数e；借助Fourier--Mellin变换分析perverse sheaf上同调层支撑的余维。
AI.result: 对每个constructible \mathbb{F}_\ell-sheaf F存在整数e，使得[\ell^e]^*: H^i(A,[\ell^n]^*F) -> H^i(A,[\ell^{n+e}]^*F)对所有n>=0及i>dim Supp F为零；因此直极限H^i(A,[\ell^n]^*F)=0对i>dim Supp F成立。同时得到Fourier--Mellin变换支撑的尖锐余维估计，\ell-adic系数下去掉算术性假设，\mathbb{F}_\ell系数下completado transform的估计为新的且在Hard Lefschetz失效时仍成立。
AI.conclusion: 该工作完整回答了Bhatt--Schnell--Scholze的问题，并显著推广了Esnault--Kerz的估计，表明相关余维界不依赖算术性且适用于更一般的系数和Hard Lefschetz失效情形。

title: Staying on the Attractor: Supervising Neural Surrogates of 3D Turbulence Where They Leave It
summary: Neural surrogates are trained to predict 3D turbulent flows in place of direct numerical simulation (DNS). For chaotic flows, the goal is short-term pointwise accuracy followed by long-term physical and statistical fidelity. However, small prediction errors can carry a surrogate away from the flow's attractor. Off-attractor states are poorly represented in training data, leaving their evolution weakly constrained. The learned dynamics can then amplify deviations and lead to blow-up, freezing, or statistical drift. We propose off-attractor supervision (OAS) to supervise neural surrogates where they leave the attractor. OAS teaches the model how the true Navier-Stokes dynamics would evolve from these states. Each selected state is paired with its own future computed by DNS. Three generators select a few hundred states for relabeling. The first collects states from the surrogate's own rollouts. The second uses surrogate attacks to target freezing, excessive amplification, and violations of incompressibility and energy balance. The third perturbs training states along an amplified direction and a strongly damped random direction of the dynamics. All attacks run on the surrogate alone, and DNS relabeling is performed offline once per selected state. Experiments on $128^3$ turbulence show that OAS increases the median time to failure from 21 to 721 steps. The compared baselines achieve medians of at most 110 steps, and the advantage holds across training seeds. OAS also achieves the lowest pointwise error at step 15 and the best long-horizon statistics among the compared methods. OAS integrates physical models into neural simulation by extending supervision from fixed reference trajectories to states where the surrogate is likely to fail. This principle can guide the development of more reliable scientific surrogates when deployment takes models beyond the coverage of their training data.

AI.tldr: 提出 off-attractor supervision (OAS)，在神经代理离开吸引子处用 DNS 重新标注并监督，将 128³ 湍流的中位失效时间从 21 步提升至 721 步，并改善点误差与长时统计。
AI.motivation: 用于替代 DNS 的神经代理在混沌湍流中会因微小误差偏离吸引子；离吸引子状态在训练数据中稀少、演化约束弱，被学习动力学放大后导致发散、冻结或统计漂移，因此需要针对这些状态补充监督。
AI.method: OAS 在每个选定状态处配对其由 DNS 计算出的未来轨迹作为标签。三种生成器各选取数百个状态：(1) 从代理自身 rollout 采样；(2) 用代理攻击针对冻结、过度放大、不可压缩性与能量平衡违背；(3) 沿动力学的放大方向和强阻尼随机方向扰动训练状态。所有攻击仅在代理上运行，DNS 重标注离线一次性完成。
AI.result: 在 128³ 湍流上，OAS 将中位失效时间从 21 步提高到 721 步；对比基线中位最多为 110 步，且优势在各训练随机种子下保持。OAS 在第 15 步取得最低点误差，并在所比较方法中取得最佳长时统计。
AI.conclusion: OAS 通过将监督从固定参考轨迹扩展到代理可能失败的状态，把物理模型融入神经仿真；该原则可指导在部署超出训练数据覆盖范围时构建更可靠的科学代理。

title: Symmetry of solutions to nonlocal Neumann problems with the fractional Laplacian in half spaces
summary: This paper investigates the fractional Laplacian equation in half-spaces, focusing on cases with nonlocal Neumann boundary conditions. We consider both single equations and systems, and establish two key principles: the decay at infinity principle and the narrow region principle. These foundational results, combined with the direct method of moving planes, allow us to derive symmetry and monotonicity properties for decaying solutions. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first results concerning the symmetry of solutions to fractional Laplacian equations with nonlocal Neumann conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究半空间中带非局部 Neumann 边界条件的分数阶 Laplace 方程，建立无穷远处衰减原理与窄区域原理，并结合直接移动平面法，得到衰减解的对称性与单调性，为该类非局部边界问题中关于解的对称性的首批结果。
AI.motivation: 半空间中分数阶 Laplace 方程在非局部 Neumann 边界条件下的解的性质尚缺乏研究，尤其是解的对称性结果此前未见报道，因此有必要发展相应工具来刻画衰减解。
AI.method: 针对半空间中的分数阶 Laplace 方程（含单个方程与方程组），在非局部 Neumann 边界条件下建立无穷远处衰减原理和窄区域原理，再将这些基础性结果与直接移动平面法相结合。
AI.result: 成功证明了衰减解具有对称性与单调性。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是关于带非局部 Neumann 条件的分数阶 Laplace 方程解的对称性的首批结果，为后续非局部边界问题研究提供了新的原理与框架。

title: Complexity analysis of trust-region methods under $(α,L_0,L_1)$-smoothness
summary: Generalized smoothness assumptions have attracted growing attention in recent years, motivated in part by machine learning problems in which the gradient of the objective function may not be Lipschitz continuous. Among the most prominent of these is the $(α, L_0, L_1)$-smoothness assumption. Existing methods that attain the best known complexity bounds require knowledge of, or upper bounds on, $α$, $L_0$ and $L_1$, while the few parameter-agnostic methods available do not recover those bounds. In this paper, we show that trust-region methods attain the best known bounds for $(α, L_0, L_1)$-smooth objective functions without prior knowledge of these parameters. Establishing these results requires new analytical tools, beyond those used in classical trust-region complexity analyses. We further show that our working model assumption allows the use of general model Hessian approximations and, in particular, accommodates limited-memory quasi-Newton updates. Finally, we show that our complexity bound is sharp in the nonconvex setting.

AI.tldr: 本文证明信赖域方法在无需预知参数的情况下，对(α, L0, L1)-光滑目标函数达到已知最优复杂度界，并给出新的分析工具。
AI.motivation: 近年来广义光滑性假设（如(α, L0, L1)-光滑）受到关注，源于机器学习中目标函数梯度可能非Lipschitz连续。已有达到最优复杂度界的方法需要知道或上界α、L0、L1，而少数参数无关方法无法恢复这些界，因此需要参数无关且保持最优复杂度的方法。
AI.method: 采用信赖域方法，在不需要先验知道(α, L0, L1)的情况下进行复杂度分析；为此建立超越经典信赖域复杂度分析的新分析工具。同时在工作模型假设下允许使用一般模型Hessian近似，特别是有限内存拟牛顿更新。
AI.result: 信赖域方法在不预知(α, L0, L1)时达到(α, L0, L1)-光滑目标函数的最优已知复杂度界；支持一般Hessian近似与有限内存拟牛顿更新；在非凸设定下复杂度界是紧的。
AI.conclusion: 信赖域方法可实现参数无关的最优复杂度，且分析框架具通用性并支持拟牛顿近似；非凸情形下界紧。

title: A Statistical Perspective on Knowledge Distillation: Foundations, Classical Methods, and Large Language Model Extensions
summary: Knowledge Distillation (KD) has emerged as a vital paradigm for transferring the capabilities of high-capacity models to efficient ``student'' counterparts, addressing critical challenges in computational cost, deployment constraints, and privacy-sensitive settings. Although KD is widely used in practice, it is often viewed primarily as an engineering technique, with a unified statistical perspective remaining less developed. This review bridges that gap by presenting a unified Bayesian formulation of KD that formulates teacher predictions as prior information. This provides a principled interpretation of how teacher information is incorporated into student learning and establishes a rigorous connection to uncertainty quantification. We demonstrate how this foundational lens reconciles classical distillation with modern extensions in generative and foundation-model systems, showing that contemporary developments remain rooted in these same statistical principles. By synthesizing theory with emerging methodologies and diverse applications, this review provides a conceptual roadmap and identifies critical open problems for the future of the field.

AI.tldr: 该综述提出知识蒸馏（KD）的统一贝叶斯表述，将教师预测视为先验信息，从而为KD提供统计原理性解释并连接不确定性量化，统一了经典蒸馏与现代生成式/基础模型扩展。
AI.motivation: KD在实践中广泛使用，但多被视为工程技巧，缺乏统一的统计视角，理论解释不足。
AI.method: 提出统一贝叶斯框架，将教师预测建模为先验信息，据此分析教师信息如何融入学生学习，并建立与不确定性量化的严格联系。
AI.result: 该视角调和了经典蒸馏与生成式模型、基础模型系统中的现代扩展，表明当代发展仍根植于相同统计原理。
AI.conclusion: 通过综合理论与新兴方法及应用，本文提供概念路线图，并指出该领域未来关键开放问题。

title: Finance-Informed Operator Learning for Option Pricing with Quantum-Compatible Realizations
summary: Pricing European options under local volatility requires repeatedly solving a PDE whose coefficients change with recalibration, while practitioners need both prices and sensitivities across spot-time surfaces. Neural surrogates can amortize these solves, but near expiry the solution loses regularity, making curvature difficult to learn and allowing violations of no-arbitrage bounds. We propose a finance-informed Deep Operator Network (FI-DeepONet) that decomposes the pricing operator into an input-dependent Black-Scholes carrier and a learned correction. The carrier uses strike-line integrated variance, capturing the leading near-expiry curvature singularity, while a smooth monotone Financial Admissibility Layer enforces pointwise price bounds. We derive a short-maturity estimate and differentiated asymptotics for the exact correction, together with identities linking correction error to price, sensitivity, and PDE-residual errors. On in-distribution tests, FI-DeepONet reduces global relative price error by nearly an order of magnitude versus vanilla and physics-informed DeepONet baselines. On parameter-shift OOD tests within the same local-volatility family, generalization is moderate. On index-option data, the frozen model remains accurate without market-specific retraining, though it does not outperform the same-input analytic formula. We also give a quantum-compatible realization in which selected linear maps are exactly compiled or approximated by a restricted diagonal-orthogonal family before supervised adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出FI-DeepONet：将局部波动率下的欧式期权定价算子分解为输入相关的Black-Scholes载体与可学习修正项，配合金融可容许层强制无套利界限，在分布内测试中相对基线降低近一个数量级的相对价格误差。
AI.motivation: 局部波动率下欧式期权定价需随再校准反复求解系数变化的PDE，业界需要整个现货-时间曲面上的价格与敏感度；神经代理模型可摊销求解成本，但临近到期时解的正则性退化，曲率难以学习，且易违反无套利界限。
AI.method: FI-DeepONet将定价算子分解为输入相关的Black-Scholes载体与学习到的修正项；载体采用行权价线性积分方差以捕捉临近到期的曲率奇异性主导项；引入平滑单调的金融可容许层逐点强制价格界限。理论上给出短期限估计、精确修正项的微分渐近式，并建立修正误差与价格、敏感度、PDE残差误差之间的恒等关系。另给出量子兼容实现：部分线性映射在监督适配前被精确编译或由受限对角正交族逼近。
AI.result: 分布内测试中，FI-DeepONet相较vanilla与物理信息DeepONet基线将全局相对价格误差降低近一个数量级；同族局部波动率参数偏移OOD测试中泛化中等。在指数期权数据上，冻结模型无需市场特定微调仍保持准确，但未超过同输入解析公式。
AI.conclusion: 金融先验（载体分解与可容许层）能显著改善定价算子的学习精度并保持无套利约束，跨参数泛化与实际市场数据迁移具一定鲁棒性，量子兼容实现提供了进一步的硬件适配路径。

title: What does FFN compression change downstream? Same-state causal restoration in diffusion language models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable flexible, parallel generation, but their iterative denoising remains computationally expensive, motivating increasingly aggressive compression. Existing compression objectives largely measure how well compressed computation approximates the original locally, but local error does not reveal which removed computations actually matter to the downstream denoising trajectory. We introduce Same-State Causal Restoration (SSR), which restores the original FFN on the exact current input reached by the compressed model and measures how the resulting trajectory changes. To our knowledge, this is the first direct measurement of the same-current-input closed-loop effect of removed FFN computation in DLM compression. Across LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-v0-Instruct-7B, compressed-side state ranks this downstream effect substantially better than local NMSE at fixed denoising phase, while controlled interventions show that correction structure matters beyond magnitude. Using task-label-free calibration, SSR freezes a single restoration window for held-out inference. Under aggressive LLaDA compression, restoring only four transitions recovers 89.9% of the lost accuracy while retaining an estimated 36.8% whole-model MAC saving and outperforming an equal-budget local-error baseline. Dream further shows that restoring dense behavior and repairing the final task are distinct outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Same-State Causal Restoration (SSR)，通过在压缩模型到达的相同当前输入上恢复原始 FFN，直接度量被移除 FFN 计算对扩散语言模型去噪轨迹的闭环因果影响。实验表明，压缩端状态在预测该下游效应上显著优于局部 NMSE，且在激进压缩下仅恢复四个转移即可挽回 89.9% 的损失精度，同时保留约 36.8% 的整模型 MAC 节省。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）支持灵活并行生成，但其迭代去噪计算代价高昂，因而压缩需求日益激进。现有压缩目标主要衡量压缩计算在局部对原始计算的逼近程度，但局部误差无法揭示哪些被移除的计算真正影响下游去噪轨迹，导致压缩策略可能错失关键计算。
AI.method: 提出 Same-State Causal Restoration (SSR)：在压缩模型实际到达的精确当前输入上恢复原始 FFN，并测量由此产生的轨迹变化，从而首次直接测量 DLM 压缩中被移除 FFN 计算的"同当前输入闭环效应"。采用无任务标签的校准方式，为留出推理冻结单一恢复窗口；并进行受控干预以考察校正结构的作用。
